dkar chagdpar skrun gsal bshad/ ༷ sgagleng gzhi/ ༷ 1gtam dpe dang 'brel sku(da kyi 'phel gtam 'ga' zhig ༷ 7le tshan dang bo/ dpe kho na ched du bshad de brjod don gang yin pa rang shugs kyis gsal bar ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ 27le tshan gnyis ba/ bod gna' rabs pas dpe mang drangs nas don gcig mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom srol gyi rgyun ltar/ dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don gang yin pa de nan tan du ston pa'i gtam dpe'i grag/ ༷ 163le tshan gsum ba/ tshig sdud che ba'i dpe tshig 'bru bzhi can gyis brjod don ston par byed pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ 189le tshan bzhi ba/ dpe sogs 'byog brjod kyis ma brgyan par phul du byung ba'i tshig sbyor gyis brjod don thad shar ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ 217len tshan lnga ba/ tshig rkang gcig gis don dang tshig rkang gcig gis dpe bstan nas dpe don zung du sbrel bas brjod bya'i ngon snying gsal bar ston pa'i gtam dpe'i gras/ ༷ ༷ 287
len tshan drug pa/ bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud dam/ lo rgyus bshad tshul semanas dang 'brengs ba 〈snad pa'i gtam dpe 'ga' zhig gi 'byung khungs sam byung tshul so sor bshad pa/ ༷༷ 325mjug bsdu ba/ 355bskyar zhib bgyis pa'i g.ya' sel/ 359
dpar skrun gsal bshad/da༅/ /bod kyi shes rig la byang chub pa'i chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs lags kyis brtsams pa'i gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun 'di ni de snga bod kyi gtam dpe phyogs btus bgyis pa gzhan rnams las khyad du 'phags pa zhig byung yod/ le tshan drug gi nang du rigs 'dra'i sde tshan dbye 'byed kyis gtam dpe'i ngo grangs chig stong drug brgya skor zhig nyams zhib dang 'tshol sgrig gnang zhing / gtam dpe de 'brel tshig don gnyis lnga'i don 'grel tsam ma zad 'brel yod lo rgyus rnams kyang zur gsal sde tshan du bkod sgrig gnang lte bod kyi gtam dpe la slob sbyong gi brgyud rim gsar pa zhig ngo sprod gnang yod/der ma zad khong gis phyogs btus dang rtsom sgrig bgyis pa'i zhal rgyun 'di yi mjug tu gtam mdzod la bskyar zhib bgyis pa'i g.ya' sel 'es pa brtsams nga/ra gnang ste rigs 'dra'i sde tshan 'khrugs pa dang / go don nor ba rnams la g.ya' sel yang gnang ba bcas ni nga tshor bslab bya chen po zhig chags yod/ bod kyi skad yig dang skad yig 'di nang 'tsho ba'i rig gzhung 'dir bod kyi gtam dpe ji tsam gal chen po yin pa ni dpe deb 'di nyid la thugs zhib gnang na nges pa rnyed cing gsal po chags nges//gtam dpe de dag gi khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan ni nyung ngu tshig gi nang du gal che'i gnad don mi nyung ba zhig shin tu stabs bde'i tshig sbyor nang bkol thub pa de yin/ dper na/ rang re kun kyis shes pa/ kha rin po che/ lus bde ru chug /ces pa la mtshon na kha la za rgyu'i zas la tshul bzhin 'dzems zon byas na lus po bde thang yong gi yod pa'i bslab bya gang zhig sman gzhung nang du gsungs pa dang dngos yod gnas tshul
sga/ gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/du byung ba gnyis ngo sprod gnang gi yod cing / de dang chabs cig gtam dpe de nyid kyis rang gi kha nas dgos med kyi smra ba ma mang ba byas te rang gi mgo la kha mchu rnyog gra dang don med rtsod pa'i rigs med par byas te lus bde ru chug dgos pa'i bslab bya yang ston par mdzad/ gzhan yang gal te gzhan la zur za byed dgos byung yang shin tu rno ngar ldan pa'i gnad don zhig ha cang gi tshig sbyor bde mo'i nang smra bar byed thub/ dper na/ brtag sgril ma red dngul sgril red/ jo bo ma red byams pa red/ byams pa byams pa chos bzang red/ byams pa'i gzungs gzhug a ni red/ lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang ston pa gar song ston ka / ston pa'i yul na dpyid ka /la sogs pa'i tshig sbyor nus ldan de dag gtam dper gtams yod/ der brten da lam 'di nas bod kyi skad yig deb phreng brgyad par dpar skrun zhus pa lags so/ /dpe deb 'di yis bod mi'i rig gzhung ngo sprod dang skad yig chu tshad gong mthor gtong ba la phan rlabs chen po yong ba'i re ba chen po yod//bzhugs sgar bod kyi dpe mdzod khang ni/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bla med kyi dgongs gzhi las grub cing / phyi lo 1971 nas da bar chos rig gi gsung rab ji snyed cig dpar du bskrun yod cing / bar lam phyi lo 2000 tsam nas tshan rig dang nang chos kyi 'brel ba'i steng nyams zhib dang bod 'gyur/ bod kyi nang pa'i na gzhon ris med dge 'dun grangs bcad la tshan rig gi zab sbyong / 2005 tsam nas nang bstan gsung 'gyur gyi zab sbyong rgyun skyong gnang bzhin pa/ gsung chos 'dzin grwa 'phar ma dbu 'dzugs zhus pa bcas ni las gzhi 'phar ma gsar gtod zhus pa'i dpe mtshon tsam yin/ las gzhi de dag thams cad 'di ga'i 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag rdor mchog gi thad ga'i gzigs rtog 'og las don sgrub bzhin pa lags so/ /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi bod kyi rig gzhung nyams zhib dang bod yig dpar skrun sde tshan 'gan 'dzin na ga sangs rgyas bstan dar gyis rab gnas chu 'brug lo ste/ phyi lo 2012 zla 9 tshes 15 la//
gleng gzhi/da༅༅/ /rang cag bod kyi mi rigs 'di ni 'dzam gling sa yi go la'i rtse mor byung zhing 'phel ba'i las la brtson zhing / dpa' mdzangs brtul phod ldan la/ shes rig kyang rnam par bkra ba'i phul byung gi mi rigs shig yin/ rang re'i yang mes rnams kyis mi rabs nas mi rabs grangs med pa brgyud mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po'i ngos las sgyi khre stong phrag 'ga' zhig gis mngon par 'phags pa'i sa mtho 'dir/ g.yang gzar che ba'i ri brag chu gter chen po'i rlabs kyi phreng ba ji bzhin gcig nas gcig tu 'brel ba'i ri rgyud kyis gang ba'i khrod du/ kha char bu yug 'tshub pa dang sa mtho'i rlung dmar sogs rang byung khams chen po'i 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nyer 'tshe sgyi g.ya' ba gang dang gang zhig la'ang ya nga dang bag tsha med par pha tsha bu rabs mi rgyud kyi phreng ba zam mi chad pas dpa' ngar gyi 'thab rtsod drag po mtha' gcig tu byas te rang gi pha yul 'dzugs skrun thog'grog las dang / zhing las/ nags las/ lag shes bzo las sogs thon skyed gsar spel gyi bya rim nang 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog ngo mtshar ches che bar brtsi 'os pa'i lag rjes bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig bzhag yod par brten/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor ba sogs skye bo rgan gzhon pho mo su zhig yin rung / rang nyid sa mtho'i gnas mchog 'dir slobs pa tsam la'ang zad mi shes pa'i dga' thro dang slobs nyams tshad med skye zhing / yid smon dang ngo mtshar phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du bsngags brjod kyi me tog sil ma ci dgar thor bzhin pa rtag tu rang re'i mthong thos kyi yul du gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa ni rgyu mtshan med pa zhig ga la yin/ de ltar mi lo khri stong du ma'i ring la rang yul gsar gtod ngang spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed
2 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/dam 'tsho ba sogs phyogs gang thad nas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i bya rim dus yun ha cang ring po de'i nang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal rnam mang phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed cig gsar skrun dang 'phel rgyas byung yod//'on kyang bar skabs mi lo brgya phrag 'ga' zhig gi ring spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs dang bsam blo'i dbang sgyur gyi phyogs lhung sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas bod kyi mi rigs 'di la rang brtsi rang bkur byed pa'i snying stobs rim bzhin je zhan du gyur stabs/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi srol rgyun shes rig sgyu rtsal rnams la skye bo tha mal pa'i spyod yul zhes mthong chung khyad gsod dang / 'gog gnon zur 'bud sogs nyams rgud tshabs chen phog yod na yang / rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs tshos rang nor rang gces kyi la rgya ma bor bar rgyun 'dzin mtha' khyongs dang ngag thog gi brgyud sprod mi rabs nas mi rabs la zam mi 'chad par byas stabs/ mtha' ma da lta'i bar du'ang phyogs gang ci'i thad srol rgyun bzang po ji snyed cig 'tshol zhib dang rdzog 'don bya rgyu yod//dper na nye ba'i lo shas nang gong rim gyi mdzub ston gzhir bzung bod rang skyong ldongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs dang / rdzongs rig gnas thing khongs bod kyi sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug khang so so nas 'tshol bsdu dang / phyogs sgrig yig sgyur/dpe skrun bcas gnang dang gnang bzhin pa'i dmangs khrod kyi rig rtsal 〈〈phyogs bsdus chen po gsum 〉〉dang / 〈〈phyogs bsdus chen po bdun 〉〉bcas gang zhig yin rung thams cad la bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing / rang rang so so'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad gshis thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo mtshar gcig las gcig che ba sha stag yin la/ de dag tshang mar rang nyid kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i don snying dang rin thang ldan pa ni smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang kho bo rang gi phyogs re ba'i 'dod tshul ltar na de dag thams cad kyi
gling gzhi/ 3khrod nas dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe 'di kho na ris su ma chad pa'i bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa khul yongs la dar khyab che zhing / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa/ nang don phun sum tshogs la bsam blo'i rang bzhin gson nyams ldan pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad ha cang mtho ba sogs mdor na 'tshol sgrig dang zhib 'jug byed rin che 〈snas yin pa lta bur mthong //spyi tshogs rig par zhib dbyad gnang mkhan gyi mkhas pa'i gsung las kyang /66gtam dpe ni mi rnams kyi thon skyed dang / 'tsho ba/ spyi tshogs kyi 'brel gtugs sogs kyi nang rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul sna tshogs la blta zhib yun ring dang shes rtogs gting zab byas pa'i tha snyad kyi spyi sdom zhig yin la/ de ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi shes rab kyi nying bcud dang shes yon gyi gsog 'jog cig kyang yin/de'i mtshon byed kyi rnam pa ni dmangs khrod kyi ngag thog rtsom rig gi khyab khongs su gtogs shing / nang don thad rig pa sna mang gi tshan rig rgyu cha tshud yod/3 ces thos pa'i bsdoms tshig 'di yang don la gnas pa zhig 'dug snyam/ gzhan yang bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe ni tshig nyung la don zab pa dang / go bde la gson shugs ldan pa/ spro ba rgyas la bzhad gad 'phel ba/ spyi tshogs kyi bya dngos phyogs gang thad nas mtshon thub pas bod rig pa zhib 'jug gi dbyad gzhi 'dzad mtha' med pa/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs yongs kyis nyan 'dod la shod dga' ba/ blo la nges sla zhing ngag nas 'don bde ba / tshig rkang res don re ston cing blang 'dor 'byed thabs myur ba la sogs pa'i dge mtshan khyad chos brjod kyis mi lang ba ldan pas dngos 'brel gces su 'os pa'i srol rgyun gyi rig gnas shig yin//der brten da phan 'brel yod tshan pa khag nas bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i thad la thugs 'khur ma bzhes pa min te gtam dpe phyogs sgrig gi deb 'ga' zhig snga
4 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/rjes su dpe skrun 'grems spel gnang yod pa ma zad/ bod yig gi dus deb khag cig dang tshags par sogs kyi thog tu'ang dum bu mang po 'don spel gnang bzhin pa rtag tu mthong rgyu yod pa sogs las mtshon thub/ 'on kyang de dag phal che ba gcig nas bskyar bskor yang bskor gyi zlos skyon mang ba dang / gnyis nas legs bshad khag gam/ yang na 〈〈kha che pha lu'i bslab bya 〉〉〈〈(tsig gtam rgyud 〉〉dang 〈〈bya sbrel gtam rgyud 〉〉〈〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉〉la sogs pa mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom dang / phyogs sgrig dpe skrun zin pa'i yig rigs nang 'khod pa'i tshig dum mam/ de min gtam dpe ma yin pa'i gzhas tshig dra rwags kyang gang 'tsham mnyam du 'dres 'dug pa de dag bsdu 'god gnang ba'i kun slong dang 'bad rtsol sogs bzang na yang 'di rigs kyis dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i dwangs gtsang rang bzhin la bsres lhad zhugs te nam zhig bza' 'phro 'thung 'phro 〈snad tshad mnyam 'dres kyis phag sto lta bu zhig chags mi srid dam/ gal te de ltar gyur tshe sngon byon pha mes kyi shul bzhag gces nor gzhan dring mi 'jog pa 'di lta bu rang re rjes rabs pa tsho'i lag pas/ na dgon gnyer phyi dar mkhas na / gser sku rag la btang yong 99 zhes pa'i dpe bzhin du 'gyur ba'ang srid snyam pa zhib mo'i blos dpyod par 'os so/ /de yang sngar gyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe da phan yig thog tu ma 'khyol ba tshig gcig yin rung don gnyer chen pos 'tshol bsdu bya rgyu ni dus nam yin yang gal ha cang che ba smos ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang bod du gtam dpe 'tshol sgrig gi bya gzhag 'go tshugs pa nas da bar mi lo bcu phrag gsum tsam se snang zin pas da lta'i char gtso bo'i las 'gan ni gtam dpe 'tshol bsdu dang phyogs sgrig bgyis rigs la zhib bsher zhu dag dang / lhag par gtam dpe re re bzhin gyi tshig don la dgos nges kyi 'grel bshad mdor bsdus re'am/ yang na so sor bed spyod bya yul dang byed stangs/ lo rgyus
gleng gzhi/ 5sam gtam rgyud dang 'brel yod gtam dpe'i rigs la 'byung khungs dang bshad tshul ji ltar yod pa la sogs pa'i 'grel bshad gang nus bcas cung zad brgyud rim ldan pa zhig gsar rtsom bya dgos pa de ni nar 'gyangs byed thabs med pa'i bya ba kha tsha dgos gtugs shig yin snyam//gang lags she na deng skabs bod rig par zhib 'jug gi bya gzhag de rgyal yongs dang 'dzam gling yul phyogs kun la khyab gdal du 'gro ba'i skas 'dir rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i mkhas pa mang pos bod kyi dmangs srol rig gnas khag la 'tshol zhib dang / shes rtogs bya rgyur do snang ha cang chen po gnang gi yod//des na gtam dpe lta bur cha mtshon na thog mar khong tshos dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i tshig don rags pa tsam dang / ma mthar yang shes dgos nges kyi 'brel yod gnas lugs tsam gsal rtogs ma thub na de'i don snying dang / khyad nus/ sgyu rtsal sogs shes thabs ma mchis pa ni smos ci dgos/ de bas kyang ya mtshan la yid mug pa zhig ni deng sang gi bod rigs gzhon skyes mang po rang rigs kyi btam dpe go mi thub pa'am/ la las shod shes kyang don mi rtogs pa/ la las don shes na yang tshig 'grel rgyag mi thub pa/ tha na dpe don phyin ci log tu spyod pa sogs rtag par mthong thos mi nyung ba zhig 'phrad bzhin pa de yin/ dus mtshungs lo rgyus sam gtam rgyud sogs las 'phros pa'i rgyun spyod gtam dpe'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang byung tshul sogs ni rang rigs dar ba'i khrod du'ang gsung rgyu yod pa u dum wa ra'i me tog gi spun zlar 'khyams/ gzhi rkang yun ring khyab gdal du gnas pa'i dmangs khrod kyi gtam dper 'grel bshad byed pa la rig gzhung gi chu tshad sogs cha skye tshon mtho po ci yang mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong dang cha rgyus gang 'tsham yod pa'i mi rgan de rigs ni dgun rlung bser bus ded pa'i shing lo ji bzhin gang sar lo re nas lo re
6 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/lhag med du gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa las/ sus kyang sgug sdod mi byed pa mthong gsal bcas dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas kho bos 'dir bod rigs khrod kyi gtam mdzod thog ma'i deb chung 'di nyid ma 'ongs par rtsab tshugs nas lo 'dab rgyas pa dang / me tog phyogs brgyar bzhad nas 'bras bu g.yur za'i sa bon tsam du 'gyur res rtsom 'go btsugs pa lags so//

38 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/45 skye sa sa yar 'phen/ spyod bas mar 'a zen/ skye khungs drag pa'i bu phrug gis kun spyod ngan pa spel mkhan la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa yin//46 skra rtse rlung gis bskyod kyang / skra rtsa ka trar 'grar yod/ phyi'i snang tshul la 'gyur ba'am g.yo 'gul ji ltar byung na yang / nang gi sems rtsa'am/ rtsa don la 'gyur ldog sku(nga mi srid zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//47 brkyangs na mda' nyan ba/ bkug na gzhu nyan ba/ spyod yon 'jon thang ldan pa'i gzhon nu ste bya ba gang zhig byed du bcug na'ang thams cad legs sgrub thub mkhan sha stag gso skyong bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyad na chog pa yin//48 bskal ba bzang po gi rdza chang de/ dus tshod ngan ba'i khral la 'jags/ bod rnying par bla ma'am dpon po sogs sa gnas gang du slebs kyang de ga'i mang tshogs kyis ja chang dang / sgo nga / mar dkrog /sha sogs 'bul srol rnams tho 'god byas te dus phyis lo re bzhin sprod dgos pa'i khral la 'jags pa mang po yod pa de dang 'dra ba'i gnas tshul rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / mdor na 'jal dgos nges kyi khral rigs ngo ma min zer ba'am/ rang phyogs nas yag po byas pa de mtha' ma chag sgo rang thog la log byung zer ba lta bu la spyad na'ang chog pa yin//49 bskal ba'i yur bar/ srid ba'i chu drangs/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar sngar hreto spru ji ltar spyod pa'i byed sgo rnams 'phyugs med byas pa yin zer ba'am/ byed bzhin yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / 'di ni srol rnying gang yin bzang por rloms pa'i bsam blo'i shugs rkyen mtshon pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin//5༷ kha lce 'ug ba'i slo 'dra ba/ skad cha ring tsam thung tsam kho na shod mkhan cha 'jog byed thabs med pa'i mi de rigs la spyod pa yin//
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 3951 kha tig ma myong na/ mngar mo'i bro ba mi shes/ dka' sdug myangs ma myong ba'i mis/bde skyid ngo ma gang yin shes tshor zab mo zhig yong mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//52 kha stong nang gi lce stong / skad cha brgya bshad stong bshad mang po zhig byas na yang /don gyi snying po gang yang mi 'dug zer ba de rigs la spyod cing / yang la las re don bcol ba'i skad cha bshad rjes 'bul tshan sogs gang yang byung ma song zer ba la'ang spyod srol yod//53 kha stong bas/ lce yug yug re 'dun bshad pa tsam las/ 'bul tshan gang yang byung ma 31nga zer ba'am/ yang na de rigs su ma 〈snang ba rjes su drin gsab zhu rgyu yin zer ba sogs la spyod cing / skabs re 'bul tshan gang yang ma byung zer ba la'ang spyod mkhan 81da//54 kha gdangs nas/ slo ba mthong ba/ skad cha yongs ldogs sba gsang med par bshad de yid ches 'thob thub pa lta bur zer zhing / 68dgos sa zhes pa'am/ 99zhu rgyu yin sa zer ba 〈snags skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog pa ni gzhan dang 'gre//55 kha bdag med nang nas/ tshig tshod med 'bud/ rang gi kha la rang gis bdag po mi byed par brten tshig gang byung mang byung mtshams dang tshod med de 'dra lha rwad pa la spyod cing / de lta bu mtha' ma'i rjes 'bras ngan pa bsam yul las 'das pa zhig 'byung nges yin zhes ro/gas la gdams pa cas//56 kha bde po a 'u rje tso/ mgo bde bo tsangs ba skya leb/ kha bde lce bde'i sgo nas gong rim la pad lad kho na 'khrab nas rang don rkyang rkyang sgrub mkhan sgya mi tha shal spyi tshogs kyi 'phung 'dre de rigs la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa'o//
40 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/57 kha nang gi rma/ kha nang du gso ba/ 'gal zla'am/ rtsod gzhi byung ba sogs phyir grags mi 'byung bar nang khul du 'grig thabs yong ba zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//58 kha nas tshig lha snar yu ba zung / bsam gzhigs legs par ma byas par lha nod mi 'os pa'i skad cha bshad pa'am/ byed ma thub pa'i khas len pa serwa gas byas na rang la dka' ngal dang / rnyog dra/ blo 'gyod sogs yong ba de rigs la spyod pa mang /59 kha nas bad ma'i lha khang bzhengs/ khog na dgo ru'i gcu phur lhar/ tshig 'grel/ kha nas o rgyan pad ma'i lha khang bzhengs rgyu phyu dang / khog nang ri dwags dgo ba'i rwa co'i sne la rtsid skud btags te dud 'gro'i spor ldem byed gcu phur dang 'dra ba'i bsam ngan 'chang bar zer/don 'grel/ kha nas chos skad dge sbyor kho na lha nod na yang /sems nang gzhan la gnod 'tshe bya rgyu'i bsam ngan 'ba' zhig 'chang mkhan zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//6༷ kha gnam la gdangs/ chub pho rog gis brus/ rang gis gzhan rgyu za sems 'chang na yang rag rgyu phar bzhag /de las ldog ste rang nor gzhan gyis 'phrog pa zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na phyogs gcig la dogs zon byed ring la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas gnod 'tshe phog pa zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin//61 kha phar dngor ḍa ru ngo gnyis/ kha tshur sa bor phur ba zur gsum/ mi re re'i mdun du skad cha mi 'dra ba re re bshad nas phan tshun gyi khog pa 'dru ba dang / yang na dbyen sbyor dkrug shing brgyab ste rang don sgrub thabs byed mkhan gyi mi ngan la sting tshig smra bar spyod pa yin// (a ma lnga sna khul )62 kha ba mgo thog tu babs na/ rbad mgos g.yab gsig bya ba rang thog la babs na / 'bad pa legs sgrub bya nges yin zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na bya thabs shig gang ltar 'tshol thub ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin//
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 4163 kha sbrang rtsi/ khog tsher ma/ mi kha 'jam khog gnag la zer ba go sla zhing / de 'dra bya rgyu med zer ba'am/ byed mkhan de rigs min zer ba 31gas skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre//64 kha ma zug gong la rna/ ngo yag po ma shes gong nas kha rtsod dam/ phan tshun lab rgyu gling rgyu chags pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / de 'dra bya rgyu med ces pa'am/ de 'dra byung ba red zer ba lta bu tshig grogs la brten nas bsgyur chog go/65 kha tshig lag bas ma bzod/ sdug sgom byed ma thub par zhu gtugs sam/ yang na sdug skad mi rgyag ka med byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//66 kha ma bsres na cham ba mi 'go mi dang bya ba ngan pa'i rigs la 'brel thug ma byas na rang nyid la gyod gzhi dang / rtsod rnyog sogs yong don med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//67 kha yis bshad na lha bzhengs/ lag la bzhag na snabs lug phar bltas na kun shes kun nus yin pa lta bu'i kha bde po brgya bshad stong bshad byed na yang / don lag len bstar dus bya ba chung rtsag gcig kyang sgrub mi thub mkhan gyi mi 'bor lha rwab can de rigs la zur za 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa'o// (ga mdo khul )68 kha la mar zos nas/ rkan la rus ba zug bden 'brel spu tsam yang med pa'i ya la bsnyon 'dzugs kyi skad cha 'ba' zhig red ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin//69 kha la phud na sman/ khog la bcug na dug sems kyi sdug bsngal lam/ yang na nye grogs phan tshun bar gyi 'gal ba sogs byung rigs skabs 'phral lha nod dgos pa las/sems nang nyar rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin// (a mdo khul )
42 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/7༷ kha sha'i pags pa/ gang la 'a zen 'a zen/ mi rang tshugs mi bzung bar sus bshad de rjes su rgyug mkhan lta bu'am/ yang na skad cha 'di yin 'di min gsal cha med pa de rigs lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin//71 kha shas bla ma bsam/ kha shas tshogs ga bor bsam/ bod kyi dgon pa khag nang grwa pa byed mkhan mang po yod pa de tsho la la thar pa don gnyer yin rung / mang po zhig ni 'tsho ba don gnyer ched yin pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa dang / yang khom ra'i nang mi mang po 'du 'dzoms/ byed pa de 'ga' zhig nyo bya bsam pa dang / la la rku ma e thob bsam pa zer ba de 'drar spyad kyang tshog pa lta bu spyod yul mang //72 kha bshad kyi nyi ma shag lag len la mun ba rub/ kha bde pos ngas shes ngas 'jon zhes rgyas bshad rgyus bshad bya rgyur dga' yang / lag len ngo ma'i nang gzhug dus 'jon thang ci yang med mkhan gyi me de rigs la zur za dang 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa'o//73 kha'i de bzhin gshegs bas/ lus kyi sgrib ba mi dag kha nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhes ji tsam bshad na'ang khrims dang 'gal ba'i rang byas kyi nyes pa de las sla por dag thabs/ med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//74 khag la spron sa kha dkar rkyang / mda' 'phen sa bre ser 'brong ka don gnad gzhan zhig la khag btags nas dngos 'brel mdung rtse gtad sa de nga la byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin no// ('brog khul )75 khab sgyung 'gro gang bzang / zhi drag 'jam rtsub tshod blta sna tshogs spyad nas rang don sgrub thabs kho na byed mkhan gyi spyod tshul la zur za byed par spyod pa yin//76 khab brlags dus tsha ge tshig ge mdzo brlags dus sba re rdzo re/ don chung la zhib tshags ru nga ha las mdog byed pa dang / don chen la snang 'jog mi byed par tshos la ma tshos lta bu byed mkhan gyi mi de 'drar zur za byed pa la spyod pa yin//
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 4377 kham bu za ma 'dod bar/ phyur la snyad 'dogs/ rtsa don blo la ma babs kyang / kha nas yan lag chung sar skad 'dogs byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/ bsam blo ngo ma mi lha da par gang dang gang la snyad 'dogs sa 'tshol ba'i bya spyod mtha' dag la spyad tshe r+sha ga pa yin//78 khal khur song bsam nas/ steng rtseg 'dir steng rtseg ces pa ni sgo phyugs la rgyab khal do po gnyis bkal ba'i bar du slar yang brtsegs nas 'gel ba'i dngos po la zer zhing / pham kha 'khur gyi 'dug bsam nas yang bskyar brnyas bcos byed kyin 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//79 khal bong bus khur bar/ rgya lam sked ba na don med/ do bdag nad theg na/ mi gzhan gyis sdug skad rgyag dgos don med ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin no//8༷ khas gong bar bshad/ gong bas cha gad bshad/ cha gas sa gzhi khyab/ gsang dgos pa'i gtam rang gis nye 〈snas la bshad na/ nye lhags des rang gi nye 'khor la bshad/ nye 'khor de tshos sem so'i mtha' 'khor la bshad de mtha' ma gang sar kun la khyab 'gro ba de 'gog thabs med zer ba lta bu la spyod pa yin zhi/ nga / na gtam 'tshogs pa'i snod med sa zer ba dang don 'dra//81 khe la snod kyi tshong dang / dal 'dod kyi skor ba/ rang la 'khur du ma 'khri ba dang / gzhan gyis ma bskul bar rang 'dod kyis byas pa'i las gar nyen 'gan nam/ chag sgo ji ltar byung rung / mi gzhan gyi sems 'khur dang / bsam shes/ rogs ram serwa gas 'thob mi thub zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//82 khog nang me 'bar yang / sna nas du ba ma thon pa/ khong khro bzod glags med pa zhig skyes na yang / rang sems rang gis mnan te lan slog rgyu lta bzhag /khro ba'i rnam
44 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/'gyur tsam yang phyir mi mngon par bzod sran dang sdug sgom byas pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//83 khyi rgan jig khug la bkar na/ mche ba mi gtsigs ka med/ mi la bsam gzhigs dang / phyir 'then bya yul serwa gas rtsa ba nas ma bzhag par tsha 'ded mtha' gcig bkar na/ 'u thug thabs zad kyis tshur rgol mi byed ka med yong srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//84 k+ṣa nyams sbrang bos lon nas/ rgyug ba sked la gzer/ 'go pa'am/ yang na sgrig khrims sogs kyi gdeng tshod lon nas/ gsham 'og gi mis brtsi bkur mi byed pa'i rnam 'gyur ston kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//85 khyi nyal sag gzhu gu ma lus ba/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub na yang sbyor dngos rjes gtsang zhig yong ba bya dgos pa las/ las mjug dang rnyog dra sogs ma lus pa byed dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//86 khyi dang nye na/ rma dang nye/ mi ngan pa dang nye po byas na kho'i spyod ngan gang dang gang yod pa de rang la 'go srid zer ba'am/ yang na gyod dang chag sgo rang nyid la'ang 'khrid srid zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod pa'o//87 4 dang wa mo kha ris gcig gyod ya'i nye phyogs kyis dpang tshig la cha 'jog byed mi thub zer ba'am/ yang na khe gyong mnyam 'brel gyi mi'i skad char bden 'dzin byed thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//88 4 dang seng ge 'dzings ba na/ seng ge rgyal yang seng ge pham/ spyi tshogs thog ming grags dang thob thang yod pa'i mis/ skye bo ma rabs tha shal gyi kha ya byas nas 'dzings mo'am/ kha rtsod brgyab pa yin na/ 'thab rtsod thog ming grags can der rgyal kha thob

dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 49113 sa spyar re pa stsor re'i rta 'o las/ rang thag chod ba'i rkang thang dga'/ las 'gan mnyam rub rkang len mi byed pa'i rogs zla 〈snad pa las med pa dga' zer ba'am yang na yong yong 'jon 'jon stong bshad la re ba bcol ba las/ rang nyid kyis 'bad sgrub byed pa dga' zer ba lta bur sbyod pa yin//114 lhas gab lha yi yul na'ang yod/ mthun ba srin bo'i yul na'ang yod/ mthun tsam dang mi mthun tsam yong ba ni mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba'i 'phel 'gyur rgyun ldan can zhig yin pa'i rtsod sgrub kyi chos nyid bstan pa'o//115 'khyag ba lha yul dang / 'grig ba mi yul/ dper na gyod ya phan tshun 'gal zla chen po chags skabs bar 'dum byed mkhan gyis bshad sbyang byas te mi 'grig pa yong mi srid ces pa lta bur sbyo sted pa yin//116 ga zer song na/ bong bus rgyal khams sa 'or/ 'di ni bya ba sgrub skabs 'tshab 'tshub dang rings stabs bya mi rung bar/ ngang sgug ngang bsrings kyis sgyid lug ma byas na nam zhig 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub nges yin zhes kha ta byed pa lta bu'am/ yang na rang gis brel 'tshab ma byas par rgyun bsrings pa la brten nas bya ba chen 〈sna legs sgrub byung song zer ba sogs la spyad kyang 'grig /117 gang drag byas bas ci drag mi zhig la re ba bcol rung / kho la'ang thabs shes bya rgyu ci yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na mi mang 〈sna 'tshogs nas gang dga' ci legs gros bsdur byas na'ang / su la yang thabs shes bzang po gang yang ma rnyed zer ba lta bur yang spyad chog /118 gang mi yogs ba gdo/ tshig 'grel/ sto chas phor pa gang za mi thub par do ji ltar za zer dper bkod//
50 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/don 'grel/ bya ba sa cig sgrub mi thub bzhin du da dung bya ba gzhan dag ci 'dra byas nas sgrub thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ khyed kyes de 'dra khas byed mi rung zer ba'am/yang na ngas de 'dra mi 'jon zer ba/ khos de rigs byed mi thub zer ba sogs gang mkho skabs bstun tshig grogs kyis sgyur chog /119 go ma chod ba de lab rgyu mang] rang 'khri'i las 'gan sgrub ma thub pa'i mi de la/khag 'dogs sa'i rgyu rkyen mang po bshad rgyu yong zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//120 go kha ma gtogs sa mi shes/ pha ma ma gtogs mi mi shes/ 'brog khul lta bu'i mi med lung sto nga du 'tshar longs byung ba'i phru gu sogs la spyi tshogs kyi cha rgyus ci yang med ces pa'am/ yang na mi 'thom skye shar nub kyi dbye ba mi chod pa la 'phya dmod byed pa lta bur spyad na yang chog /121 go chod med kyang] go bkag rang nyid la kha thabs med na yang / gong rim nas las gnas 'dir bzhag pa yin pas/ brtsi bkur mi byed ka med yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//122 gom gsum slo dbang ka tshig gsum shod dbang] btsan shed kyis gnas lugs rgyu mtshan lha da du mi 'jug pa sogs la spyi dmangs kyi khe dbang longs su spyod rgyu yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o// (khams khul )123 gos chen thang la bting na/ bzo khog yid la 'char dgos/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i 'char gzhi dang / bya rim 〈snags cha tshang gtan 'khel ba'i skabs su/ byed pa po rang nyid la 'di nas 'di byed rgyu'i rtsis gzhi'i gdeng tshod cig yod pa bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 51124 gos chen rgas kyang ri mo'i gzhung / spyi tshogs kyi cha rgyus sogs nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i mi sna lo rgas kyang shes yon gzhan dang mi 'dra zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'am/ skabs re bud med mdzes ma lo na rgas rung rus bzo mdzes chos kyi rjes shul da dung mngon gyi 'dug zer ba la'ang spyod srol yod//125 rgyang na ning log /thal gab da lo langs/ song zin pa'i don rtsa rnying pa gzhi nas bskyar slong gi gyod gzhi bzo ba lta bu ma 'os pa zer ba sogs la spyod pa yin//126 sgra no med kyis sha mi chod/ shes rig dang 'jon thang med pa'i mis/ bya gzhag chen po sgrub mi thub zer ba'am/ blo khog dang ngar shugs med pa'i mis drag po'i dmag 'thab byed mi thub zer ba la spyod pa yin//127 gro ma gting la med na/ ro pho kha la 'i thon/ sems nang gnad don med na/ skad cha de rigs lha nod mi srid zer ba lta bu sogs rnam pa brgyud nas ngo bo rtogs pa'i rigs la spyod pa yin no//128 grog ma 'gro 'gro mang na/ rkang lag thang chus 'dzin/ sdod tshugs mi zin pa'i mi dang / yang na bya byed mang ba'i mi la tha tshig sgrog pa lta bur spyod pa yin//129 thog ma rta thog nas mi mngon/ sngon chad 'brel 'dris che ba'i mi yin na'ang / da lta dbang nor gyis dregs nas kha ya tsam byed kyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//130 thong ba'i ba sha yang da mya ngan zhag gsum/ mi gzhan la chag sgo byung ba mthong dus gdung sems mnyam skye bya da〈snas pa las/ gzhan sdug snying tshims sam snang med bag yangs kyi spyod tshul 'dzin mi rung bar mthun gshib shes dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o//
52 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/131 4 grong ba nye la don na/ gong lar tsher rags rgyobs/ bod kyi grong gseb tu khyim tshang gi thog kha'i mtha' skor du tsher ma rtsig srol yod/ de ni gcig nas tsher rlon skam gses dang / gnyis nas rkun ma 'gog byed yin/ 'dir khyim mtshes thog 'brel la brten rgyu dngos brlag shor dang / pho mo'i 'brel ba sogs kyi dogs gzhi dang rtsod gleng ma byung sngon 'gog bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//132 gu rod ba 'grangs kyang/ zhim blo mi bde/ rogs pa byas na'ang / lhag bsam rnam dag dang kha zhe gnyis med cig byas ma byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//133 gla ba na ning rga /ril ma da lo 'gyul/ 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul rnying pa la mi srid pa'i bskyar rtsod slong ba ma 'os zer ba lta bur spyod par snang //134 glang chen mjing ba sgom po phrom rkyang) rog ma sked ba ltag ba ltag rkyang) dbang nor gyis dregs pa rnams khrims med lugs med rang 'dod ltar byed shag shag dang /dbul 〈snangs nyam thag rnams brnyas ba tshe byos 3rdzog rdzis 'khur shag shag gi lam lugs ngan pa 'di lta bu zhes spyi tshogs kyi tshul min spyod tshul la yid mi rangs pa lta bur spyod pa yin//134 gling bu gtong rgyu dang / tsam ba 'gam rgyu/ skabs rtsab nas mi mtshungs pa'i bya ba gnyis dus gcig tu sgrub rtsis byed mi rung zer ba'am/ yang na sgrub thub thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//139 slo bar ma phan/ mchin ba'i skran/ phan sems bcangs te kha ta byas pa der/ phar phyogs nas go ba log sgrub kyis 'khon du 'dzin gyi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na mi gcig la phan pa'i bya ba byas pa la bya yul des phan par mi sems pa'i khar/ 'brel sku(da mi gzhan zhig la phog thug byung 〈snang zer ba lta bu sogs la spyod pa yin//

54 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/143 mgo thar na dbung ba ga rtsa ba/ thog ma re ba chung ngu zhig bton pa de khas blangs pa'i rjes su chog shes med par/ slar yang gom pa re re byas nas ham pa je cher gtong ba'i spyod tshul la ma rangs pa lta bur spyod pa yin//144 mgo bde po4zhwa mo brlags ba/ mgo bde dran 'phrul ha cang che ba'i mi la skabs re mgo bde drags nas jus nyes sam/ chag sgo 'phrad pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing /'di la zur za dang snying tshims pa'i go don zhig kyang shugs la mtshon gyin yod do//145 mgo ‘ med la/ ral ba'i khral/ rang la cha rkyen med par las 'gan dkris byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang skabs re shes rig gi bya gzhag sgrub skabs so sor cha rkyen de 'dra med ces khengs skyungs byed par yang spyod srol yod//146 mgo ma tshos bag klad ba ldag ba/ tshig 'grel/ lug mgo sogs za skabs sngon la yag po btsos rjes gzhi nas za ba yin mod/ 'dir mgo ma tshos gong nas klad pa lces ldag pa zhes dper bkod/don 'grel/ bya dngos gang yin pa de'i rtsa ba'i gnas lugs ci yang shes rtogs ma byung bar ma shes shes mdog gis de'i skor la 'di dang de zhes rgyas bshad byed mkhan zer ba lta bu de rigs la zur za byed par spyod pa yin//147 mgo ma bton na dbon bo/ g.yog ma rgyug na g.yog bo/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs nang / dpon po dang g.yog po so sor 'gan 'khri'i 'os 'gan re yod zer/ zhing bran la zhing bran bdag po gzhan gyis btsan gnod phog skabs rang gi dpon khungs la zhu 'bod byed dus spyod pa mang //148 mgo mi na bag thi gus bsnams ba/ tshig 'grel/ zhing 'brog khul du mgo bo na skabs lham sgrog serwa gas kyis ldem pa'i yul thabs shig 〈snad pa dper bzhag pa'o//
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 55don 'grel/ byed mi dgos pa'i las ka byas pa la brten nas rang nyid la rnyog dra dang ca bsun 'phrad pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//149 mgo 'og tu/ lus chug ba/ sde tshan nam/ yul tsho/ tha na khyim tshang bcas kyi 'gan 'khur bas so so rang khongs su gtogs pa rnams bka' khrims dang / yul srol sogs las ma 'gal ba khrims mthun/ sgrig 'khur sku(nga ba bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//150 mgo rul ba/ sna yis ma tshor ba/ tshig 'grel/ rang gi mgo rul zin na'ang de'i rul dri sna yis tshor ma thub pa zhes mi srid pa lta bu dper bkod pa'o//don 'grel/ rang dang rtag tu mnyam gshibs kyi bya ba'i nang gnad don tshabs chen zhig lhags kyang / da dung do snang rtsab nas ma byas pa zer ba lta bu lhod g.yeng chen po byed mkhan de rigs la sting tshig smra ba'i gtam dpe zhig yin//151 mgo la me shor yang] 'phur long med ba/ las brel ha cang che bas long khom cung zad tsam yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//152 mgo la rwa mi 'dzugs kyang da rkang la thi gu mi 'dogs/ phan thogs pa'i ram 'degs ma thub kyang / gnod skyel ba'i rgyu rkyen mi byed zer ba'am/ bya mi rung zer ba lta bur phru ster pa yin// (ma lnga sna khams khul )153 mgo las dbung ba mtho ba/ go rim la mi brtsi bar rim pa 'og mas/ gong ma las lhag pa lta bu byed kyi 'dug zer ba la spyod pa yin//154 mgo las rma che ba/ bya dngos gang yang rung ba de'i ngo bo las chag sgo che ba yong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / 'di la ma 'os pa'am/ lugs dang mi mthun pa zer ba'i go ba zhig kyang shugs la yod//

68 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/zer ba dang / yang ngas tshong mkhan gyi kha la yid ches byas kyang / ca lag 'di rdzun ma red zer ba lta bu de rigs kyi lan la sbyod pa'o//219 sngar sprul khra bos srog bcad/ da thi gu khra bor yid mi ches/ sngon chad sna gug brdabs pa'i bslab bya drag po zhig phog myong bar brten/ da cha tan tan tig tig byas na ma gtogs yod tshad la blos 'gel thub pa mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la sbyong pa yin//22༷ bcad khar ma tshang yang / mthud khar tshang ba/ gra sgrig byed pa'i dus su rjes ma zin na yang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su le ma thogs pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / tshig mjug tu zhu chog pa zer ba'am/ yang na nges par bya dgos zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur na 'grig pa gzhan dang 'gre//221 bcad ba'i shul la/ btsugs ba 'dra ba/ pha rgod po zhig 'das pa'i rjes su bu de bas kyang 'jon pa zhig thon yod zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na dmag dpon skad grags yod pa zhig brjes pa'i tshab la dpa' bo de bas lhag pa zhig gtong dgos zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa'o//222 bcu gsum khog rtsis ma shes na/ grong pa'i a pha ga la yong] mchan/ bcu ni phyogs bcu'i gnas tshul dang / gsum ni 'das da lta ma 'ongs dus gsum gyi 'gyur ldog la zer ba'o//don 'grel/ rang gi khog pa'i nang spyi dang bye brag gi gnas lugs la gdeng tshod nges can zhig med na/ don chen gros thag gcod par yong mi srid zer ba'am/ yang na yong rung go mi chod zer ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyad kyang chog /

70 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/don 'grel/ bya ba 'gangs chen po sgrub skabs tan tan tig tig dgos pa ma zad/gzab gzab nan tan yang bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//227 ltags la me 'bar na/ lan la thal ba rgyobs/ mi srid pa'i bya ba de 'dra byung dus/'u thug pa'i thabs shes kyang de lta bu zhig las bya thabs med zer ba lta bu thabs rdugs pa'i las ka phrad dus spyod par snang //228 lcang ma'i bdag bor/ ko g.yog dkon/ ming tsam gyi bdag dbang las/ don dngos yongs su spyod dbang mi 'dug zer ba'am/ yang na rgyu nor gyi bdag po ser sna che drags pas bed spyod byed mi nus zhes zur za byed pa semags de rigs la spyod pa yin//229 lcam sku zhabs kyi phebs stongs ma shes/ bu mo rang gi 'gro stangs kyang zu stor/ mi gzhan gyi lad mo bya rgyu kho nar dga' ba'i mi de rigs la zur za byed par spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re lad zlos byed dgos nges kyang so so rang gis legs par mi shes zer ba la'ang spyod mkhan yod//23༷ chag sgo rab la/ god kha 'bring ka chag sgo'i ngos nas bshad na che shos shig byung na yang / rgyu rkyen gzhan dag la brten nas god kha ste gyong gun de tsam gyi chen po rang ma byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / rgyun gtan rab ces pa legs lhags la go ba yin rung / 'dir chag sgo'i thog spyad pa yin stabs che lha rwa so la go dgos so//231 chags na zho dang ma chags na da ra/ mi dang bya ba gang yin rung / 'grigs kyang de 'dra zhig yin la/ ma 'grigs na yang ha las dgos don ci yang med zer ba lta bu ste/gnad don de la snang chung byed pa 'dra zhig la spyod pa yin//232 chang khas btungs/ jis rig bas zin/ chang btungs nas ra bzi na'ang /don dag gang yin blo la nges pas 'phyugs mi srid zer ba ste/ chang 'thung mkhan gyi mis rang nyid
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 71ra bzi na yang dran shes gsal po yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / 'dir rig pa zhes pa ni dran shes la go dgos so//233 chang mis 'thung na snying na/ rang gis 'thung na mgo na/ bya ba zhig mi gzhan gyis bsgrubs pa la khong khro ko long byed pa dang / bya ba de rang nyid sgrub tu bcug na klad pa 'khrags nas cha shas tsam yang sgrub mi thub mkhan gyi mi nga rgyal phrag dog can de rigs la snying tshig gnad du 'khel ba zhig bsnun par spyod pa yin zhing / mi de gras ni deng skabs kyang gang sar mthong rgyu yod do//234 char thag tshod kyang] thigs thag mi chod/ gnad don che ba thag chod kyang / chung rtsag rnams da dung thag ma chod pa lta bu'am/ yang na phyi rgyar thag chod kyang nang khul du zhib phra'i 'gan 'khri brtsad gcod bya rgyu zer ba la sogs pa de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin no//235 char ba chu grogs/ nyi ma me krogs/ phyogs gang ci'i thad nas mthun grogs su 'gyur ba'i skabs bstun gyi rogs ram gang drag yong ba zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/236 chu skor gyi gnyer bas/ dkar yol la nyams zhib/ bya ba gang zhig la nyams myong dang cha rgyus phar bzhag /spyir btang gi 'brel 'dris tsam yang med pa'i mis bya ba de'i thad la the jus rtsab nas byed mi 'os zer ba'am/ yang na bdag gnyer dang dbye zhib ci 'dra byas te byed thub zer ba lta bu ma 'os ma 'tsham pa'i mi don gyi skor la spyod pa mang //237 chu dkrogs nas/ mar mi thon/ don stong pa 'brel med kyi gnas tshul la rtsod 'ben mang po byas na'ang / mtha' ma'i 'bras bu gang yang thon rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//
72 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/238 chu grang mo btung yang) kha tshig ba/ 'di ni brjod yul mi'am khyim tshang des gang sa ci thad la ma khyab pa med pa'i rogs skyor de lhag bya rgyu med pa lta bu zhig gnang byu snang zer ba la spyod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ 'on kyang tshig 'grel thad 66chu grang mo btung nas kha tshis/ byung 9 zer na ma gtogs/ de min byas ma byung zhes pa'i skad cha tshig gcig bshad rgyu med zer ba lta bur go dgos pa yin nam snyam pa da dung ri gtam rgyud 'dra 〈snad med serwa gas dpyad pa mu mthud 5(da pa zhu//239 chu 'gro mkhan dang / gram ba sdod mkhan/ bod rnying par sa gnas so so'i ljang dpon ni lo gsum re nas 'phos 'gro zhing / yul de'i dgon pa'i las sne dang / sger drag sogs 'go gtso rnams ni sa cha de rang du sdod mkhan yin stabs/ mi ser tsho ljang dpon gyi rjes su 'brang rgyu med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//240 chu char pa'i skyo rogs ma byung yang / sad ser ba'i sna 'drin ma byed/ gzhi rkang phan 'dogs pa'i 'os yod na yang / de tsam gyi rogs phan byed bzo med pa'i mi la phan ma thogs kyang gnod ma skyel rogs zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re ngas phan ma thogs rung gnod bskyal mi yong zer bar spyod mkhan yang yod//241 chu chung 'ur sgra che ba de/ phu na gangs shag yod ba'i rtags/ stobs zhan gyi dgra zlas ngar ngar 'di tsam byed stangs la bltas na/ rgyab phyogs nas ngan rogs byed mkhan stobs dang ldan pa zhig yod pa'i rtags mtshan 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin// ('drerwa ga khul )242 chu rtog rang rtog na/ 'go nas rtog bka' khrims dang sgrig srol nyams dmas 'gro ba de dang thog dbang cha yod mkhan tsho rang gis gtor bshig btong ba las/gsham snyu snyog nas khri/ mas 'gal byed mi 〈snad la/ gal te byas kyang lam seng gcun bde

126 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/567 tshong 'dus gcig la/ lde thang gnyis/ don rkyen gcig rkyang la dbya khral che chung mi 'dra ba len gyi 'dug ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//568 tshong ba la ngo tsha med na/ bong bu btsos nas zo/ dka' sdug mang po myangs nas phar la phan thogs chen po byas na yang / bsam shes med par bzang lan ngan 'jal kho na byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur 'u thug pa'i dmod tshig dang bcas spyod pa'o//569 mtshal rang la bzhag nas/ btsag mi la re/ mi dang dngos po gang zhig yag shos rang phyogs su yod pa de snang med du bzhag nas/ de las zhan pa zhig phyi phyogs su yod pa de rag thabs byed pa lta bur spyod pa ste cung zad ma rangs pa'i nyams kyang yod//57༷ 'tshig ba g.yag la za/ rgyug rdung dra shur khel/ khong khro mtho sar za nas/ de'i bran 'khor la gnod pa skyel ba'am/ pa phar ma 'dod pa skyes te phru gur gshe gshe gtong ba lta bu sogs de rigs la spyod pa yin//571 mdzub mo lnga la grangs ka mi thebs ba med/ don gnad de ni rtogs dka' ba gang yang min zer ba'am/ yang na phar phyogs la stobs nus ci 'dra zhig yod shes gsal yin zhes pa lta bu se rdzogs la spyod pa yin//572 mdzub mo gar bstan la shar/ mi gzhan gyis gang dang gang bshad na yang / de dang de rang yin par brtsis nas mun thom ngang gzhan dbang du gyur pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / bya mi rung zer ba'am/ byas pa'i ngan 'bras yin zhes pa serwa gas tshig grogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'dra//573 mdzo khyung dkar bzang rung rtol rgyud/ g.yag rog bo 3 rung 'brong rgyud/ a mdo'i 'brog khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ khyod da lta'i gnas bab bzang yang sngar gyi rgyud pa mi bzang / nga da lta'i gnas bab zhan rung pha rgyud ma rgyud bzang po yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'i rigs rgyud smra ba mtshon pa'i dpe rnying zhig yin// ('brog khul )

128 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/581 wa gsod ba de/ pags ba'i don du yin/ klan ga'am/ rnyog gzhi bzo ba 'di dmigs yul ga ge mo de'i don du yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//582 zha lu nas byung ba de/ tshong 'dus su bskyal/ gtsang khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ zha lu dgon par yong 'bab byung ba de de'i 'gram gyi gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo zhes pa der bskyal zhes gcig nas phran bu zhig byung ma thag gzhan zhig tu bag med 'o snangs spyod kyi rgyur gtong ba zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin// (gtsang khul )583 zhabs bro gang du rgyag rgyag /sgog gtun gyi nang la/ spyir btang bya ba zhig gang du byas na'ang chog pa la/ da res rnyog dra yong sa kho nar byas pa de ha cang thabs rdugs zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / mdor na bya ba de spyod yul shin tu mi 'tsham pa la zer ba yin//584 zhabs zo mnyam du brgyab nas/ sked gzer logs gad/ bya ba gang zhig mnyam du byed bzhin pa la/ bye brag gi snang tshul 'ga' zhig gcig gyur ma yin pa mngon pa de gang yin nam zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//585 zhal dkar phyogs gcig bod rnying par dbang sgyur pa nang khul phan tshun la rgya gcig gyur bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa dper na/ 66sger pa zhal dkar phyogs gcig ces mi ser ram/ yang na dgon pa sku(gas la kha gtad mnyam du bcar dgos zhes shu stod skabs phru sted pa'o// (lha sa khul )586 zhal la bad ma'i mdangs 'phyo yang / zugs la 'dzer ba'i sa stson 'dug kha nas bshad rgyu snyan po dang 'dra chags po 'dug kyang / sems nang du 'khon 'dzin gyi gnod sems bcangs 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o//
dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 129587 zhi mi zos tshar nas/ skar khung 'gebs ba/ las ka nyes tshar nas/ bzlog thabs byed pa zhes ma rangs pa'am 'phya dmod kyi rnam 'gyur dang bcas khrel dgod byed skabs spyod pa yin//588 4na mar 'tshol bar/ zhun mar dgos/ dper na dngul gsog srel byed par ma dngul dgos pa'am/ yang na rang la cha rgyus med pa'i sde tshan gcig gi nang ngo shes shig 'tshol dgos na/ thog mar sde tshan de'i nang rgyus mnga' yod la/ rang dang yang 'brel ba yag tsam yod pa'i ngo shes shig 'tshol dgos zer ba lta bu'i rigs la spyod pa yin//589 zho'i lung bar/ da ra'i khyos ma/ dper na 'brog par lag rtags phyur ba dang /zhing par yos bskur ba lta bu rang yul gyi khyad thon gtso bo de lung pa de'i mi la lag rtags su sprod pa zhes ga phyi ga log gi spyod tshul de'i rigs la 'phya dmod byed par spyod pa yin//590 gzhas la yong rgyu zho gang / gzhas gos g.yar gla srang gang / gtong yong go log gi bya ba gyong gun phog rigs byed pa la 'phya dmod lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / dpe'i 'byung khungs ni bod rnying par gzhas rgyag lta bu yang mi ser la khral 'gel bar brten 'khrab gos rang med gzhan g.yar byed dgos pas mtha' ma'i sdom rtsis shig yin//591 gzhu mnyen thog la/ sga 'obs/ pha rol po shugs nyams te 'grig thabs byed par yong skabs/ phyin chad lang rgyu med pa zhig bzo rgyu'i kha dan nam/ gros chod/ yang na cha rkyen sogs 'thab jus nan po zhig 'don dgos zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang //592 gnong ba stong bar gnang 7)nga / mdon thog rgyal pham dang thob shor sogs gang yang med pa'i don dag gam/ skad cha tsam la nga bden nga yus kyis rtsod bsher drag po byed pa la don med stong bshad ma byed zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//

dpe kho na bshad de brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 149710 lo yag thog la/ btsas ma/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung gra sgrig 'thus sgo tshang tsam zhig byung ba'i skabs su byed mtshams de gar bzhag nas mjug sgril na legs zhes gtso bo tshod ran po bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ dpe'i tshig mjug tu/ 66gal srid slo bur sad dang ser ba zhig byung na sa zer ba zhig shugs bstan du brjod pa 'di'ang bod kyi gtam dpe'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin//711 lo re la dbyar re/ dbyar re la mu ge re/ rtag par 'char can gyi rnyog dra lang ba dang / rnyog dra'i mjug 'bras la yang rtag tu gyong gun phog pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / de'i shugs bstan las chag sgo de rtsa bcos bya dgos pa'i 'dod tshul mtshon gyi yod//712 lo legs na/ phug ma zhar la dzong ka don chen de 'grub na/ don chung gzhan dag rang shugs kyis zhar la 'grub yong ba yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o//713 lo gsar dang / lug mgo bya ba zhig spyi yongs nas bkod sgrig byas pa'i nang du / 'char can yin pa'i bye brag gi bya ga(nag rnams rang shugs kyis tshud pa de ni khu1da mi dgos pa zhig los yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//714 long bas bltas kyang khams gsum/ las ka de ni 'di 'dra zhig yin pa mi su 'dra zhig gis bltas na yang ha cang gi gsal po mthong thub zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/dpe 'di ni ma 〈snams pa'i mi tshos 〈 sna bde 11 med//715 sha khog phar sbrad/ rti kha tshur sgug dpal 'byor gyi 'byung gzhi lte ba de phar sprad de / de las byung ba'i yong 'bab kyi cha shas phra mo tsam tshur yong rgyu sgug nas sdod pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//
150 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/716 sha ba sgo rtsar slebs dus/ mda' gzhu gzhi nas bzo ba/ bya ba mgo thog 4tu babs tshar dus gzhi nas gra sgrig byed rtsis byed pa zhes phyis drags thag chod pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//717 sha mo tshos ba ma shes/ gri mi no ba'i mgo la/ bya ba gang zhig rtsa ba'i nang rkyen la brten nas sgrub ma thub pa la/ byed pa por 'bad brtson ma byas pa zhes skyon brjod 'khel ba'i lan lta bu de rigs la sbyo sted pa yin//718 sha zhim bo de a 'o spyang gis zos/ khag sprod ba de a ce wa mor sa phel/ khe bzang de mi gzhan dag gis zos nas/ ngan khag de nga la 'khel byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin// ('drerwa na khul )719 sha za mi dgos/ sha khur mdzub mo bcug pas chog khrims 'gal gyi bya ba de'i nang nas khyod rang la dngos su khe phan 'thob med na yang / bya ngan de lta bu byed pa'i khongs su the zhugs byas pa tsam gyis khrims dang 'gal ba red zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//72༷ sha yin na za bde ba dang ka rus yin na skyur bde ba/ dga' rogs sam/ yang na grogs po sogs gang rung yang / yin la min la lta bu'i spyod tshul lung ma bstan de 'dra ma yin par rnam 'gyur gsal po zhig ston dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o// ('brog khul )721 sha sha sha dang / lder ma gsar lder/ ngo chen zhu ba sogs kyi skabs do bdag la ma dgongs na'ang / zhu brgyu tshod byed pa po'i ngo la dgongs nas don 'bras de smin pa zhig gnang rogs zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/722 sha gsar a ma skal slon la/ sto nad ma gtogs gtam nad med/ sto gos kyi gnad don la bsam blo gtong ba ma gtogs/ mi gzhan gyis bstod bsngags dang / sgyi tshogs kyi thog ming snyan grags don gnyer sogs gtam 'dod rigs med zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o// (bye rags a ma skal sgron yang zer )

152 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/729 shel sgo'i nang gi mog mog mig gi longs spyod tsam las dngos su bed spyod byed thabs mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//73༷ —1shod mkhan chung 1 nyan mkhan che/ bkod 'doms byed mkhan dang / bya yul gyi bar la go ming ngam dbang cha sogs bar khyad chen po med par brten bshad kyang nyan gyi mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//730442 shes bya dgra la yang thongs/ 'dir shes bya zer ba ni nyan shes dang bsam shes sogs la go dgos shing / thongs zhes pa'ang skyed po thongs zer ba ltar yong ba 〈snag ces smon tshig gi bskul ma yin/ bsam shes ni dgra bo la'ang ldan pa zu stog zer ba'i shugs las rang gi bza' zla'am/ yang na gnyen nye lta bur bsam shes mi 'dug zer ba de rigs la zur za'i tshul du spyod pa'o//731 bshad ba bu mo dang / go sa mna' ma/ skad cha thad kur shod bde po med mkhan la / tshab byed cig btsal te de la bskor gtam lha nod pa lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / skabs re thad kur khyed kyis kho la bshad khul ma gtogs/ rgyag sa ngo ma nga red zer ba lta bur spyod mkhan yang yod//732 sa brkos na rdo langs/ bde 'jags dkrugs na rnyog dra langs srid zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//733 sa khug khug gi /mi tsog tsog sa mtha' 'am/ byang thang sa khug kyog gi 'go pa chung chung lta bu ste sa gnas de rang la gtso bor brtsi na'ang / bod yongs la dpags na brtsi rin med zer ba lta bu la spyod par snang // ('brog khul )734 sa dngod snyoms nas/ de'u 'bur 'don/ gnas tshul 'dra mtshungs kyi nang nas/dmiṭa bsal snang zug byas byung zhes pa'am/ byed kyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//

dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don nan gyis ston pa/ 16934 chu rgyug shul dang / gdung ma drud shul/ sngar sgya lam srol gang yod ltar byas pa yin zer ba'am/ yang na sngar lam gang dang gang yod pa 'tshol zhib kyis de gzhir bzung bya rgyu las ma 'das zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//35 chu dwangs du dwangs ma nya gsal du gsal sa rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas tshul rnams re re bzhin brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byas na gang zhig bden/ gang zhig rdzun yin pa je gsal je gsal du 'gyur thub pa yong zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//36 chu gtsang po dkugs nas mar mi thon/ rdo g.yam ba gtsir nas snum mi thon/ don snying dang 'brel ba med pa'i stong bshad mang po phar bshad tshur bshad rje gis rgyu med pa byed pa'am/ tha na don med rtsod gleng yang byed pa sogs de rigs la dgos don dang /snying po ci yang med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin// ('grog khul )37 chos lam rim slog gin zhe snang je che/ rdo cong zhi za bzhin nad ba je zu/ phan tshun mthun 'grig 〈snang ba'i don la phan ched thabs lam dang spyod tshul ma lan ma 'gyod pa zhig byas na yang / re 'bras smin rgyu phar bzhag /de bas 〈snag phyo phrogs su 'phel nas gnas tshul je zhan je sdug tu 'gyur bzhin 'dug zer ba de rigs la spyod pa yin//38 ja bkol na thab zangs kha kha/ me bad na dud khung so so/ phan tshun dbar gang dang gang gi thad la'ang 'brel ba dang / 'dra 'dres rtsab nas med pa khag khag 〈sna so yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la sbyod pa yin// (a mdo khul )39 4 lags sku thang mnyel rogs/ sha khyi rkang ba tsho rogs/ ri dwags gsod mi thub par rngon rgyag tu 'gro ba ni mi dka' las che ba dang / rngon khyi rkang pa tsha ba las 'bras bu med ces dper bstan te/ don la 'grub mi thub pa'i bya bar 'bad rtsol byed pa ni ngal gron gyi rgyu las ma mchis zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin// (kong po khul )
170 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/4༷ 'jag ma'i la btsas/ shog bu'i dar lcog la la la btsas dang / de la dar lcog 'dzugs pa serwa gas ni gna' rabs bon las chad pa'i bod kyi yul srol zhig yin pa de dper bzhag pa'o/ /don la yid rton gtad so ci yang med pa'i mi dang bya ba sogs la zur za byed pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin/41 la(ga bar zhabs ra dang / 'chang bar lung5 nyer spru9da dngos po'i rigs la mar 'jog pa'i zhabs ra dang / lag pa 'chang sa'i lung med na mi 'grig pa dper bzhag ste / mi dang / bya ba/ gtam brjod sogs gang yin rung / brten sa'i khungs lung dang rgyu mtshan yod dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / med na mi 'grig zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun chog pa yin//42 nyag kha'i ser ba/ lung mdo'i chu log rtag par gzhan gyi brnyas bcos sam/'phrog bcom bar chad yong sla ba'i sde tsho'am/ khyim tshang sogs la nyams nyes yang yang phrad pa zer ba lta bu de rigs la ñtsa ste da pa yin// ('drerwa ga khul )43 nyi ma je ring dang / tsam ba je zhim/ gtso bo gtan grogs gshis bzang zhig btsal na mi tshe ring po ji tsam bshibs pa de tsam gyis mdza' brtse je zab tu 'gro zer ba lta bur spyod par snang zhing / rtsam pa ni bod rigs kyi bza' cha gtso bo ji tsam zos rung / zhe kha log rgyu med pa zhig yin pa dper bkod pa des gsar 'grogs kyi a gsar gtan nas bya mi nyan pa shugs la bstan sku(da snyam//44 nyin mo'i mi dang / mtshan mo'i khyi/ spyi don nam/ yang na khyim tshang gi don du nyin mtshan gang la'ang ma bltos par rang nus gang yod lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas 'bad brtson lhod med byas pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//
dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don nan gyis ston pa/ 17145 nye ring med ba'i gtam zhig shod/ che chung med ba'i skal zhig bgo ngas phan tshun gnyis ka la nye rgyang med pa'i bar 'dum zhig bya rgyu yin zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na khyed rang gis drang bzhag tshad ldan zhig gis bar gzu bya dgos zer ba seng gas la spyod pa dang / yang tshad ma'i skyes bu'am tshad ma'i spyod tshul zhes pa 'di lta bu la bya zer ba la spyad kyang chog / ('brog khul )46 gnyom chung gi mgo la/ sems chung gi sbar mo bkab/ gong 'og g.yas g.yon sogs su la'ang phog thug mi 'a〈sna ba dang / gang sar khrims mthun lugs mthun 'gro gzo sdod mkhas kho na byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/ bdag gzhan dus gsum dang bya byed sogs skabs dang bstun nas bsgyur chog /47 te po'i nang gi gzugs bzang] sbrang po'i nang gi stobs ldan/ mchan/ 'dir gzugs bzang ni gzugs tshad mtho ba dang / stobs ldan ni 'byor pa ldan par go dgos shing / go don ni zhan pa'i khrod nas cung zad ngo mtho ba zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / rang dang sbyor skabs khengs skyungs kyi nyams dang / mi gzhan la sbyar na mthong chung gi rnam pa mtshon gyi 〈snad//48 gtam kha byang] bris lag byang] mi tshe hril por kha mchu rgyag mkhan gyi mis bshad pa'i gtam dang / bris pa'i zhu gtugs kyi yi ger 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig kho na yod rung /do la cha 'jog bya thabs med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin 'dra snyam pa dpyad dgos// (a mdo khul )49 gtam a phas lab rgyu a mas/ mda' bu tshas rgyag rgyu bu mos/ phan tshun gyod gzhi rgyag skabs/ ngas shod dgos pa'i skad cha de phyin ci slog nas kho pas tshur shod kyin drag ces dngos 'brel nad mi theg pa de nga yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin snang / dpe 'dir pho mo 'dra mnyam med pa'i shan che tsam zhugs 〈snad//
172 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/5༷ rta kha lag bas sgyur dgos/ yob chen rkang pas non dgos/ rang nyid sde tshan zhig gi 'gan 'khur na/ de'i khongs gtogs kyi mi dang bya ba'i kha lo sgyur shes pa zhig dang /btang 'dzin gang byed rang gi lag par 'dzin thub pa zhig bya dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin// (a mdo khul )51 rta rgod khrid na mthur thag ring dgos/ sdong rgan gcod na sta yu ring dgos/ spyi tshogs 11ga gi bya ba tshang ma gcig ma yin pas dmigs bsal gyi bya bar dmigs bsal gyi bya thabs re yod dgos/ de yang bya yul dngos kyi gnas 'u/gas dang mthun pa'i bya thabs khyad par ba zhig 'dzin shes pa bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//52 rta rgyug na rgyug mnyam/ gur rgyag na kha sprod/ phan tshun phyogs gang thad nas 'dra 'dra mnyam mnyam yin pas khyod 'og la nga 'dug dgos med zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin zhing / dpe 'di'i thog nas bod kyi sngar srol la rta rgyug snga rting dang / gur rgyag sa mtho dma' de ni mi sem so'i spyi tshogs kyi thob thang mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan gal chen po zhig la brtsi ba gsal por mngon gyin yod//53 rta 'do ba'i rgyug lam bde dgos/ khab skud ba'i shul lam drang dgos/ bya ba gang dang gang byed na yang / de dang de'i dgos mkho dang 'tsham pa'i mthun rkyen mi 'dra ba so 〈 snar 'dzoms dgos pa yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin// (a mdo khul )54 ltas ngan la blta skyor/ dri ngan la sdom skyor/ sngar byas jus nyes byung ba'i bya ba de/da cha bskyar du byed 'dod gtan nas med zer ba lta bu'am / yang na bza' tshang nang ma mthun par bye bral bya rgyu zer skabs bar mi gnyen tshan gyis bskyar sgrig yong thabs go skon byed pa'i lan la 'grig 'dod med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/༈
dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don nan gyis ston pa/ 17355 ltag mtshongs sar rjes/ shang rta drud sar shul/ bya ba gang dang gang yin rung / de dngos su byas phyin chad gang byas pa'i rjes dang shul zhig nges par ston rgyu yod dgos zer ba lta bu de rigs la skabs dang bstun nas spyod pa yin//56ltag dar mas ltag zug khrid khrid/ 'phrong bre lus 'brong brug gso gso/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'am/ yang na ched las kyi shul 'dzin pa 〈snags slob khrid sbyong gsum gang ci'i thad la dka' ngal dang / 'gro gron 'dzems med kyi sgo nas gso skyong lhad med byas yod zer ba lta bu'am/ bya rgyu yin dang byed kyin yod sogs gang dgos tshig grogs bsgyur na 'grig /(a ma lnga sna khul )57 ltar ka byed gshag /mda' mo stong gshag bza' mi'am/ khyim tshang tha dad byed skabs phan tshun phyogs gnyis gar phyi nor nang rdzas ji yod mang nyung med par phyed ka tag tag ba bo sna bsha' rgyag dbo se zer ba la ñtsa ste da pa yin//58 nyer ba'i ngo so dang / btsongs ba'i rin ba/ dngos rdzas g.yar nas phyir sprod ma byas pa'am/ bu lon mi 'jal ba sogs byung dus spyod pa yin zhing / rgyu dngos phyir song la thob 'os pa'i lan gong gsal gnyis ka ma byung zer ba'o//59tho rang langs nas gang yong] rnga shang dkrogs nas gang yong / 'di ni bon po la 'phya ba'i gna' gtam zhig yin pa ma lnga rdon/ dus phyis nam ma gsal 4stong nas langs na'ang /don go ci yang ma byung ba'am/ byung ma se snang zer ba'i mtshar gtam la spyod pa mang //60 bden ba'i sto zos/ bden ba'i gos phyon/ rnam pa kun tu khrims mthun lugs mthun gyi 'tsho ba skyel ba las/ khrims hre rwa spru dang 'gal ba'i bya ba gtan nas byed ma smyu phreng zer ba la spyod pa yin//
174 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/61 bden rdzun bar na sor bzhi/ skyid sdug bar na gom gang ka khrims las mi btsan pa'i dus su bden pa rdzun par 'gyur ba la tshegs med pa de lta bu'i 'og /skyed sdug ji ltar yong ba la'ang gdeng tshod ci yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa'o//62 mdud ba dgo rus mi khrol/ 'dzir ba sta res mi gsil/ dge bshad skyon ston gyi go gsed ji ltar byas na yang / phan tshun gyi 'khon sems mi zhi ba dang / 'gal zla mi sel ba zer ba lta bu de rigs la sbyod par snang // ('grog khul )63 mdun rten gyi gsar ba/ rgyab rten gyi brag ri/ re sa dang / brten sa gang zer na'ang khyed rang ma gtogs gzhan med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//64 mdun brten sgyi ga48 ba/ rgyab rten gyi slog ba/ de ni 'gal rkyen kun sel ba dang /mthun rkyen mtha' dag yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i mgon skyabs nyag cig yin zer ba lta bu de rigs la sbyo sted pa yin// (khams khul )65rdo chung yang rdzagacog /me chung yang shang 'tsheg gnod byed kyi rigs chung ngu la'ang snang chung byed mi rung bar/ 'go 'bud ma thag tu do snang dang / sel thabs byed dgos zer bar spyod pa yin//66 sdig chen dmyal bar 'gro nor/ har ba bu lon len nor/ jug nyes sam/ ming shas kyi grags pa ngan pa zhig khyab zin pa'i skabs su yid chad pa'am/ 'u thug nas mu mthud ya yud che ba'i bya ba zhig brtsam rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o/ /har pa ni tshong nyes 〈snar te ma rtsa stongs nas bu lon sprod mi thub mkhan la zer//93 sdig bas snum thigs dang / sbal bas tshwa thigs/ 'bu srin sdig pa ra tshas mar snum gyi thigs pa dang / sbal pas lan tshwa'i thigs pa rtsab nas mi bzod pa de dper bzhag ste/ bzod bsran mi thub pa dang bzod glags mi 'dus zer bar spyod pa yin//
dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don nan gyis ston pa/ 17568 sdong bzang la 'bras bzang thogs/ son bzang la myug bzang skye/ pha ma bzang po la bu tsha bzang po 'ong ba dang / dge rgan bzang po las dge phrug bzang po thon thub pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin zhing / 'di la rigs rgyud ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen cung zad phog yod pa ltar snang rung / sgo phyugs dang gcan gzan sogs dngos yod las rgyu mtshan med pa'ang min snyam//69 nam mkha'i bya dkrogs/ sa gzhi'i 'bu dkrogs/ yul mi drag 'bring dkyus gsum tshang mar dogs 'drog 'khos su mi phebs pa 5(nga gzhi'i don rkyen bzos pa lta bu la spyod pa yin//70 nam zla'i bab la bltas nas rgya ni lugs/ gye rkyal bongs la bltas nas za lugs/sgyi tshogs kyi bya spyod gang yin rung dus bab dang bstun nas bya dgos pa dang / 'tsho ba longs su spyod stangs ni rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor yong 'bab la dpags pa zhig bya dgos zhes pa lta bur spyad kyang chog la/ thad shar zas gos spyod stangs la gdams par go na'ang 'grig /71 gnam gron mo 'bab res thang res/ sa dog mo skya res gro res/ sde tsho'am/ khyim tshang sogs phan tshun chags sdang gis gcig la jus nyes byung dus/ gcig lhags kyis ltad mo blta ba lta bur spyi tshogs thog skyed res dang sdug res sam/ dar res gud res sogs tshang mar yong srid pas ltad mo phar lta tshur lta yin zer ba lta bur spyad na chog /('drerwa na khul )72 gnam mtsho la rab dang / thang lha la la/ sngar na ma grags shing / mi srid pa'i gtam mam bya ba se rdzogs rna bar mi 'gro ba zer ba lta bu la sbyod pa yin// ('brog khul )
176 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/73 dpe med kyi mtshod rten la/ lung med kyi rab gnas/ bka' khrims dang / yig rigs/ yul srol sogs gang dang yang mi mthun par rang snang gang dran gyis rtsod gzhi khungs lung med pa zhig bzos pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//74 spro'o la bu tshas rnam thar/ nas la sbang mas kha ta/ cha rgyus zhib phra yod pa'i mi la/rgyus mnga' de tsam med mkhan gyis 'di 'dra dang de 'dra byed dgos zhes lha rwad pa lta bur zur za byed pa la spyod pa yin// (gtsang khul )75 sbyang ke la zhi dang / lug rdzi la bad/ 'brel yod so sor brda lan dus thog tu sprad pa yin zer ba'am/ yang na sprod dgos zer ba/ sprad ma byung zer ba sogs skabs don dang bstun nas tshig mjug bsgyur te spyod pa yin//76 spyang gi la dkar nag dang / rnga ma la sgom za med/ spyi tshogs la gnod pa'i mi ngan gyi rigs la bzang ngan dang / che chung sogs kyi dbye ba phye dgos don med pa tshang mar rdung rdeg gtong dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//77 spyang kes sha za/ rkun mas mna' za/ de dag ni gdon mi za ba yin pas/ mi gzhan gyis bden bden 'grig 'grig gi skad char lam seng yid ches bya mi nyan zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//78 phug ma la sngas dang / yol ba la rgyab snyes/ 'di ni blo gtad dang rgyab rten bcol mi nyan zer ba'am/ yang na de 'dra mi yong ba'i brtag dpyad gdeng 'khel gtan tig bya dgos zer ba sogs skabs bstun tshig grogs gang 'os dang sbyor srol yod//79 'o sha shug sdong mi rgas/ mo phyod rgya mtsho mi skam/ phan tshun sha lan chags pa'am/gyod gzhi thug pa ni dus yun ji tsam ring po song na yang / yal thabs med pas mi rabs nas rtsod lan sprong rgyu yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o// (a mdo khul )
dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don nan gyis ston pa/ 17780 3 yi lcags ri/ nang ni nor bu/ khyu tshogs sam/ shog khag de'i yod na med na e yod nang gi de yod de yin zer ba la spyod pa yin//81 phyin ba 'grul la phan ba/ zas ba sto la phan ba/ las ka byas pa'am/ yang na rgyu dngul btang ba sogs dmigs yul lam/ yang na sprod dgos pa'i chad bun gyi 'jal grangs la sman pa zhig dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang //82 za rab sangs na ri bo/ thigs ba bsags na rgya mtsho/ shes yon nam/ yang na rgyu nor/ snyan grags sogs legs cha gang dang gang yin rung / dus dang rnam pa kun tu cha shas byas te 'bad bsgyu(na rgyun chad med par byas na/ nam zhig gi tshe mkhas pa'am/phyug chen/ grags can sdu nogs chags thub pa las/ 〈sna bur du 〈gang bsam 'grub thabs med zer ba sogs la spyod pa'o//83 bar gyi mi dang / mtshams kyi rdo/ gyod don nam rtsod gzhi sogs gang yin rung mi dpang dang / dngos dpang yod zer ba'am/ yang na dgos zer ba sogs la skabs bstun gyis spyod pa yin//84 bya ba'i rgyal bo thabs dang / skud ba'i rgyal bo ga gug zad/ don zhig sgrub pa'i don du thabs brgya jus stong gis bya rgyu med na ma gtogs sku rwad tshad spyad na'ang dmigs yul de sgrub ma thub pas/ da cha bya thabs rbad de ldoge ga song zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin//85byas ba rjes med/ byugs ba shul med/ phan 'bras ldan pa'i bya ba mang po zhig 'bad pas bsgrubs na'ang byas rjes til 'bru tsam bstan rgyu med pa chags se nong zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / tshig mjug tu byed mi nyan zer ba sogs sbyar na go don bsgyur chog pa ni gzhan dang mtshungs//
178 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/86 bla ma'i zugs la'ang mi 'dug /dpe cha'i nang la'ang mi 'dug dngos 'brel spyi phan byed dgos nges kyi bya ba zhig yin na'ang / gong nas byed dgos zer mkhan yang mi 'dug la/ gsham nas byed 'dod byed mkhan yang mi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//87 dgrar gsum du ba snyag 'dres/ dgun gsum chon thag snol 'debs/ a mdo'i 'grog khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ phan tshun 'bral med mnyam 'a〈snags kyi khyim mtshes yin zhes skyed sdug mnyam myong dang / blos 'gel rogs res dgos pa mtshon gyi yod//('a〈snag khul )88 'bu nag rwa co can la 'brong mi zer/ sbrang ma thig le can la stag mi zer/ ltabs legs nas rgyal kha phran bu thob pa la dpa' bo mi zer la/ stes dbang gi lam 'gro rgyugs pa la 'jon po mi zer zhes pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin// ('brog khul )89 zab rdo 'dril sar g.yang / rlangs ba langs sar mtsho/ chag sgo dang gyod gzhi sogs chags par de 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig yod pa de zhib brtsad bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'o//9༷ mang nyung bre la 'jal/ yang rtsi srang la 'degs/ phan tshun gnyis kyi bar la bden pa mang nyung dang / nyes pa che chung ngam/ yang na blo gros sam/ snying stobs/ shes yon/'jon thang sogs gang gi thad la 'gran zla byas kyang chog ces shugs kyis khyod las nga mi zhan zer ba lta bur spyod pa dang / yang khyod la gang 'dra yod med ngas tshod lon gyi yod zer bar spyad kyang chog go/91 mar khu me thog nas bkag /ko ba chu nang du skyongs/ bya ba gang yin rung de sa de thog tu lam seng thag bcad nas sgrub dgos pa las/ nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud byas na 'gyur ba dang rnyog gzhi dka' ngal sogs yong srid ces pa lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//
dpe nyis rtseg gis brjod don nan gyis ston pa/ 17992 mar khu la rdor dang / tsher ma la no/ 'dang nges yod bzhin du da dung bskyar ldab yang ldab tu snon pa ni dgos pa rtsab nas med ces pa lta bur spyod pa dang / yang yod pa la yod gcig gam/ med pa la med gcig red zer bar spyad kyang chog pa tsam mo//93 mi go ba can la tshig ga jig /rta gom 'gros can la lcagagacig gnad don gal che go gsed dam/ go skon slob gso byed skabs bskyar bshad yang bshad bya dgos don med par khyed kyis bsam blo gtong thub nges yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin// ('brog khul )94 mi chung la bskul bde/ rta chung la bzhon bde/ mi gzhan gyis mthong chung dang brnyas bcos byed pa 'khur mi thub pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon par byed pa la spyod pa yin//95 mi thos ngo thog /rta tho'i sga thog rang nyid la 'khris pa'i las 'gan de 'bad brtson ldab brgyas legs sgrub byed pa las/ zhabs 'dren rtsab nas zhu rgyu med ces bskul ma ga lha(nga ba'am/ yang na zhabs 'dren zhu yi min zhes khas len byed pa serwa gas la phru khad cing / de min mi tshang ma gcig 'dra ma yin pas drag se phure bya spyod dngos la blta dgos zer 'drar spyad kyang chog /96 mi ming can/ rta gdong can/ gling bya'i mi de ni spyir btang ma yin par kun shes yongs grags can mi sna su dang yang nor thabs med pa zhig yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin//97 mig nang gi gra ma dang / sha nang gi tsher ma/ gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi sdang zug bzod par dka' ba byed kyi 'dug ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin//98 pun nag mda' 'phen lha'i spyan/ long bas rdo 'phen klu'i mgo spyi tshogs kyi shes bya ci yang med par rang snang gang dran gyi skad cha kha nas gang thon bshad na/ gong rim la phog thug dang / gnyen nye bar go long sogs bzo ba'i rgyur 'gro nyen yod zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin// ('brog khul )
