242 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/13༷ nye sa dang tshong ma rgyag /rgyang sa dang gtam ma glings/ tshong ni khe slogs len pa'i don du yin pas na nye sa dang rgyag mi 'os pa dang / gtam ni rnyog gzhi slong ba'i rgyu yin pas mi mthun phyogs dang gleng res byed mi nyan zhes sgyi tshogs thog nye rgyang dbar la 'dzin pa'i spyod tshul gyi 'dor len bstan pa'o//131nyes ba can la chad ba ma bcad na/ yul gyi rgyal po de la chad ba thob/ khrims las 'gal mkhan nyes can pa rgya yan du btang na/ khrims med byed mkhan je mang du gyur nas spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags zang zing chags te mang tshogs la chag sgo mang po yong nges yin/ de lta bu'i nyes 'gan ni rgyal po'am/ yang na khrims kyi dbang cha dngos su bzung mkhan de rang la chad pa thob nges yin par bstan pa'o//152 gnyid gung gi g.yag /chang 'thung gi gtam/ gnyid khug pa'i dus kyi rtug dri dang /chang 'thungs nas ra bzi dus bshad pa'i skad cha ci 'dra yin pa bcas la cha 'jog dang ngo tsha 'khur dgos don med zer ba 'di las/ rtug dri shor ba ni bod rigs kyi yul goms la ngo tsha chen po yin par brtsi ba mtshon gyi yod// (a mdo khul )133 gnyen dang nyi ma/ rgyang nas lde/ gnyen nye ba dang nyi ma gnyis ni rgyang ring tsam nas lde ba'am/ bsten na dro zhing 'jam la 'cham mthun 'ong ba yin zhes bstan nas/ shugs las nye drags na nyi mas sreg cing tshig par byed pa bzhin du gnyen nye ba yang 'khon zhing snang bar 'gyur srid do zhes bstan pa'o//134 gnyen 'i gtso/ 'grul gtso/ pha phyogs sam ma phyogs gang rung nas gnyen tshan 'gro stangs nye rgyang de gtso bo ma yin par/ dus rgyun du phan tshun rogs res kyi 'gro 'ong byed mang nyung de gtso che ba yin zhes bstan pa ni/ spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang de rang don la gnas pa zhig yin no//
g.yog brjode med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 243135 gnyen ya ma dma'/ tshong ya ma mtho/ gnyen ya mtho sa bsgrigs na rang khyim gyi gtam don la rgya gang sar phan pa yong srid pa dang / tshong ya mtho sa la byas na gang ltar rang la gyong gun phog srid ces spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyu de'ang bya ba so so'i dgos don dang bstun shes pa zhig dgos par gdams pa'o//136 gnyom chung 'dug shes na/ btsan pos sgul mi zub/ rang ngos nas tshul mthun 'phro gzo sdod mkhas byed shes na/ che btsan su zhig gis kyang sdod gzos mi bde ba bzo mi thub zer ba 'di la sgyi tshogs kyi khrims srol drang nan don thog tu 'khyol ba zhig yod dgos pa ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin//137 snying gtam bu la bshad/ dgra bo'i rna bar sa stsor/ gsang dgos pa'i gtam de rang gi bu la'ang lha nod mi nyan/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i gegs bar dang chag sgo yong nyen 〈snad ces gdams pas na/ mi gzhan dag la de bas kyang lha dod mi 'os pa brjod ma dgos// ca138 snying med sgra ring zed gzer/ 'gram lcag rin gyis nyo ba/ rang la dpa' blo khog med bzhin du mi gzhan gyi lad mo byas te gri ring po sked par phred gzer sogs krog krog dang rgod mdog byas na/ mi gzhan gyi mig la mi 'gro bas don med rang nyid la dma' 'bebs rag pa'i rgyu rkyen du 'gro ba yin par bstan pa'o// (khams khul )139snying rus can gyis rdo las khung phyug/shes rab can de sbrang la me shor ro/shes rab che yang nan tan mi byed pas shes 'phral brjed sla ba dang / snying rus can gyis cha shas cha shas byas nas shes zin rnams mi slod pas dka' ba'i gnad dag kyang nam zhig mthar son pa yin zhes slob sbyong ngam/ bya gzhag gang yin rung 'bras bu chen po zhig 'thob pa la rig (pa (sto ba las kyang / brtson 'grus che ba de gal che bar bstan pa'o//
244 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/14༷ gtam ku re med ba bshad phrol med/ zas mchod kha ma phul za sol med/ de dag ni bod mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis kyi gras shig yin pa bstan nas/ gtso bo phan tshun skad cha lha nod res byed skabs ku re ste kha mtshar bshad nas 'dzum gyis bsu dgos par bstan pa'o// ('brog khul )141 gtam gyi mgo brtsams te/ las sa'i mjug skyel dgos/ rang gis bshad pa'i skad cha de nges par du lag len la 'khyol ba bya dgos zer ba'am/ yang na las ka gang yin rung 'go btsugs pa'i rjes su mjug 'khyol ba zhig cis kyang bya dgos zhes bstan pa'o/ /gong gi bsdus tshig la/ rgyan gtam 'go las mjug ces kyang brjod srol yod//142 gtam 'go 'dzum gyis bsu/ gtam mjug 'dzum gyis sdogs/ skad cha ni mi dang mi'i bar la 'brel ba byed pa'i 〈sna byad lte ba de yin pas rang gzhan su yin rung / zhi dul dga' 'dzum gyis gtam 'go btsugs thog /bar du brjod dgos pa'i don rnams ran par bshad de slar yang zhi 'jam gyi sgo nas gyes 'dzum dang mjug bsdu dgos zhes spyi tshogs mi chos kyi kun spyod bzang po skyong shes dgos par bstan pa'o//143 gtam mchil ma gnyis de len rgyu med/ gtam kha nas thon pa dang mchil ma kha nas g.yugs pa de gnyis slar tshur len thabs med ces pa ste/ skad cha lha stod dus nam yin yang gang dag bshad dgos pa dang gang dag bshad mi dgos pa rig pa sgrim nas stangs 'dzin bya dgos pa las/ lha snar zin pa'i tshig la bskyar bcos byed thabs med par bstan pa'o//144 gtam dang nyag zan drang na dga'/ lam dang gzhu mo sa stson na bde/ spyi tshogs thog bya dngos sna tshogs ji snyed par brten rang rang la mtshan nyid dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba so sor yod pa las/ tshang ma gcig ltar ma yin par shes dgos par bstan/ 'dir
'byog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 245lam 'khyog na bde zer ba ni gna' bo'i rkang lam phra mo rang byung khams kyi chags tshul la bstun nas bskor na bde ba der go dgos//145 gtam dris na mi 〈snad/ bsgug na lhu lda/ gal che'i gnas tshul zhig shes dgos na de dang 'brel yod mi snar thad shar skad cha dris na/ kho yang dogs pa za nas drang po shod mi srid/ ci sgros mol sgros kyi zhor la gnad don de'i mtha' skor gyi 'brel ba gling nas sgug bsdad na/ snang med kyi skabs gzhi nas lha rwad srid ces pa ni nyams myong rgad po'i jus cha zhig yin//146 gtam mdun dang / ba lo rgyab/ skad cha bzang ngan gang yin na'ang brjod yul gyi mi de rang gi mdun du shod dgos pa dang / skra lhas pa'i pa lo ste de ni rgyab tu glod dgos pa bcas yul lugs dang mthun pa yin zhes mdor na/ skad cha rgyab bshad rgyag pa ni tha shal gyi spyod tshul lugs dang 'gal ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o//147 gtam rnams thams cad gdod ba'i phyogs nas yong da mi rnams thams cad sgyug bo'i bu la byams/ 'di ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas lugs la phyogs bsdoms byas pa zhig yin zhing / rgyun ldan phyogs lhung can gyi gling phyogs sna tshogs sam/ yang na 'byor ldan pa la phyogs pa'i gtam spyod 〈snags yang yang 'byung ba'i skabs su gtam dpe 'di gleng nas dbye zhib byed pa yin no//148 gtam la mtshon cha med kyang / mi snying dum bur gcod/ tshig rtsub mo'i gtam ni rang nyid la phog skabs bzod par dka' na'ang mi gzhan la lha da rgyur dga' bas tshig rtsub kyi gnod tshabs shin tu che ba gsal rtogs byas te/ don med la tshig ngan nam yang mi smu zhing / skad cha zhi 'jam du smra ba'i goms gshis bzang po 'jags pa byed dgos par gdams pa'o//
246 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/149 rta rnga tsam yang yong rgyu med na/ ri rab tsam la sbyod shed med/ 'tsho ba'i longs spyod ni yong 'bab la brten nas gtong dgos pas gal te tshur yong sa'i yong khungs med pa'i rjes su/ da yod kyi 'byor stobs ji tsam che na yang mig yug tsam zhig la ljagos 'gro bas gtong yong la 'char gzhi sku(da pa zhig bya dgos par gdams pa'o//15༷ btang na rgyal sgor mi thag gcur na 'jur mig la tshud/ spyir na rang rtogs zhan pa'i mi rnams bag yangs su bzhag na/ rang snang gang shar byed sla ba dang / gal srid sgrig khrims kyis tsha gcun byed skabs dbugs kyang gtong mi phod pa byed pa'i snang tshul la bsun 'byon byed pa'o/ / 86'jur mig lnga ces pa ni phyugs kyi ko bar 'breng thag bzo skabs lcags kyi 'jur khung phra mo de'i ming yin no//1(1 4 rta gcig byung na/ sga gcig dgos/ mi'i 'dod pa ni nam yang tshim rgyu med pa zhig yin/ 'dod yon longs spyod ji tsam chen po chags na/ dgos mkho yang de tsam gyis mang zhing 'dod ham je cher 'gro ba yin zhes rang rtogs kyi sgo nas chog shes bsten dgos par gdams pa'o//152 rta shor yang 7)na thabs yod/ tshig shor na la)na thabs med/ tshig zin go sla ba ltar lha nor ba thams cad kyi khrod nas kha thal tshig thal zugar ba de nam yang 'dzin thabs med pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu tshul 'di la yid 'jog nan tan bya dgos par bstan pa yin//153 lta phyogs gcig la/ mthong phyogs gnyis/ blta yul gyi bya dngos gcig yin na yang / lta mkhan so so'i lta ba dang 'dod tshul/ khe phan sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mthong phyogs mi mthun pa 〈snang srid pa de ni rgyun ldan zhig yin stabs/ rang bsam mtha' gcig tu bden rlom bya rgyu med ces bstan pa'o// (gtsang khul )
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 247154 ltas 3 la rang gsang med bad byur la ngo so/ rang gis nor 'khrul lam bya ngan byas par mnong 'gyod kyi 'dzom bag tsam med pa'i thog la/ da dung rang gzhan kun la gnod pa'i byur dang chag sgo ngom ngom 'phyar 'phyar byed pa ni ches tha shal gyi sbyod tshul lo zhes ched du smad pa'o//155 sto 'dun can la ci yang zas/ las da sred can la ci yang nog spyod tshul de rigs phyogs gcig nas ltogs sla dang 'dod rngams can la smad pa lta bur snang mod/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas spyi tshogs kyi lag len dngos kyi nang kron chung sri tshags kyi spyod tshul ni phan pa ldan pa zhig yin pas/ 'di gras kyi brjod gzhir dbye zhib dgos pa 'dug snyam smang//156 stogs na la phug rtsab pong zhim/ rgyags na sha yi skye sbrags bshu/ mi ni dran shes yod pa zhig yin rung / 'tsho ba longs spyod kyi thad la mtshams tshod med pa'i sems can zhig shes su bcug ste/ rang rtogs rang bcun gyi bsam shes cung zad tsam ldan rtso zhig tu 'gyur thub pa'i 'bad brtson bya dgos par bstan pa'o//157 7 stod gangs ri lta mas mi bzhu/ bya rma bya dug gis mi 'tshe/ dngos po so sor rang nus dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba ci rigs 〈snad pa las tshang ma gcig ltar ma yin pa bstan nas/ dgos med kyi blo g.yeng dang sems nad bya dgos don med par gdams pa'o//158 ston rta sgo nga yin bas la)ma dgos/ dgyid rta rgyus ba yin bas shad dgos/ ston gyi dus su rta sha shed yag kyang rgyugs drags na khrag rgyun 'gag pa'i nyen kha yod pas 'dzom bya dgos pa dang / dpyid dus rta sha shed zhan na yang rgyus pa bzhin du mkhregs po yod par brten shad dgos pa ste/ mang tsam bkol dgos zhes bzhon rta bdag skyong byed stangs kyi nyams myong bshad pa'o//
248 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/159 ston ba gar song ston ka /ston ba'i yul na dmid da ston pa ste chos gzugs kyis grong chog rgyug mkhan de tsho sa cha gzhan dag gang du phyin kyang bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu 'bel ba ston ka shar ba nang bzhin yod na'ang / ston pa kho rang gi pha yul du log dus mchod gnas su 'bod mkhan med stabs/ bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu dkon pa dpyid ka slebs pa dang 'dra zhes zog brdzu can gyi chos pa rdzus ma de rigs la ther 'don dang / dad ldan mang tshogs la rmongs gnyid gad dgos pa'i bskul ma gtong ba'o// (ga mdo khul )16༷thag ring zung gnyis gar bro dgos/ dgra yod med gnyis dar gzon dgos/ lam thag ring thung ji ltar yin rung lam bar bza' btung gi bro gas 'khyer dgos pa dang /dgra nyen yod med la ma bltos par dogs gzon gyi gra sgrig kyang tshogs su 'tshud pa dgos zhes bstan cing / mdor na gang gi dus su'ang gra sgrig yod pa zhig bya rgyu gal che bar gdams pa sbyatsu//161 thag ring gtam de rgyang yang go /thag nye'i gtam de thos ba dka'/ gsang ba'i gnas tshul mang po zhig thag nye sar thos mi thub kyang / rgyang ring ba'i sa gnas su de'i dogs zon dang / nyen 'gan yol ba'i stabs kyis bde blag tu thos pa'i gnas lugs de lta bu rtag tu yong gi yod par bstan pa'o//162 thag ring gi gnyen las/ khyim mtshes kyi dgra dga'/ 'di ni go don nges can zhig gi thog nas bshad pa yin te/ gnyen tshan ji ltar nye rung skabs 'phral gyi bya bar phan 'a lnga rwags mi thub pa dang / khyim mtshes zhe nas mi mthun yang / skabs 'phral gyi g.yar po skyin 'grul lam/ glo bur gyi don rkyen byung dus phan thogs res yong bar bstan pa yin/ de las bod du khyim mtshes rogs res kyi dar srol bzang po yod pa de mtshon gyin yod//

260 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/224 bya mang byur gyi sna 'drin/ kha mang phyod kyi g.yab mo/ 'di ni da cha mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'dem 'ching gi ldog dpe zhig yin par the tshom med mod/ 'on kyang gnas tshul dang cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og tu dpyad gzhir bzung na skabs re ya mtshan yang yong srid snyam//225 byams skyong thal ches na/ khong khro rgyun mi 'chad/ rang gi bu phrug dang slob ma 〈snags byams thal shu par na gces lang du gyur nas mthar thug 〈snal la mi tshud pa chags te khong khro rgyun mi 'chad pa slong ba'i rgyur 'gro bas chung dus nas gces thal du ma lha ra ba bya dbo rwa so zhes bstan pa'obyo//226 byas na byung na yod na gsum/ de gsum gtam gyi tha ma yin/ 'das zin pa'i bya bor phan med kyi phyir bsam sna tshogs dran gso byas te blo 'gyod byed pa ni las kyi tha ma yin pas bya mi rung zer ba bstan pa'o//227 bla ma la mi shi dgos/ dpon bo la kyod gzhi dgos/ bod rnying par bla ma la mi shi byung na 'bul ba mang po yong ba dang / gyod kha mchu byung na dpon po tshor za rgyu'i lkog rngan chen po rag pa bcas gong rim dang mi mang gi skyid sdug rbad de rgyab 'gal yin pa ther 'don byed pa'i dmangs gtam rno ngar can zhig yin///228 zlun bos nor na gcig nor/ mkhas bas nor na brgya nor/ spyir na blun pos mi shes pas nor 'khrul mang po yong ba dang / mkhas pas mang du shes pas nor 'khrul mi yong ba'am nyung ngu las mi 'ong bar brtsi mod/ don dngos la nges pa med de/ gal te blun pos nor na yang kho rang gi bya ba gcig gam chung rtsag tsam yin zhing / gal srid mkhas pas nor na de'i rjes su 'brangs mkhan mang bas nor 'khrul brgya phrag gam/ yang na nor tshabs chen po yong ba yin pas de bas gnod pa che bar bstan pa yin no//
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 261229 blos byed ka bkal na phyed ka /sgang bo bkal na sgang bo/ spyi tshogs thog mi dang bya ba gang yin rung / pha rol po'i bsam spyod ngo ma gang yin la bstun nas dgos sar ma chad pa dang / ma dgos sar ma lhag pa'i spyod tshul sgrin po'i blo rig dang ldan pa zhig 'dzin dgos pa las/ legs nyes dang bden rdzun dbye ba ma phye bar gcig mtshungs kyi rnam 'gyur bzung na mi 'grig par gdams pa yin no// (gtsang khul )23༷ dbang yod ba la jus med/ jus yod pa la dbang med/ spyi tshogs thog dbang cha yod mkhan la shes yon dang 'jon thang med pa dang / cha rgyus dang shes yon 'dzoms pa'i mi la dbang cha med pa'i snang tshul de 'dra nam yin na'ang mthong rgyu yod/ de ni spyi pa'i bya gzhag lam du mi 〈snangs pa'i rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig yin par bstan pa'o//231 gsag ba me'i bong bu/ ral ba khyi'i gzhu gu/ bod rnying par byang thang gi 'grog las byed mkhan dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byas te spyi tshogs kyi rgyu nor thon skyed byed pa po tshor khrel med mthong chung dma' 'bebs kyi bshad tshul ngan pa zhig yin// rtso232———1 ma kha bde na/ bu sku skye sa khungs/ a mas rmi lam dang / ltas rten 'brel mang po byung tshul sogs lha nod mkhas po byed shes na/ bu de bla ma'i sku skye 'gro ba yin zhes bod kyi bla sprul ngos 'dzin sgya lam srol la mos mthun dang yid ches mi bye da pa mtshon par byed pa'i gtam dpe khyad par ba zhig yin//232———8 ma nyes ba'i nam mtha' nas gsal yong / rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten re zhig ma nyes khag g.yogs kyi chag sgo 'phrad skabs rang nyid la nyes pa med pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal byed du spyod pa mang zhing / skabs re gnyen grogs kyis sems gso gtong ba la spyod srol yang yod//
262 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/233 ma byams ba drin che/ ma zhim ba 'og chung ka byis pa chung dus gces lang du ma shor ba'i gso skyong bdag gnyer byed stangs de rigs kyi 'bras bu bzang po thon zhes par spyod pa yin zhing / byams po tshad brgal gyis gces lang du gtong ba ni don la drin chung yin zhes ston pa'o//234 ma med bar a rjer re dus/ zas zhim ba kha la mi rag a ma med par mi gzhan la re dgos byung na/ rang gi a ne yin rung / zas zhim po phor pa gang tsam yang kha la rag mi thub ces rang mgo rang thon byed ma thub na mi la re rgyu ni ka med 'u thug yin zhes bstan pa'o//23〉 ma 'gyur na blo min/ ma khug na sems min/ mi'i blo dang sems ni/ bem dngos gzhan dang mi 'dra bar phyi yul la brten nas rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ba dang / rang rtogs yong thub pa ba de'i khyad chos yin zhes bstan nas dus las mi yol ba'i ngang rengs por mi 'gyur ba zhig bya dgos pa'i bskul ma gtong ba la spyod pa yin//236 ma shes shes khul byed ba mtshang yin/ shes nas khong du thed na skyon yin/ sgyi tshogs thog mi khag cig ma shes shes khul dang / ma yin yin khul byed mkhan 6 rwa da pa de tsho ni rang mtshang rang gis ston pa zhig yin pa dang / yang mi la la shes kyang khog par sbas nas sdod pa de'ang skyon yin pas de gnyis ka bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o//237 4 mi skyon gram ba'i rdo ro/ rang skyon ri bong rwa tso/ mi su yin rung mi gzhan gyi skyon cha che chung mang po mthong ba las/ rang nyid kyi skyon cha chung ngu phar bzhag chen po yang mthong mi thub pa yin pas tshul de rtogs pa byas te rang skyon la zhib bsher mang tsam bya dgos pa shugs la bstan pa'o//
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 263238 mi go med cig la lha nod ba las/ las dka' mo gcig la 'bad na dga'/ bslab bya ji tsam byas na'ang drag skyed mi thon pa'i mi la 'u thug nas tha tshig sgrog pa lta bu'i skabs spyod pa'ang thos/ (a mdo khul )239mi rgan rta rgan khyi rgan gsum/ byas ba che yang kun gyis sdang ka 'di yang spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la ma rangs pa'i sdom tshig cig yin zhing / da dung de'i ldog zlar/ 66a nyog rte'u khyi chung gsum/ byung ba med kyang kun gyis byams 9 zhes pa'ang brjod srol yod//(khamar/ khu0/ )240mi rgyu za bar/ lcags kyi 'gram so dgos/ mi gzhan gyi rgyu nor bag med du ham za byed pa ni rtsab nas mi 'os par ston pa ste/ gal te lcags kyi 'gram so med na pho bar 'ju thub thabs rtsab nas med ces sting tshig smra ba'o//241 4 mi ngan pa'i dri ma/ shing rlon ba'i du ba/ mi ngan pa'i spyod ngan gyi dri ma ni/ shing rlon pa'i du ba bzhin du kho rang rtsa med ma phyin bar du sangs thabs med ces mi ngam la yid ches mi rung bar gdams pa nyo byo//242 mi ngan la bzang bca' ba las/ khyi rgan la sto nyer ba dga'/ mi ngan pa la phan btags na phan lan gnod pas 'jal ba mang bar brten/ de las khyi rgan la lto zhig bster na mjug ma ril ril byed pas de dga' zhes mi ngan la 'brel ba byed mi rung bar bstan pa'o//243 mi 'jam pos 'dul/ rang cab bos 'dul/ mi gzhan la bstun thabs kyi mthun po yong ba bya dgos pa dang / rang nyid la nan po byas te dka' spyad sdug 'khur thub pa'i sbyong brdar bya dgos zhes pa 'di 'jig rten lugs kyi bslab bya don snying ldan pa zhig bo sna/
264 gtam mdzod mes po'i 'al rgyun/244 mi nyan ba la zos ma 'debs/ mi 'jon ba la las ma skul/ mi so so'i shes yon dang 'jon thang gi tshad las brgal ba'i las ka sprad na/ byed pa po ngal ba ma zad bya ba yang yag po sgrub mi thub zhes pa lta bur spyod pa mang zhing / bshad nas mi nyan mkhan la spyad kyang chog /245 mi rnying ba dga'/ gos gsar ba dga'/ mi ni 'dris shing cha rgyus yod pa'i rnying pa rang legs pa dang / gos ni gsar pa yang zhing dro la bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa yin zhes bstan nas/ gtso bo rgyus med kyi mi la gsar 'grogs bya rgyur dga' po byed mi rung ba dang / 'dris pa'i mi la gzhung dang phyi thag bya dgos pa ni bod mi rigs kyi goms gshis kun spyod yin par gdams pa'o//256 mi stogs kyi khog bar me 'bar na/ rgyal po'i khrims la bag mi tsha/ mi ser dbul po rnams lto chas bza' rgyu med par gyur na/ yul der rkun ma dang jag pa sogs rgyal khrims las 'gal ba'i bya ngan thon nges yin pa de ni g.yol thabs med pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa yin//247 mi dang mi 'dra na/ mi g.yog sus rgyug 'di ni gtso bo bod rnying par bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rim mang lam lugs kyi dril bsgrags kyi thon dngos shig yin rung /phyogs gzhan zhig nas tshan rig dang thon skyed kyi lag rtsal sogs byang tshad mi 'dra bar yong 'bab kyang de bzhin he bag je cher 'gro ba'i don dngos dang sbyar na rgyu mtshan ldan pa zhig yin no//248 mi dang zhing la/ skye khungs dgos/ 'di ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rigs rgyud mchog dman smra ba'i bshad tshul zhig yin zhing / 'on kyang khyim tshang gi mig nyos goms srol dang / pha ma'i kun spyod kyi bslab bya sogs legs nyes las byis pa rnams kyi bsam spyod la shugs rkyen chen po thebs nges pa de ni dngos yod do//
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 265249 mi bden ba mi brin/ khram ba brin/ spyi tshogs kyi srol lugs bzang po 'tshol ba'i dus skabs su 'di ltar 'byung ba yin mod/ 'on kyang 'phral sel gyi dgos pa tsam la bltas nas tha shal gyi spyod tshul rigs nam yang 'dzin mi rung zhes gdams pa'o//250 mi tso tso yod na dgod kha slong / zog tso ro yod na kha mchu slong / mi gdong dbyibs dang gzugs stobs sogs ha cang 'dra ba gnyis mthong na tshang ma gad mo lha dor ba'i rgyur 'gro ba dang / sgo phyugs gzugs stobs dang spu kha ha cang 'dra ba gnyis yod na/gcig brlag gtor sogs byung dus bdag po gnyis kha mchu slong ba'i rgyur 'gro ba yin zhes zer ba yin// ('a〈snag khul )251 mi 'dres na skyon mthong] 4gas 'dris na dri zhim/ mi 'grogs yun ring na phan tshun gyi skyon mtshang bsngogs nas gnod pa skyel res byed pa de ni/ dud 'gro las kyang zhan pa'i kun spyod ngan pa zhig yin par ston pa yin/ 'on kyang tshang ma de 'dra ma yin pa ni : mi rnying pa dga' nya zer ba serwa gas kyi gtam dpe gzhan mang po las mtshon pa ltar spyi tshogs thog mi mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 6 rwa da pa'i 'tsho ba dngos gas don nyams ldan pa bstan pa sku byo//252 mi rnam rtog can la/ 'dre rgu sa bor/ gza' tshes skar ma sogs dang / rtags rten 'brel/ lha 'dre phan gnod sogs la dogs pa dang rnam rtog mang po byed mkhan la/sems dogs rjes 'brel gyi ltas dang 'dre sogs tshang ma 'khor yong ba yin pas blo dogs mang po bya mi rung zer ba la spyod pa yin//253 mi mang gi kha de dug /mi mang gi lag de gser/ mi mang por lto ster dgos byung na 'dang tshod kyis mi 'dang bar 'gro sgo chen po yin pa dang / mi mang po'i lag pa bsgul na bya gzhag rin thang can bskrun thub par bstan zhing / yang la las mi mang gi kha ni
266 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/gcig gyur yong mi thub la/ gleng phyogs mi 'dra ba mang po thon pa der zer ba yin zhes 'grengs mkhan yang thos//254 mi 'u zug nas lha la dris/ lha 'u zug nas a bzhad/ bod rnying par bya ba che phra gang ci mi khog tu lha zhugs par lung bstan zhu srol yod/ lung bstan zer ba 'ol tshod kyis bshad stabs don dang mthun dka' bar mi rnams kyis zur za byed pa'i ther 'don zhig yin//255 mi yi khra khra khog la yod/ zog gi khra khra pyi la yod/ 4gas thog gi spu kha khra khra ji ltar yin pa phyi la yod pas mig gis mthong thub na yang / mi yi bsam tshul bzang ngan ci 'dra yin pa de khog nang du yod pas mig gis mthong mi thub ces mi'i phyi'i rnam nya 'gyur dang kha mkhas tshig snyan tsam la yid rton mi rung bar lag len ngo ma brgyud nas shes rtogs bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o//256 mi rig na sgang la bud/ mi shes na rgan la dris/ mig gis mthong mi thub na mtho sar 'dzegs nas ltos/ don gnas rang gis ma shes na rgan rabs rgyus ldan tsho la skad cha dris zhes pa ste rang bsam bden rloms ma byas par shes ldan gzhan la 'dri dgos par gdams pa yin// (a mdo khul )257 mi la ngo tsha med na khyi yin/ khyi la rnga ma med na 'dre yin/ mi la ngo tsha med na mi'i mtshan nyid ma tshang bas khyi la ma gtogs brtsi rgyu med ces pa gtso bo'i brjod don yin zhing / gal te khyi de la rnga ma mi 'dug zer na de ni gdon 'dre yin zhes khyi las kyang 'od par smad pa yin no//258 mi la nyog spyor/ rgyugs la mug spyor/ mi la zas gshom skabs lto chas phon chen po dus gcig tu sbyar ba na mi rnams zhe kha 'o rdzog ste mang po za mi thub/ phyugs rigs la
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa / 267lto ster skabs nyung zad tsam/ byin pa na mnga' ma ngoms par za 'dod med pa chags 'gro ba yin zhes bstan nas don la ldog pa ste mi zag nyung tsam sten dgos pa dang / phyugs zas ni mang tsam ster dgos zer//259 mi la gnod ba'i gtam spongs/ rang la gnod ba'i zas sgongs/ rang gi lus la gnod pa'i zas nges par slong dgos pa dper bzhag ste/ mi gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa'i skad cha ni do snang chen po'i sgo nas spong ba ste ci nas kyang shod mi rung zhes 'doms pa nyo byo//260 mi la mi khyad 'bum 'gyur/ lcags dang ko bar brgyad cu ldab/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rim mang lam lugs kyi dril bsgrags su spyod pa zhig yin zhing / lcags dang ko ba gnyis zad tshad ni kho ba brgyad cu zad pa'i tshad la lcags gcig zad pa'i khyad par brtsi thub na'ang / mi dang mi'i bar khyad ni brjod kyis mi lang ba yod zer ro//261 mi la 'phya gsum 'phya ba la/ rang la 'dzoms gsum 'dzoms ba dgos/ mi gzhan la 'di ma 'grig /de mi legs zer ba sogs smad bshad mang po byed mkhan la de ltar mi byed par 'doms ched/ dang thog rang so sor skyon de dang 'di sogs yod med la zhib bsher bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa'am/ yang na gzhan gyis 'phya bar thad yar lan du spyod pa'ang yod//262 mi sems 'dzin na khab dang skud ba/ mi sems gsod na tshig ka skam po/ mi'i sems kyi tshor ba ni ha cang rno ba yin pas/ dngos po phra mo khab skud g.yar ba tsam gyis phan btags na'ang sems 'gug nus pa yin zhing / de bzhin rnam 'gyur ngan pa'i tshig ka skam po tsam gyis/ kyang mi sems rbad de gserwa da thub ces bstan nas/ mi la mthun sbyor gyi 'grogs thabs shes par bya rgyu de gal chen po yin par bstan pa'o//
268 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/263 mi'i ri mo nang / stag gi ri mo sgyi/ mi'i rigs ni srog chags gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar nang gi blo rig dang / snying stobs sogs la phyir mi mngon pa'i khyad par chen po yod/ der brten phyi tshul kho nar blta mi rung bar rtog dpyod zhib mor byed dgos pa las/ gya tshom gyi spyod tshul 'dzin mi 'os par bstan pa'o//264 mig stos ngan pas/ rgyal khams brlag spyi tshogs kyi sgrig srol dang / bde 'jags/ yar rgyas sogs la gnod pa'i spyod ngan gyi ri rigs rgya yan du khyab bcug na/mtha' 'bras rang gzhan yongs kyi bde rtsa la chag sgo chen po yong nges yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//265 mig ldan kun gyis sdun rig /mkhas ba yin na gzhug rig mdun du yod pa'am/gron la byung zin pa'i bya dngos ni mi tshang mas mthong thub pa yin pas de shes pa sla yang /mjug 'bras bzang ngan ji yong thog ma nas shes thub pa de ni dngos 'brel mkhas pa yin zhes bstan pa'o//266 mis bshad tshad kyi gtam la ma nyan/ rta gang mthong gi rgyab la ma zhon/ rna bar thos tshad kyi skad char yid ches bya mi rung ba dang / mig gis mthong tshad kyi bya ba lag tu mi len par bsam gzhigs dang / brtag dpyad nan po bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o//267 mo ngan gyi kha dang / pho ngan gyi lag khyim tshang gi rtsod gzhi phal che ba khyim bdag mo'i kha nas tshig ngan thal ba dang / khyim bdag gis lag pa btegs pa las byung ba zhes bza' mi pho mo so sos kha dang lag pa 'degs rgyur sngon 'gog byed dgos par gdams pa cas//268 dmag dang ser ba rgyang grags che/ dmag 'khrug dang / ser ba babs pa sogs kyi gnas tshul de rgyang ring sar 'ur grags chen po yong na yang / sa gnas de rang du de tsam
sa khyog brjod med par brjod don gas/la bar ston pa/ 269gyi tshabs che ba rang byung med ces mdor na thag ring gi sbir grags de don dngos la de nang bzhin yin nga 'i nges pa med par bstan pa'o//269 dman sa bzung na mtho sar slebs/ mtho snyeg gdod na dma' sar lhung ka 'jig rten gyi bya ba ni mi so so'i 'dod don ltar mi 'grub pa ma zad/ ldog phyogs su 'gyur ba mang po 〈snad ces bstan nas mi su yin rung mtho 'dod kyi ham sems bya rgyu med par rang nyid rang rtogs yod pa zhig bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o//270 dmyal ba ma mthong na/ sangs rgyas la yid mi ches/ sdug bsngal drag po zhig dngos su ma myong na/ bde skyed chen po la yid ches skye mi srid ces pa lta bur spyod par snang zhing / tshig zin las dmyal ba dang sangs rgyas zhes pa rnams dngos su ma mthong na yid mi ches zer bar yang spyod pa yin//271 rma 'og tu gtam sha /ro 'og tu rma shi bod rnying pa'i khrims srol zhig ste/ mi gcig gis gcig brdungs te rma bzos na/ rdung mkhan la bden pa yod kyang brtsi med dang / rgyag res btang nas mi gcig bsad / ga31da mkhan phyogs la rmas skyo ༷ na ji tsam phog na'ang brtsi med yin zhes pa'o//272 spyon ba'i snang ba dgung las mtho/ 'phung rgan byed rgyu gzhan las mang / spyi tshogs thog mi 'os mi 'tsham pa'i snang tshul bzlog tu med pa 'di dang 'di 'dra ba mang po yod ces bstan nas mi rnams la tshang mas rang rtogs kyis do snang bya dgos par gdams pa cas//273 gtso a pha che yang ka gzhis a ma gtso/ bod rnying par pho mchog mo dman gyi lta ba shugs che tsam 〈snad kyang / khyim tshang nang gi bya gzhag rnams a mas gtso bo byed pa mang bas/ phyi don pa pha dang / nang gi don rnams a mar brten dgos par bstan pa'o//
270 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun /274 btsan ldo ldeg lha' shing] nyam chung gi pha ma/ khrims dang dpon po sogs la ngo bstod byed skabs spyod pa'am/ yang na de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid shod skabs su sbyod pa yin/275 btsan rang tshod bzung na mtha' brtan/ blo rgan la dris na phugs brtan/ bya ba gang la'ang tshod 'dzin mkhas pa dang / blo 'dri gros bsdur sogs bab snying brtan gsum 'dzom dgos par gdams pa'o// (a mdo khul )276 rtsod ba rgyag bar khog ba yangs dgos/ gyod gzhi sogs thug skabs blo chung nga rgyal gyi kha lan tshig rtsub sogs smra ba mang drags na skyon du 'gyur bas/ blo rgya chen pos phar phyogs nas gang bshad rnams legs par nyan nas 'phral phugs kyi dge skyon rnams bsam gzhigs nan tan byas te dgos nges kyi lan gnad du phigs pa rgyag nyad bo sa par gdams pa sbyatsu/277 tshe gang skyed mi 'dod na/ chung ma nyis 'dzin 'tshol/ chung ma che chung gnyis mnyam du bsten na dus nam yang skyed pa'i go skabs mi yong bas de lta bu rang sdug rang nyo'i bya ba byed mi rung zhes ldog phyogs nas bstan pa'o//278 tshes bcu re la ra re bsad/ zangs mdog dbal ri ra ros bskyangs/ tshes bcur ming btags nas sems can smra rwag gcod kyis za rgyag sbyo sted gsum byed mkhan la ther 'don byed pa ste chos dang chos min dbye ba 'byed shes dgos zhes gdams pa'o//279 tshong nyes la dod na/ mi rgyag kha nas mi thon/ tshong nyes shor dus khe gyong rtsis gzhi legs par ma bskor bar tshong zho langs nas kha nas gang thon la rgyag rkyang byed mkhan yod ces tshong rgyag par nges par du khe bzang yod pa zhig bya dgos par bstan pa'o//280 tshong dang bla ma gang bzang] tshong rgyag dus rin gong sus mtho ba sprad kyang de la tshong ba dang / bla ma bsten dus bla ma gang zhig bzang ba yod rung de la bsten rkyang byed pa de gnyis la tshad gzhi gzhan gang yang med ces bstan pa'o//
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 271281 tshong slog tshong gi bzhi zur/ bod rnying ri par tshong brgyab zin nas dngos zog sprod len sogs tshar rjes phyogs gcig gis tshong slog rogs zhes bshad na/ tshong zog rin gnad kyi bzhi zur ri gcig slog rogs zer mkhan gyis gyong 'khur te phan tshun so so'i tshong zog sngar ma ltar phyir slog byed srol yod pas de ltar grags//282 la)nga mo 3ngas gsum brgyab na/ shag po snying 'dra chags/ 'khrag 'dzing blo thag chod pa thengs kha shas byas pa'i nang du phan tshun blo mos byung ba'i grogs po de ni snying gcig lta bu chags thub ces bstan pa catsu// ('drerwa ga khul )283 'dzum mer med bags ba'i 'tshen phyogs/ mi gzhan gyis kha yag ngo yag ston pa kho nar yid ches bya rgyu med/ lag len dang bsam tshul ngo ma rtogs pa bya rgyu re gal chen po yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//284 'dzoms na sgyid theg ba/ dbul na sdug theg ba/ skyed sdug legs nyes ci byung na'ang bzod thub pa zhig bya dgos pa las cung zad tsam gyis rang gshis 'gyur mi 'gro caba gcig bya dbo rwa so zhes/ gdams pa no//285 6che ba/ dpon gyi yon tan/ bod rnying par bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dpon po rnams la shes yon dang / 'jon thang gang yang med stabs cha rgyus med pa'i mi'i sar skad cha mang po mi lha rwad pa dang / rnam 'gyur gsal po mi ston pa 31gas spam rdzu gang che bya rgyu de gal chen po yin zhes bstan pa'o//286 zhag gsum ar bo rgyag bar/ lo gsum bsam blo gtong dgos/ ar las ni phugs kyi yun gnas bya gzhag cig yin pas las 'bo sna ma btsugs bo rwang nas/ khang pa'i phyi dbyibs dang nang gi bkod pa gang sar dus yun ring po'i nang bsam gzhigs yang bskor bskyar bskor byas te ar po brgyab zin pa'i blo 'gyod mi yong ba zhig bya dgos zhes gdams pa car+sha//
272 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/287 zhe ma mthun na/ tshig mi mthun/ nang blo sems kyi zhen phyogs ma mthun na/ gcig mthun gyi skad cha zhig yong mi srid ces bstan pa'o// (a mdo khul )288 za ran dus khung khung ske ring skyong ka las ran dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku/ mi la la bza' rgyu gang yod kho nar rtsod cing bsher rgyag pa dang / las ka yod na g.yol thabs sam yang na bsgul bskyod tsam mi byed mkhan de rigs la zur za dang zer 'don byed pa'o//289 za rogs ngan bas/ 'phya rogs byed/ za dus mnyam du zos kyang / zos tshar nas de mi zhim dang 'di ma 'grig ces 'phya ba'am/ lkog za mnyam du byas nas ther 'don byed pa lta bu dra rdzogs la 'jug pa yin//nya290za e 'og sna/ sgyu ton e 'og mig bya ba gang yang ma byas gong nas bsam gzhigs dang brtag dpyad legs par bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyad na'ang 'grig /(mdo khams khul )291 zas chen zos ba'i gcong can/ mi gzhan gyi lag nas rgyu rngan chen po zos tshar ba'i rjes su mi des khrims med lugs med ji ltar byas na'ang / rang nyid kyis lkog rngan zos par brten kha grag mi thub par mthong yang ma mthong ba lta bur mi 'jog ka med byed mkhan de rigs la spyod pa yin//292 zas thog 'khel na kham gang zo/ las zog 'khol na khyem gang las/ yul srol ltar za ma za sar slebs na za mi dgos rung kham gang za tshul byed dgos pa dang / las ka byed sa/ra slebs na las rogs mi dgos kyang sa sbyag ma kha shas dbyugs dgos zhes yul mi khyim mtshes 'cham mthun gyi kun spyod la brtsi srung nan po bya dgos par bstan pa'o// (a mdo khul )
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 273293 zas zhim po lta 3ngas gcig /gtam mi kha bskal ba stong / mi gzhan gyi bslu brid dbang du gyur na bza' rgyu phran bu zhig gis zhabs 'dren mi rabs nas mi rabs bar mi dag pa zhig bzos yong zer ba lta bur spyod par snang zhing / mdor na ltogs sla tsha po dang / kha snyan tshig snyan la dga' po byed mi nyan zhes pa'i don yin//294 zas mi lag bzhag na je nyung] gtam mi kha brgyud na je mang / zas mi lag tu bzhag na tshang mas kha re bro ba blta bas je nyung du 'gro na yang / gtam mi gzhan gyi kha brgyud na tshig snon rgyag gin rgyag gin je mang du 'gro ba yin zhes bstan nas/ bshad dgos don med pa'i skad cha su la'ang lha da mi rung ba de gtso bor ston pa yin no//295 zas bza' tshang 'tshogs na tshar/ gtam bza' gros byas na lus/ zas khyim mi 'dzoms ma thag zos tshar 'gro ba yin rung / gtam bza' mi mnyam gros byas na phan tshun de min 'di yin zhes lha nod bde yod stabs ji tsam bshad tshe de tsam gyi phyogs 'gal du gyur nas thag chod mi thub ces bstan nas/ don chen yod na nye ba rgan ca dang mnyam du gros bsdur byas na legs zhes pa lta bu'o// (a mdo khul )296 zas slong na ya rabs mi la slongs/ ya rabs mi de zas jis chung ka mi gzhan la re dgos na pha rol gyi bsam spyod dang bstun nas re ba bcol dgos pa las/ gnad du ma 'khel na rang nyid kha skyengs dgos pa zhig ma gtogs mi yong bas brtag dgos par bstan pa yin// (a mdo khul )297 zas la ngo yod bas byin/ nor la dgra yod bas sba/ zas za dus nye 'khor na mi gang yod bos nas byin dang rang la ngo so yong ba yin/ 'on kyang rgyu nor rtsa chen gyi rigs la dgra yod pas gzhan la mi ston par gsang dgos zhes bstan nas bya dngos gang la'ang rang rang gi khyad chos dang bstun shes dgos pa las tshang ma gcig pa ltar bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o//
274 gtam mdzod mes ngo'i zhal rgyun/29no zin dka' ba de tshod yin/ theg dka' ba de skyed yin/ 'di ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyir btang gi mtshan nyid tsam bstan nas spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong dang / kun spyod kyi blo sbyong 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi zhig yin/ gtso bo ni bya ba gang la'ang rang tshod rang gis bzung dgos/ nga/ra gdams pa'o//299 gzu ba gral sgrig sa/ phyod ba ngo bsher sa/ bden rdzun gyi rnam dbye 'byod sa 'di 'dra bar skad cha yin la ma yin dang / snga tshig phyi 'gal sogs lha rwad sa min zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin// ('brog khul )300 gzu pa ra rtsag can gyis bshad ba de/ phyod ba gos ser can gyis bzhig mi chog'dum pa nyam chung zhig gis bshad pa'i gtam yin na'ang / gyod ya 'gyor ldan yin rung /rgyab 'gal byed mi 3rmog ces pa ste gzu'am 'dum byas pa'i lnga don gnad ni khrims dang 'brel ba 〈snad pa zhig yin par ston pa'o// ('grog khul )301 bzang po dma' babs 'dod na/ bad ba'i kha ya gyis/ rang nyid spyi tshogs thog gi cha mthong dang mtshan snyan brlag 'dod na/ mi ma rabs can gyi kha ya byas te tshig rtsod dang 'dzing mo gyis zhes don la mi tha shal la ya lan 'degs mi rung bar gdams pa'o//302 bzang po ming can min yang / ngan ba rtags can zhig ma yin/ rang nyid spyi tshogs thog cha 'jog dang thob thang mi dman tsam yod ces pa lta bur spyod pa yin//3༷3 bzang bos las byed sar/ ngan bas ltad mo lta/ tshul ldan gyi mi rnams spyi phan gyi las ka byed sar/ tshul min gyi mi rnams lag mgos lag ma〈sna bzung nas ltad mo blta zhes mi bzang ngan gyi dbye ba spyi yi bya7 bar rnam 'gyur 'dzin stangs las 'byed thub par bstan pa'o//
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 275304 bzang lan rol bar lo zla/ 3 lan rdzog bar zhogs gang] bzang por bzang lan 'jal thub pa ni ha cang gi dka' mo yin na yang / ngan par ngan lan slog rgyu ni las sla po yin zhes don la bya ba bzang po ni bsgrub dka' ba ngang / ngan pa ni bde blag gis bsgrub thub pa yin zhes bstan pa'o//305 bza' rgyu 'thung rgyu mang na dga'/ lab rgyu gling rgyu nyung na dga'/ tshig zin ltar go sla zhing / rnam kun nas grogs po mang tsam sgrig pa dang / don med kyi skad cha mang po mi shod pa/ lhag par mi gzhan la phog thug mi gtong ba sogs spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod bzang po lag len da〈snas zhes gdams pa'o//306 bza' las gal ta mgo 'brel/ bza' rgyu ma gtogs las rgyur bsam gzhigs ma byas na mi 'grig /de gnyis ni kha bral thabs med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//307 bzo ba rig la ma 'dzims/ rig gis bzo ba mi bslu/ thig rgyag dus las rnyog ji ltar che yang ngal dub la 'dzems mi nyan/ thig tshad yang dag pa byung na bzo las de legs 'grub 〈snang nges yin pa ltar/ bya ba gzhan la yang thog ma'i 'char gzhi'am jus 'god byed dus ca sun la ma 'dzims pa tan tig byas na mtha' 'bras legs po yong nges zer ba lta bur sbyar yang chog /308 ya rabs khog ba yangs/ ma rabs sems ba nag ya rabs ma rabs gnyis kyi bsam blo'i khyad chos bshad pa ste/ mi rnams la khog yangs dkyel che bya dgos pa dang /sems ngan rtsab nas bya mi nyan par gdams pa car+sha// (a mdo khul )309 5 rabs ma rabs ma shes na/ skyed sdug snga lag 'jal dus stos/ ya rabs dang ma rabs kyi spyod pa'i khyad par ni skyed sdug snga lag 'jal stangs la brtags na gsal
276 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/po shes thub ces mi rnams la drin lan 'jal dus ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba zhig las/zhan pa bya mi rung zhes gdams pa totsu// (a ma lnga sna khul )310 ya rabs phyag dang zhe sa mkhas/ ma rabs gnyid dang zod ba che/ spyod pa'i khyad par las ya rabs dang ma rabs brtag par bshad de mi rnams gus 〈 snal bkur sti sogs spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod bzang po rnams la sbyang goms bya dgos par bstan pa'o//311 5 rabs ngo tshas 'phung / ma rabs ham bas 'phung da 'phung stangs mi 'dra ba gnyis bshad de/ dgos nges kyi skabs su ngo tsha che drags pa bya rgyu med pa dang / ham pa ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu de bas bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o//812 yang na stob lte bltas bas shes/ yang na zhag gsum gshib bas shes/ mi'i rang gshis rtogs thabs bshad pa ste/ tshang ma gcig ltar ma yin pas gnas lugs dang bstun nas brtag zhib bya da〈snas par bstan pa'o//313 yul chu 'thung nas/ yul khrims 'khur dgos/ rgyal khab bam srid 'dzin sa khongs sogs gang du gtogs na yang / sa de ga'i yul srol spyi khrims gang yod pa rnams srung brtsi zhu dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//314 yod ba'i thog la gsog 'dod/ med ba'i thog la gtor la dod/ 'gror pa ni ji tsam rgyas na de tsam gyis spel 'dod je cher 'gro ba dang / phongs pa ni gsog rum gyi re ba med pas gang byung de 'phral longs su spyod pa'i goms ngan zhig yod/ de gnyis ka don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i bsam sbyor yin zhes smad pa'o//315 yod bor sdug bsngal brgya/ med por sdug bsngal gcig rgyu nor mang po yod mkhan la gsog nyar dang spel thabs sogs sdug bsngal ha cang mang po yod cing /
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 277dbul po la ni med pa'i sdug bsngal gcig rang yin zer ba de ni chos lugs kyi bshad tshul dang 'brel ba zhig yin la/ zhib tu bsam na rgyu mtshan cung zad lnga rwad snyam//316 rang skal rdo yin yang mur/ rang nyid la 'khri ba'i las 'gan nam/ skal ba de dka' tshegs dang ngal dub ji tsam che na yang 'bad brtson ldab 'gyur gyis legs sgrub bya rgyu yin zhes pa lta bur spyod pa'o//317 rang skyon sbar mos bkab/ gzhan skyon sen mos 'dru/ rang gi skyon cha 'gebs g.yol kho na byed pa dang / mi gzhan gyi skyon bsngog 'tshol bya rgyur dga' mkhan gyi mi de 'dra ni/ tha shal smad 'os kyi ma rabs shig yin par bstan pa'o//318 rang skyon ri tsam bzhag /gzhan skyon shag tsam bshad/ spyir na mi phal che bar rang skyon mi mthong bar gzhan skyon mthong sla ba'i phyogs ris shig yod kyang / ched mngags go ldog 'di ltar byed pa ni ha cang ma rabs tha shal gyi spyod ngan yin par bstan pa'o//319 rang kha sbar mos khebs kyang ka mi kha byar bas mi khebs/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung /gsang thabs byed pa ni rtsab nas yong thabs med pa zhig yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin/32༷ rang mgo sbar mos mi khebs bar/ gzhan mgo la don rgyu phar tshad/ mi de 'dra bar re ba bcol na bya ba gang la'ang 'bras bu 'thob mi thub zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re khyod rang gi kha tshul de las med par mi gzhan la skyabs rogs bya rgyu ni gad mo slong ba zhig yin zhes thad kur spyod mkhan yang yod//321 rang rgyu sman dang / mi rgyu dug rang gi rgyu nor chud zos su mi gtong ba bdag gces legs par byed dgos pa dang / mi gzhan gyi rgyu nor khab skud tsam yang ham len ped spyod rtsab nas byed mi nyan pa de gnyis sman dang / dug ltar blta dgos zhes mi'i kun spyod kyi gnad che sa zhig gsal por bstan pa'o//
278 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/322 rang rgyud la dab blangs nas/ gzhan rgyud la bsam shes gyis/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung / rang la byung na ji ltar 'gyur bsam blo btang thog /gzhi nas de la gzhigs te gzhan gyi bde sdug la bsam gzhigs byed thub na spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod dang mthun pa zhig 'ong bar gdams pa'o//323 rang thag rang gis chod kyang] dbon thag g.yog gis mi chod/ dpon g.yog gi khyad par la spyod pa ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi gzhung don nam/ thun mong gi spyi don la spyad kyang chog la/ skabs re byed 'dod med pa'i khag 'dogs la spyod mkhan yang yod/324 rang med bzo bar rogs mi dgos/ rang srog gcod bar gri mi dgos/ rang gis rang brlag par byed pa ni/ bya ba thams cad kyi nang nas sgrub sla lha rdzas shig yin par nyagazhan gyi rogs ram sdu gigs 'tshol mi dgos zhes ldog phyogs nas dpe dang bcas bstan te rang gis rang gcun rgyu 'di ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba legs sgrub yong ba'i rmang gzhi yin par gdams pa'o//325 rang tshod mi zin/ gzhan tshod 'dzin rgyu/ kho rang gi tshod kyang kho rang gis bzung mi thub pa la/ mi gzhan la tshod 'dzin byed rogs bya rgyu zer ba ni gad mo slong ba zhig red ces pa lta bur spyod pa'o//326 rang yul rgyab tu phyur/ mi yul bang du blangs/ sngon chad sdug bsngal chen po myangs pa'i tshul bgrang ba'am/ yang na spyi don la dka' ngal mang po spyad pa'i yus bgrang ba lta bu'i skabs spyod pa yin//327 rang rang gtsang ka mi mi gtsang] 'di ni kha dang zhwa gos lham gsum sogs mi gzhan dang ma 'dres pa bya dgos par gdams pa yin zhing / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi skye khungs mtho dman dang rigs rus gtsang btsog sogs smra bar dgag pa rgyag pa'i
'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 279zur za zhig yin pa ma zad/ deng rabs 'phrod bsten gyi blang bya tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig kyang yin snyam re(//328 rang la blo yod na/ mi la mig yod/ rang so sor blo dang jus yod par rloms mkhan tshor/ mi gzhan la yin min blta byed kyi mig gsal 〈sna ji snyed cig 〈snad pa de brjed mi rung zhes nan po'i sgo nas gdams pa'o//329 rang lus la gces dgos/ rang sems la dbyad dgos/ mis rang gi gzugs po bde thang rgyun 'khyongs yong ba'i don du gces smras bya dgos shing / 'on kyang rang gi sems la dran tshad yang dag pa gtan nas ma yin pas nges par du sgam nan gyi thog nas dpyad pa yang yang byas te brdar sha gcod dgos par gdams pa'o//33༷ rang lus la bltas nas/ gzhan lus la bshad ba rgyobs/ thog mar rang nyid la tshur bltas 〈snag /gzhi nas mi gzhan gyi gnas lugs lha nod da〈snas zhes pa 'di ni spyi tshogs kun spyod kyi blo sbyong phan nus ldan pa zhig go/ 9331 4ri mtho na kha ba dgrar yang wob/ klung dma' na ljang ba dgun yang skye/ phyi rol yul gyi dngos po'i cha rkyen ni ha cang chen po yin/ khor yug gi mthun rkyen 'dzoms na 'jig rten du yongs grags kyi gnas lugs las brgal ba'i don gnad ngo mtshar can gang yang sgrub srid par bstan pa 'di ni dmangs khrod kyi dngos gtso'i lta ba bab chags pa zhig yin nyo sna//332 rig ba dwangs na/ ngo tshul nag kyang nag nang shes rig gi me long dwangs gsal ldan na/ phyi ngo tshul nag pa ste gzhan gyi snang ngor mi mjes kyang skyon med ces phyi tshul las nang rig gal che bar ston pa'o//

'khyog brjod med par brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 281339 las tshan shig la/ bza' sgo phro ma/ bod rnying par dbang sgyur pa'i 'og gi las byed chung rtsag tshos kyang / rang rang gi ming thob la dpags pa'i mi ser gyi lag nas za bed 'phrog len byed pa de ni lugs mthun yin par brtsiba'i srol ngan de mtshon pa yin no//340 las la byas yus che na/ ngo so chung] bya ba gang sgrub na'ang byas yus bgrang mi rung bar bstan zhing / mi la las bya ba phran brtseg tsam bsgrubs par dka' ngal che tshul mang po shod dus dngos su gong dpe drangs nas skyon brjod byed mkhan yang yod do//341 legs ba brgya la skor phyogs/ nyes ba brgya la zlog thabs/ 'gal rkyen sel thabs sam/ mthun rkyen sgrub thabs sogs gang zhig gnang 'os yod na yang / khyed rang nas gnang rogs gnang zhes pa lta bur spyod pa'i yid ches blos 'gel gyi rnam pa mtshon pa zhig yin//342 lo brgya yon ba'i mi dkon yang ka lo khri song ba'i gtam bsdad yod/ mi'i tshe tshad ni ring po ma yin rung / mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rim gyi gtam rgyud kyi dus yun ha cang ring po'i gong nas rim bzhin bzhag yod ces lo rgyus la shes rtogs bya dgos par bstan pa'o//343 lo nyes lo gcig /gtam ngan tshe gcig lo nyes sam tshong nyes sogs dpal 'byor thog gi gyod gun ni thengs gcig tsam las/ rtag par jus nyes mi srid cing /sgyi tshogs thog yongs su grags pa'i gtam ngan ni mi tshe hril po gcig la dag thabs med ces bstan nas rgyu nor khe phan gyi don du kun spyod bzang po blos gtong ba'i rigs gtan nas bya mi nyan zhes gdams pa cas//344 long ba mthong rgya rgod/ 'on ba thos rgya che/ de ni rang gis mthong ma thub pa dang /thos ma thub par brten ci 'dra yin nam snyam pa'i bsam blor shes 'dod chen po yod
