290 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/bzos na gnas tshang gi bdag pos brtsad 'tshol lam/ yang na 'gan 'khri gang yod 'khur dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//15 khyed kyis ma mthong shes bya mang / bong bus ma phyin lam 'drang mang / dpe bong bus 'gro ma myong ba'i lam kha da dung yod pa de bzhin du/ don khyed kyis ma shes pa'i shes bya de bas mang po yod ces dpe don sbyar te thos chung rang rloms can tshor zur za byed par spyod pa yin no//16 khra chung mig la rdul/ dam ba'i chos la rdzun/ dpe khra chung mig la rdul 'gro sa med pa bzhin du/ don dam pa'i chos la rdzun 'gro sa med ces dpe don sbyar nas tshul 'chos mkhan la zur za byed par spyod pa'o//nya17 khrims rig shang gnyis de drang dgos/ rgyan ri mo gnyis de ma sa dgos/ dngos po so sor nges par ldan dgos pa'i mtshan nyid re yod de dper na rgyan dang ri mo yin phyin nges par mdzes po dgos pa bzhin du/ don khrims dang thig shing gnyis de nges par du drang po zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te gtso bo khrims zhes pa de'i mtshan nyid ni mtha' gcig tu drang po dgos pa de rang yin/ gal srid de dang mi ldan na khrims ma yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang //15 khrims sa'i tshig dang / gong ba'i khab/ gong bar 'dzer ba'i khab bzhin du/ khrims sar bshad pa'i tshig de bor brlag 'gro sa med ces dpe don sbyar nas khungs skyel ra sprod dgos zer bar spyod pa yin//19 khrel phyi thag ring ba'i phrogs bo dkon/ khe drang bor shod ba'i tshong ba dkon/ dpe ma gnad 'di tsam dang khe bzang 'di tsam byung zhes drang por lha bod mkhan gyi tshong pa shin tu dkon pa de bzhin du/ khrel dang phyi thag ring por brtsi ba'i nam yang mi bslu mkhan gyi
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 291grogs po yang ha cang dkon po yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas su la'ang yid rton che drags pa bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o//2༷ gal bo che la nan tan/ dam ba'i chos la brgya tshar/ dpe chos lugs kyi gzungs sngags dang cho ga sogs la brgya tshar dang stong tshar sogs dgos pa de bzhin du/ don gal che'i rigs la sla bcos ma yin par gzab nan tan tig gi yang bskor bskyar bskor bya dgos zhes dpe don spyar te gdams pa'o//21 gos gong ba med na bzo las/ tshig rnga ma med na bshad gso/ dpe gos la gong ba med na bzo 'phro yin pa bzhin du/ skad cha la tshig mjug med na bshad 'phror brtsi ba los yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas skad cha lha snad skabs nges par du tshig mjug cha tshang ba zhig 〈snang ba bya dbo rwa so zhes bstan pa'o// (a ma lnga sna khul )22 phyod kyi sdong po/ rnag gi 'thum bu/ dpe zug gzer gyi 'byung gzhi rnag gi 'thum bu la thug pa de bzhin du/ don gyod kyi sdong po'am rtsab gang la thug yod pa brtsad gcod dgos zer ba'am/ yang na 'di la thug yod zer ba lta bu de rigs la spyod pa yin//('drerwa ga khul )23 rma byas dug 'ju/ grwa bas dkor 'ju/ dpe rma byas dug zos kyang 'ju nas mi gnod pa bzhin du/ don grwa pa rnams kyis dkor te dad ldan gyis bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i dngos rdzas rnams 'ju thub ces grwa pas dkor za ba de 'os pa yin tshul gya tshom du smra ba'am/ yang na grwa pa 'di tsho dkor ji tsam zos kyang rgyags rgyu mi 'dug ces ldog nas zur za byed pa'i dpe don sbyar ba'o//24 gri rdo med lag la gzan/ gtam don med rna bar gzan/ dpe rno po med pa'i gri de lag par gzan pa bzhin du/ lnga don dbo tshes med phan pa ma mchis pa'i skad cha mang po de
292 gtam mdzod mes po'i 'al rgyur/mi'i rna bar gzhan las gzan pa yod ces dpe don sbyar nas/ rgyu mtshan dang dgos dom med pa'i gtam nyog gi rigs 'di nam yang lha nod rgyu tsho med ces bstan pa'o//25 dga' bo dngon srid/ zhim po skyug srid/ dpe zas zhim po ci 'dra zhig yin rung zos drags na skyugs srid pa bzhin du/ don phan tshun dga' po byed pa'ang dga' tshod ma zin na nam zhig 'khon pa'ang yong srid ces spyir 'jig rten gyi bya bar nges brtan med pa'i dpe don sbyar te/ gtso bo gang dang gang yin rung tshad las brgal na ldog phyogs su 'gyur 'gro ba'i bya dngos kyi chos nyid bstan pa'o//26 dge bshes lags dang rtsod ba/ ka ba lags dang rdung ga dpe khang pa'i ka bar rdung ga rgyag pa bzhin du/ don dge bshes lags te rtog ge smra ba dang rtsod pa rgyag pa de ni 9 pham kha 'phel rgyu las med ces dpe don sbyar nas mi kha bde po dang mnyam du don med kyi gtam la rtsod 'then bya mi rung zhes gdams pa'o//27 dgra kha gzhom che na 'grig 'dod/ 'brug 'ur sgra che na than rtags/ dpe dbyar dus 'brug sgra drag po sgrog pa de gnam dwangs nas than pa ston pa'i rtags mtshan yin pa bzhin du/ don dgra phyogs nas 'phyar rgyag gi 'bor shog chen po byed pa de yang snying 'dum 'grig byed 'dod kyi rtags yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas dgra bo'i 'ur gshom byed par skrag mi rung bar bstan pa'o// ('brog khul )28 mgar ba rang gi ral gris bsad/ pha ma rang gi bu yis mnag dpe mgar ba rang gis bzos pa'i ral sgras rang bsad pa bzhin du/ don pha ma rang gis gserwa so pa'i bu phrug gis rang nyid sdug bsngal myong du 'jug mkhan yod ces dpe don sbyar nas/ pha mas bu phrug gso skyong dang sbyong brdar bya rgyu byams sdang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar ran par skyong dgos zhes bstan pa'o//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 29329 'grul ba dgong slebs sdod ba'i rtags/ kha ba zhogs babs 'gro ba'i rtags/ dpe 'grul pa dgong dro slebs na do nub yul der zhag pa byas te sdod pa'i rtags gsal po bstan pa de bzhin du/ don zhogs pa kha ba 'bab pa de ni sprin pa 'gro ba ste nam mkha' dwangs pa'i snga ltas yin zhes sa mtho'i gnas gshis 'gyur tshul gyi nyams myonge brjod pa yin no//30 rgan bas gang byed gzhon bas byed/ gla ba'i phru gu brag la 'dzegs/ dpe gla ba'i phru gu brag la 'dzigs pa bzhin du/ rgan pas ji ltar byed pa de bzhin gzhon pa tshos byed pa yin zhes bstan nas/ rgan rabs tshos kun spyod bzang po rgyun 'khyongs byas te mi rabs rjes ma tshor mig dpe 'jog rgyu de spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod dar 'phel yong ba'i 'gag rtsa zhig yin par bstan pa'o//31 rgya la 'tho bar rgyu dgos/ rgyu ma skyong bar khrag dgos/ dpe bza' bya'i phyugs kyi rgyu ma skyong ba la khrag dgos pa bzhin du/ don rgya gar rgya nag sogs thag ring yul gru chen por 'gro ba la rgyu nor dgos pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas spyi tshogs thog bya ba gang zhig byed na ya nga / de gtso bor dpal 'byor gyi tsho cha rkyen la brten dgos par bstan pa'o//32 rgyal kha blon bos sgyur/ rta kha srab kyis sgyur/ dpe rta'i kha lo srab kyis sgyur ba de bzhin du/ don rgyal po'i kha lo yang blon pos sgyur gyin yod ces dpe don sbyar te rgyal po 'dod yon la g.yengs nas gnas lugs ci yang mi shes par brten/ skabs dang bstun nas/ blon pos rang 'dod ltar rgyal srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin pa yin par bstan pa'o//33 rgyal khams pho gyed mo phyed/ lung spru na)da chu byed/ dpe lung pa gang sar sdu dang chu phran phyed 'dres yin pa bzhin du/ don rgyal khams te sgyi tshogs thog skyes pa dang
294 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/bud med phyed 'dres yin zhes dpe sbyar nas/ dga' rogs gnyen ya gang nas gdam na'ang rnyed thub pa yin zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//34 rgyal po chags bar ga bangs/ bya chags bar shing ka dpe shing sdong med na bya rigs chags sa brten sa med pa bzhin du/ don chab 'bangs med na rgyal po chags sa med ces dpe don sbyar te rgyal pos nges par 'bangs kyi 'tsho skyong la bsam gzhigs bya rgyu ni / rang nyid chags 'jig la thug pa'i gnad don zhig yin par bstan pa'o//35 4 rgyal po chags ba'i rten dang / 〉'u rang dngor ba'i yos/ 'dir bshad pa'i rgyal po ni dregs pa sde brgyad kyi gras lha 'dre'i nang gi rgyal po zer bar go dgos/ dpe the'u rang zer ba'i 'dre de 'khor ba la yos khra ste nas 'bru sreg ma gtor dgos pa bzhin du/nya rgyal btsan chags pa la rten mkhar dgos pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar zhing / skabs re mi ser rnams gnas dgos na sa zhing sgo phyugs sku(gas med thabs med zer ba lta bu la'ang spyod srol yod do//36 rgyal po ri bka' khrims nor gyis bshig /sgom chen phyag rgya shag gis bzhig dpe sgom chen sgom rgyag pa'i lus kyi phyag rgya de shig gis zos nas bshig pa bzhin du/ don rgyal po'i bka' khrims ji ltar btsan na'ang rgyu nor lkog rngan gyis bshig mi thub pa med ces dpe don sbyar nas/ sgyi tshogs lam lugs ci 'dra zhig la'ang rgyu rngan la mgo mi sgur ba'i khrims dpon zhig mthong dkon par bstan pa'o//37 rgyal po'i bka' dang ri gzar rbab/ dpe ri gzar po'i ngos las thur du 'gril ba'i rbab rdo bzhin du/ don rgyal po'i bka' yang phab zin pa'i rjes su bden rdzun nam don dngos dang mthun mi mthun la ma bltos par rgyu mtshan bshad de bka' 'gog byed sa med ces ha cang btsan po yin pa'i don sbyar ba'o//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 29538 rgyu gab ba sa rgyal po'i bang mdzod/ chu lab ba sa lung pa'i sum mdo/ dpe ri g.yas g.yon gyi chu phran thams cad 'bab sa de lung pa'i sum mdor yin pa de bzhin du/ don mi ser gyi rgyu nor thams cad mtha' ma'i 'bab sa de rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyi nang du yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas bstan pa'o//39 rgyu med gshom la dga'/ da dig bshad la dga'/ dpe ngag da dig can gyi mi de skad cha bshad rgyur dga' ba de bzhin du/ don rgyu nor med pa'i mi de rgyas ga 9 rwa smra bya rgyur dga' po yod ces dpe sbyar nas/ rang gi dpal 'byor dang mi 'tsham pa'i ga lha rnam ra bya mi nyan zhes gdams pa cas//4༷ rgyu ma rlon ba gris mi chod/ le lo can gyis las mi tshar/ dpe nor phyugs kyi rgyu ma rlon pa gri yis mi chod pa de dang 'dra bar/ don mi le lo can gyi las ka la tshar ba'i dus med ces dpe don sbyar te/ bya las gang yin rung dus thog legs sgrub byed dgos par bstan pa'o// 941 sgog bar zug na sgog dri 'jags/ bad bar 'grogs na spyod ngan 'go dpe gog pa la reg na sgog dri rang bzhin gyis 'jags pa bzhin du/ don skye bo ngan pa dang 'grogs na de'i spyod tshul ngan pa rnams ched du ma bslabs kyang shugs kyis 'go ba yin pas grogs po ngan pa rgyang ring du spong dgos par gdams pa'o//42 ngan bas rang bstod/ rul mas bu bstod/ dpe a ma rang shed can gyis rang gi bu la ngo bstod byed pa de bzhin du/ don mi ngan gyis rang gis rang la bstod pa byed pa zhes dpe don sbyar nas de dag ni ngo tsha med pa'i rang gshis yin pas/ mi rnams zhe nas khrel dgos pa zhig yin par bstan te gang dang gang la'ang khengs skyungs bag yod kyi spyod tshul skyo steng dgos par bstan pa'o// (mdo khams khul )
296 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/43 ngan bas rang bstod/ pa tas slo bstod/ dpe bya khwa tas rang gi sgro la bstod pa de bzhin du rang gis rang la bstod pa byed pa ni skye bo ngan pa'i rang rtags phyir mngon pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ mi gzhan la bkur sti gus 'bas/ kyi goms gshis mtshon nga/ yin//44 bcad pa'i sdong po skye mi shub ba dang / mnan ba'i dgra bo langs mi chub ba zhigdpe bcad zin pa'i shing sdong po de nam yang skye mi 4thub pa zhig bzo dgos pa de bzhin du/don mar mnan zin pa'i dgra bo de dus gtan du yar langs mi thub pa zhig bzo dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ lan gcig pham par byas pa'i dgra bo de gal srid yar langs pa yin na rang nyid la 'khon lan drag po zhig slog nges yin zhes gdams pa'o/ /45 chang lan chu 'jal/ bzang lan ngan 'jal/ dpe chang gi lan chu yis 'jal ba bzhin du/ don phar la bzang po byas pa'i lan la tshur ngan gnod bskyal ba zhes dpe don sbyar nas tha shal gyi spyod tshul de lta bu nam yang mi bya bar gdams pa yi na zhing / yang skabs re phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byas byung zer ba lta bu de rigs la dpe nyis rtseg gi tshul du spyad na'ang 'grig go/46 char sne rlung khrid/ dgra sne gnyen khrid/ dpe char gyi sna rlung gis khrid pa bzhin du/don dgra bo'i sna gnyen gyis khrid pa zhes dpe don sbyar nas de ni gzhan las thabs rdugs pa zhig dang / snying na ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o//47 chu rka nang du mi tshud spru dang / mi khrims 'og tu mi 'dus pa/ dpe chu chu rka'i nang du mi tshud pa med pa de bzhin du/ don mi su yin na'ang khrims lugs kyi 'og tu mi 'dus pa med ces dpe don sbyar te/ khrims lugs ni spyi tshogs bde 'jags su 'god pa'i thabs mchog bla rlo ma mchis pa zhig yin par bltam/ che btsan ci 'dra zhig yin na'ang de las rtsab nas 'gal du 'jug mi rung bar bstan pa'o//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 29748 chu mgo chad ba'i jing bu/ dbung rogs med ba'i dba' bo/ dpe chu rgyun 'bab sa'i chu 'go chad zin pa'i rdzing bu bzhin du/ don rgyab phyogs nas dpung rogs yong mkhan med pa'i dpa' bo zhes dpe don sbyar te/ de rigs/ ni pham nyes yong rgyu nyas cig las bzlog thabs med par bstan pa'o// (ma lnga sna khams khul )49 chu chen bo brgal dus ngo tsha med/ gtam chen po lab dus ngo tsha med/ dpe chu chen po brgal ba'i skabs su de snga ched bzos mdoms ras sogs med rkyen mi tshang ma gos yongs rdzogs phud de brgal bar ngo tsha mi byed pa nge bzhin du/ don gal 'gangs che ba'i skad cha'i rigs lha stod dus ngo tsha dang / 'dzim gzon sogs bya rgyu med par gnas lugs kha gsal lhu snad dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ngo tsha'am 'dzim bya la'ang tshad gzhi yod par bstan pa'o//50 chu sprod 'jam gyis sha mi tshos/ gtam nyag nyog gis don mi go dpe chu drod 'jam nang sha btsos na dmar log thebs/ nas ji tsam btsos na yang sha yag po mi tshos pa bzhin du/ don gtam kha gsal med pa'i nya ge nyog ge ji tsam bshad kyang go dgos nges kyi don dag gsal po go mi thub ces dom sbyar te/ bya ba gang yin rung skad cha gsal po go don 'phrod pa zhig lha rwad dgos par bstan pa'o//51 chu ma shor gong nas rags/ rkyen ma byung gong nas zlog ba/ dpe chu ma shor ba'i snga rol nas chu rags rgyag dgos pa de bzhin du/ don bya ba gang yin yang rkyen ma lhags gong nas bzlog thabs bya rgyu gang yod bya dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ma byung sngon 'gog gi bya thabs spyod rgyu ni gal 'gangs ha cang che ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o//52 chos med kyang bla ma'i tshul/ ) med kyang bags ba'i tshul/ dpe spu med na'ang pags pa yin khul byeng pa bzhin du/ chos med na'ang bla ma'i tshul bzung ba zhes dpe don sbyar
298 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/te / rang nyid la cha rkyen de lta bu med kyang ming chen po zhig 'khur dgos byung zer ba lta bu khengs skyungs la spyod pa mang zhing / yang skabs re kho la de 'dra'i cha rkyen med na yang ming stong tsam khur ba yin zhes 'phya dmod lta bur spyad kyang chog /53 ra tshwa med dang / gtam don med/ dpe ja la tshwa med na bro ba med pa bzhin du/ gtam don med la snying po ci yang ma mchis zhes dpe don sbyar te/ don dag med pa'i skad cha lha snad pa ni rang gzhan gnyis lnga'i dus tshod chud zos kyi rgyu las/ dge mtshan ci yang med par bstan pa'o//54 la rdzang gar zug la nyi ma/ bu gar song la mna' ma/ dpe 'ja' gang du zug sa der nya nyi 'od yod pa bzhin du/ don bu gang du song yang sa de gar mna' ma yod ces dpe don sbyar ba ste/ pho khyo ga gar bskyod sar chung ma 'tshol ba de lugs mthun lta bur bshad pa 'di las lam lugs rnying pa'i pho mo 'dra mnyam ma yin pa'i bsam blo'i shugs rkyen mtshon pa yin phrus//55 nyam chung tshig gis nus mi thon/ dbul po'i nor la rin mi khug dpe dbul po'i rgyu nor la rin nges kyi gong mi rag pa bzhin du/ don mi nyam chung gi tshig la bden pa'i don snying yod na'ang nus pa ci yang thon mi thub ces dpe don sbyar te/ spyi tshogs thog dbang dang rgyu nor med na bya ba gang zhig kyang 'grub mi thub par bstan pa'o//56 nyi ma rgas khar spro/ mi tshe rgas khar sgyid/ dpe nyi ma nub ri brgal khar dro ba bzhin du / don mi tshe rgas pa'i skabs su skyed pa zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ pha ma tshos dka' sdug du ma spyad de bu tsha rnams gsem skyong byas pa yin pas lo na mtho por slebs dus dal skyed du gnas thub pa zhig dgos par bstan pa'o//
—rlu don zung sbrel gyi tshos brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 29957 nyi ma shar na mun ba 'gro/ bden ba bdar na rdzun ba gsal/ dpe nyi ma shar na mun pa rang bzhin du sangs 'gro ba ltar/ don bden pa'i bden khungs ra sprod byas na rdzun ma gsal por ther 'don byed thub ces dpe don sbyar nas/ rang la bden pa yod phyin bden don rnams mthar phyin pa gsal bshad bya da〈snas par bstan pa'o// (khams khul )58 nyin brgya chub ba'i me rtog med/ sgyi thag ring ba'i grogs bo dkon/ dpe nyi ma brgya'i rid la bzhad nas sdod pa'i me tog med pa ba'i na du/ don tshe gang ring mdza' gcugs 'gyur med kyi gzhung phyi thag ring ba'i grogs po dkon zhes dpe don sbyar te 'grogs 'dris byas pa'i grogs po yin phyin skyed sdug khe nyen ji ltar 'phrad na'ang 'gyur ba med pa'i grogs po dam pa zhig bya tsho dgos par bstan pa 'di ni bod rigs kyi kun spyod gal chen zhig yin//59 gnyom chung byas nas dgra ngo mi lon/ med mug bshad nas 'grul ngo mi lon/ dpe gnyom chung sems chung byas nas dgra bo'i ngo len byed mi thub pa bzhin du/ don med rabs dang mu ge byung tshul sogs bshad nas 'grul pa'i ngo ya lon mi thub pa dpe don sbyar te/ rtag par gnyom chung dang sdug skad kho na brgyab kyang don 'grub mi srid pas skabs dang bstun shes pa gal che bar bstan pa'o//rdzoX gtam kha nas shor/ rdza la ga nas shor/ dpe rdzam lag nas shor na chag thor 'gro rgyu las skyo ste ba thabs med pa de bzhin du/ lnga don gsang da41sa pa'i gtam kha nas zugar ba'i rjes tshur bsdu thabs med ces dpe don sbyar te/ skad cha lha snad dus lha snad 'os dang mi 'os bsam zhib bya dgos pa las/ thos tshad gang dran bshad na rjes su 'gyod kyang bzlog thabs med par bstan pa sbyatsu//
300 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/61 gtam go ba log bas rgyal khams da khug /zas go re skam bos mid ba dbral/ dpe bag sreg skam po za nyes na mid pa dbral ba bzhin du/ don skad cha go log thebs nyes kyis rgyal khab 'khrug gzhi'i ngan 'bras bzo ba zhes dpe don sbyar te/ skad cha nyan bshad gang gi skabs su'ang go ba ma log pa zhig yong thabs nges par du nan tan bya dgos par bstan pa'o// (a mdo khul )62 gtam gyi mgo ma ku re/ chos kyi mgo ma skyabs 'gro/ dpe chos kyi 'go 'dzugs de skyabs 'gro nas byed pa bzhin du/ don gtam gyi 'go 'dzugs skabs kyang kha mtshar bzhad gad thag ge ba zhig 〈snang ba byas na/ phan tshun blo bag phebs shing sems sgo yangs por bye ste brjod don gang zhig bshad dgos na'ang gros mol bde blag ngang lhag por nyabyed thub par bstan pa'o// (a mdo khul )63 gtam brgya bshad kyi snying po don/ zho brgya dkrog gi snying bo mar/ dpe zho thengs brgya phrag dkrog pa'i dgos pa mar 'don rgyu de kho na yin pa de bzhin du/ skad cha brgya bshad stong bshad kyi snying po dgos don go bar bya rgyu de yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ don med kyi gtam 'chal mi lha da par gang bshad de don go chod pa zhig lha pād dgos par bstan pa'o// ('grog khul )64 gtam don can zhib tu smo na mtshar/ gos bkrag can rgyang nas bltas na dga'/dpe tshig zin ltar go sla zhing / mdor na dbang po lnga'i spyod yul tha dad par rang rang gi khyad chos dang byed las mi 'dra ba yod par bstan cing / 'dir don gtso bo gtam rgyu mtshan ldan pa de rna bas nyan pa kho pa na tsam gyis mi tshe byog par bsam zhib legs par bgyis na/ gzhi nas ngo mtshar can gyi don snying rtogs thub par bstan pa'o//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 30165 gtam bden rdzun dbyad na shes/ lug tsho jid reg na shes/ dpe lug rgyags lod lag pas reg na gsal por shes pa bzhin du/ don skad cha bden pa yin rdzun ma yin de brtag dpyad zhib nan byas na shes thub ces dpe don sbyar te/ bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed skabs don dngos la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug bya rgyu de ha cang gal che bar bstan pa'o//(a mdo khul )66 gtam mi'i mdun la shod/ mtshon dgra'i mdun la 'phyar/ dpe don tshig zin ltar go sla ba bzhin ldog nas bsam na/ skad cha mi'i rgyab ngos su lha rwad pa ni mtshon cha dgra bo'i rgyab tu 'phyar ba ji bzhin ngo tsha la zhe khrel ba'i tha shal gyi sbyo sted tshul zhig yin pas/de ltar ci nas kya nga bya mi rung bar bstan pa'o// (a mdo khul )67 gtam shod sar kha bde dgos/ dgra phub sar lag myur dgos/ dpe dgra bo dang 'thab sar lag pa myur dgos pa bzhin du/ don skad ca 〈snad sar kha bde po byed thub pa dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ldog phyogs nas skad cha lha da mi dgos sar kha bde po bya rgyu med par shugs la bstan pa'o// ca68 rta kha srab kyis sgyur/ mi sems gtam gyis sgyur/ dpe rta'i kha lo srab kyis sgyur nus pa de bzhin du/ mi rnams kyi sems kyang gtam gyis sgyur 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ dril bsgrags dang / spyi tshogs kyi gleng phyogs sogs mdor na skad cha 〈snad phyogs kyis mi'i sems khams la 'gyur ldog gtong ba'i nus pa chen po ldan yod par bstan pa'o//69 rta sga 'og tu mi 'dus ba/ mi khrims 'og tu mi tshud ba/ dpe rta ci 'dra zhig yin rung sga 'og tu mi 'dus pa med pa bzhin du/ don mi su zhig yin na'ang khrims lugs kyi 'og tu mi tshud pa med ces dpe don sbyor ba mang / 'on kyang skabs re mi khrims 'og tu mi tshud pa zhig 'dug ces tshig bsgyur gyis spyod pa yang yod do//
302 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/7༷ rta chung la bzhon bde/ mi chung la bskul bde/ dpe rta gzugs chung la bzhon bde po yod pa bzhin du/ mi nyam chung las ka bskul bde po byed kyin 'dug ces dpe don sbyar te / mi gzhan gyis mthong chung dang rtag par brnyas bcos byed pa 'khur 'dod med pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig shugs la mtshon par spyod pa'o//71 rta thar sar sga thar/ dpon thar sar g.yog thar/ dpe rta gang du 'gro sar rta sga yang mnyam du slebs pa bzhin du/ dpon po gang du phebs sar g.yog po yang mnyam du thar dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te bod rnying par dpon po tsho ni g.yog po dang kha 'bral thabs med na yang / skabs re dpon po rnams 'dod yon longs spyod byed sar g.yog po tshor spyod skal med par ma rangs pa'i 'phya dmod byed pa mtshon//72 rta sha shed rgyas dus 'tshong dgos/ 'i snyan grags che dus gzab dgos/ dpe rta shed mo yag dus 'tshong dgos pa bzhin du/ mi snyan grags che ba'i skabs su gang sar gzab gzab bya dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te/ ming grags thang che dus khengs dregs lhod g.yeng gi bsam tshul 'chang ba ni nyen kha ha cang chen po yin pas rig pa sgrim nas dogs gzon lhod med bya dgos par bstan pa'o//73 rta har mas srab kha mi len/ dman dred mos kha ta mi nyan/ dpe rta rgod kyis srab kha mi len pa bzhin du/ 'jem 'tsher mi shes pa'i bud med rang shed can gyis kha ta bslab bya rna bar mi nyan zhes dpe don sbyar te ma myong dgu thug gi bud med byang mar rgyu mtshan bshad kyang / phan pa med par bstan pa'o//74 sto 'grangs tshod la zhog /gtam go tshod la zhog dpe lto 'grangs tshod la za mtshams bzhag na lus phung bde ba bzhin du/ don bshad dgos pa'i skad cha de phar phyogs kyis gsal po go ba'i tshod la lha nod mtshams bzhas dgos zhes dpe don sbyar
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 303nas/ gtam bo rdzo nas kyang bskyar bshad yang bshad mang drags na nyan mkhan gyi zhe la phog pa las/ phan pa gzhan med par bstan pa sbyatsu//75 thob go sa don du gnyer ba de/ 'bu bse sbyar gyang la 'go ba 'dra/ dpe 'bu bse sbrur gyang ldebs su 'dzegs bzhin mar lhung 'gro ba bzhin du/ don thob thang dang go gnas kho na don du gnyer ba de ni ngal ba 'bras med kyi bya ba zhig yin par bstan nas/bsam slo de rigs gtong mi rung bar gdams rma 'o// (a mdo khul )76 drang bo sus byed dpon po/ byams bo sus byed pha ma/ pha ma'i mtshan nyid ni rang gi bu phrug la byams skyong byed pa de yin pa bzhin du dpon po'i mtshan nyid ni mi drag zhan su yin la ma bltos par drang po drang bzhag byed pa de yin zhes bstan pa'o//77 drang bo bshad na mi mi dga'/ rgyug ba na khur na khyi mi dga'/ dpe lag tu rgyug pa thogs na khyi rnams rdung bar dogs nas mi dga' ba de bzhin du/ mi rnams ngo dga' sbrel lad la dga' bas skad cha drang po thad kur bshad na mi dga' ba'i spyi tshogs kyi goms 9gshis ngan pa zhig chags sku(da ces bstan pa sbyatsu//78 bden rdzun bsdur sa khrims ra/ gser rag brdar sa ka shu da dpe gser dang rag gang yin rdo ka shu ka la brdar na dbye ba chod pa de bzhin du/ don su bden dang su rdzun gang yin de khrims ra'i nang bsdur na gsal po mthong thub ces dpe don sbyar ba'o//79 rdo ril ril cig ba'i dkrug shang] mi ril ril khrims kyi dkrug shing / dpe rdo ril ril gcig brtsigs na de rtsig pa'i dkrug shing du 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ don mi ril ril te yid brtan rtsab nas med par mgo nas gang mtho'i phyogs su phar ril tshur ril byed mkhan de rigs ni khrims kyi dkrug shing rang yin zhes dpe don spyar nas mi de gras la spyi tshogs yongs kyis ther 'don dang / gnon shugs sprod dgos par bstan pa'o//
304 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/80 〈ma bu mang sar lo rtog nyung1 kha lab mang sar blo ros dkon/ dpe sa zhing rtsa yan mang po yod sar ston thog nyung nyung las mi yong ba de bzhin du/ gtam nyog rdzogs rgyu med pa bshad nas sdod sar don dang ldan pa'i blo gros thon dkon pa yin zhes dpe don zung du sbrel nas sbyod pa'o//81 sde mgo skyong na khog rgya che dgos/ rta rgod khrid na mthur thag ring dgos/ dpe rta rgod ri 77ra khrid na mthur thag ring tsam dgos pa bzhin du/ don sde tsho pa'i 'go 'dzin byed na phra dogs chung gzon ma yin par khog yangs dkyel che'i bsam blo 'dzugs dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas dpon po'am 'go 'dzin ji tsam gyis che na/ khog rgya yang de tsam gri1sa je cher bskyed dgos zhes gdams pa'o// ('brog khul )82 sdong po mang na rlung khog mi grangs mang na don 'grub/ dpe shing sdong po ci tsam mang po yod na de tsam gyis bye rlung 'gog nus che ba de bzhin du/ don las ka byed pa'i mi grangs ji tsam mang na de tsam gyis las don 'grub che ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas mang tshogs ni stobs shugs kyi 'byung khungs yin par ston pa'o//83 4 nang khul tshong mi rgyag /dbon g.yog sho ma rgyag dpe dpon g.yog sho brgyab na thob lhu ra ji ltar byung rung mtha' 'bras bzang po mi yong ba de bzhin du/ don nang tshags tshong brgyab na khe gyong su la byung yang 'tsham po med ces dpe don sbyar ba'o//84 dbon chen tra lde kha yag don med yin/ nam ring zas mi lam stong ba yin/ dpe nam ring po'i gnyid lam stong pa yin pa bzhin du/ dpon chen po'i skad cha yag po de tsho don la 'khyol thabs med ces dpe don sbyar nas/ dpon po'i khas len bzang bzang la yid ches bya mi nyan zhes bstan pa cas//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 30585 dpon las gnyis kyi mi seg ri ngo gnyis kyi lug phe dpe ri g.yas g.yon gnyis la khyab pa'i lug gi dzi bo ni g.yas ri 'ded na g.yon rir mi slebs pa bzhin du/ bod rnying pa'i nang dpon 'go mi 'dra ba gnyis la khral 'ul rgyug dgos pa'i mi ser ni gcig gi bka' ltar bsgrubs na/ gcig gi thugs dang 'gal 'gro bas de las khag pa med ces dka' ngal dper 'os pa'i tshad du bstan pa'o//86 dbon bag ru sde blun spru 'gro/ bo'u (me mda' pa brgyab na ri dwags gsan las/ dpe me mda' brgyab na ri dwags rnams 'a tor+sha ga nas ca ) gas bzhi mtshams brgyad du 11sa 'a〈sna ba de bzhin du/ dpon po btsan dbang che drags na mi sde tshang ma yul spangs nas 'thor 'gro ba dpe don sbyar nas sde 'bangs la btsan shed byed mi rung bar bstan pa'o// (a mdo khul )87 stod nyi ring bor grang gsum dang spro gsum/ mi tshe ring bor skyid gsum dang sdug gsum/ dpe dpyid dus kyi nyi ma ring por gangs char rlung 'tshub dang / nyi ma dro skyed sogs gnam gshis 'gyur ba sna tshogs yong ba de bzhin du/ don mi tshe ring po 'di la skabs re skyed po dang skabs 'gar sdug po sogs bde sdug sna tshogs yong srid pa ni mi yul gyi chos nyid yin pas ya mtshan dang / ha las dgos don ci yang med ces dpe don sbyar nas bshad pa'o//88 pha gcig bu snyan dgra ru langs/ sngas zhabs sha skal dug tu gyug dpe sngag 'og tu bcug bzhag pa'i sha skal de rul sungs kyis dug tu gyur pa bzhin du/ pha gcig pa'i bu spun de dgra ru langs pa zhes dpe don sbyar te 'ong mi srid pa'i bya ba thabs rdugs po blo yul las 'das pa zhig byung zer ba lta bu'am/ yang na de 'dra ba'i bya ba ngan pa rtsab nas byed mi nyan zhes kha ta byed pa la spyad kyang phyuzlog bo sna/ ('a〈snag khul )
306 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/89 pha gcig rung bsam spru mi gcig /sngas gcig rung rmi lam mi gcig dper na mi gnyis sngas 'go gcig gi thog mgo bzhag nas gnyid nyal yang rmi lam mi 'dra ba so dra par rmis pa bzhin du/ don pha gcig gi bu phrug yin rung bsam blo gcig pa yong mi srid ces dpe don sbyar nas mi rgyud ring lugs smra bar dgag pa rgyag pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin//9༷ 'o ngan tshig la bskyar zlos/ rul ma'i rtsam ba nyis 'thag dpe bud med le lo can gyi tshos btags pa'i rtsam pa zhib mo mi 〈snang bas bskyar du 'thag skyo par byed dgos pa bzhin du / don pho go ma chod kyi tshig la bskyar zlos yang bzlos byed pa zhes dpe don sbyar nas gtam gang lhu snad rung / tshig nyung don gsal go brda 'phrod pa zhig bya dgos par bstan nya nga/sbyang// ('dre tog khul )91 pho rab tshig zog gnas/ 'phar ba rjes thog 'tho/ dpe gcan gzan 'phar ba ni rang gi rkang rjes kyi thog mi 'phyugs par 'gro ba bzhin du/ don pho rab cig yin na rang gis gang bshad pa'i tshig thog tu gnas dgos zhes kha dan don thog 'khyol dgos zer ba yin// (a ma lnga rdzo khul )92 bo e bden kha la tshig bzhag /mdzo e bzang rgyab la khal 'gel/ dpe mdzo yag nyes de rgyab la khal bkal nas 'ded na shes pa bzhin du/ don pho drang po yin min de kha nas bshad pa'i tshig la gnas dgos zer ba yin//93 bu skyes par ming dang / chang 'drin bar gtam/ dpe bu zhig skyes na ming 'jogs dgos pa bzhin du/( don gtam zhig lha nod par yang nges par chang 'dren dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te bod kyi sngar srol la gtam bzang ngan gang 'dra zhig shod pa'i skabs su'ang sngon la chang zhig 'dren pa'i yul goms gshis lugs 〈snad pa de mtshon gyin yod//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 30794 bu bad bas pha shul mi zin/ rta ngan bas sga khog mi khengs/ dpe rta ngan chung gis rta bzang po'i khog mi khengs pa de bzhin du/ don bu ngan pas pha bzang po'i shul rjes zin mi thub ces dpe don sbyar nas bstan pa'o//95 bu mo skyid sar mi sdod/ ra ma bde sar 'i 'ju/ dpe sgo phyugs ra ni lam bde sar mi 'gro ba g.yang gzar 〈snags rtsub sa gar yod du 'gro ba bzhin/ bu mo yang pha mas bkod sgrig byas pa'i khyim tshang skyid sar mi sdod zer ba 'di thog nas de snga gnyen sgrig rang dbang med pa las byung ba'i ngan 'bras de mtshon gyi yod/༈96 bya slo tas nam 'phang mi chod/ bu ngan bas rang mgo mi thon/ dpe bya khu tas mkha' dbyings mthon por nam 'phang gcod mi thub pa bzhin du/ don bu nyam zhan gyi spyi tshogs kyi thog rang mgo thon mi thub ces dpe don sbyar nas de lta bur rogs ston khrid gsum bya da〈snas pa shugs la bstan pa nyo(// (a ma lnga sna khul )97 bya mang dkyil du rdzo brtog /mi mang dkyil du dma' phab/ dpe don gnyis sbyar ) kha gtad 9 ) gas kyis bsam bzhin du brnyas ba〈snas dang / dma' 'bebs nad mi theg pa zhig byas byung zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//98 byas ba la rjes dang / drud ba la shul/ dpe dngos po zhig drud pa la nges par drud shul zhig 〈snang ba bzhin du/ don las ka gang zhig byas na'ang nges par byas pa'i rjes shig yod dgos zer ba lta bur spyod cing / skabs re las ka byas par rin dod gang yang rag ma byung zer ba la spyad kyang chog /99 bla ma phal cher 4ga tho li bu la sa khungs/ me rtog phal cher chu bo'i 'gram la skye/ dpe me tog gi rigs phal cher chu ro'i mtha' 'gram la skye ba bzhin du/ don bla ma'i sprul sku phal che ba ni rgyu nor phyug po yod pa'i khyim tshang gi bu la 'khungs kyi 'dug ces dpe don
308 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/sbyar nas bod kyi bla sprul ngos 'dzin zer ba de phal cher rgyu nor la bltas nas byed kyin 'dug ces zur za byed pa'o//1༷༷ blo rtseganyis kyis don mi 'grub/ khab rtseganyis kyis tshem bu mi yong ka go bde ba'i dpe don de gnyis sbyar te 'gag rtsar thug pa'i don chen sgrub skabs blo rtse gcig sgril gyis sems thag bcad nas mtha' 'khyongs bya dgos pa las/ nem nur dang phyir ba lha shā spru bya rgyu med zer bar spyod pa yin//101 dbul na dgra las gnyen sdang] chad na zur las chen gzar/ dpe thang chad pa'i skabs su thur las kyang gyen gzar ba'i tshor ba 'byung ba bzhin du/ don nor gyis dbul ba'i dus su dgra las kyang gnyen sdang ba yong zhes dpe don sbyar te dbul zhing phongs na dgra bo'i zhe sdang zhi 'gro yang / gnyen nye tshos g.yar skye re gsum gyis dogs nas sdang zug byed ces spyi tshogs kyi gnas lugs bshad pa'o//102 dgrar drug ba'i shwa 'os rwa la me)ma/ dgun bcu ba'i wa mos gra la 'dzim/ dpe srog chags dud 'gro yin rung / rang nyid kyi dge mtshan rgyas pa'i dus so sor dogs gzon chen po byed kyi yod ces dper bstan nas mi dbang thang dang / longs spyod/ snyan grags bcas dar zhing 'dzoms pa'i dus su phyi nang gang sar dogs gzon chen po bya dgos pa las/ bag med lhod g.yeng rtsab nas byed mi rung zer ba lta bur spyad na 'tsham po yod//103 sprul phar rgyug gi rnga ma 'ju dka'/ tshig phar shor gyi rnga ma sdud dka'/ dpe sbrul phar la rgyug 'gro ba'i mjug ma lag pas 'jus nas tshur 'then dka' ba de bzhin du/don rang gi kha nas lha rdzor ba'i tshig gi gzhu gu de tshur bsdu rgyu dka' ba ste bsdu thabs med ces dpe don sbyar nas dus rgyun du kha nas bshad mi dgos pa'i tshig thal rigs mi lha dor ba'i goms gshis 'jags pa bya dgos par gdams pa'o// (a mdo khul )
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 309104 mar skogs mar gyis mi shul/ chos dred chos kyis mi shul/ dpe mar skogs la mar byugs nas ji tsam mnyed kyang dul rgyu med pa bzhin du/ don chos tshig kho nas dred pa la chos ji ltar bshad na yang / sems rgyud 'dul mi thub ces dpe don sbyar ba'o//105 mi skyed sar mi sdod/ ra bde sar mi 'tho/ dpe sems can ra ni lam bde sar mi 'gro bar brag ldebs g.yang gzar la 'gro ba bzhin du/ don mi rnams kyang skyed po yod sar yun ring sdod mi 'dod ces dpe don sbyar nas gtso bo mi la la skyed ma theg par de las lhag tsam zhig dgos 'dod byed ces par spyod pa yin//106 mi skyon gdon dgos/ shing skyon gzhog dgos/ dpe shing gi skyon gang du yod pa de gzhog nas thad ka 'drong po zhig yong thabs bya dgos pa bzhin du/ don mi'i skyon yang rang gzhan su la yod rung 'don thabs kyis dus thog sel dgos par bstan pa'o//107 mi skyon med la(ma bu gling dang / shing la tsher med rgya rong nags/ dpe shing 'dzir pa med pa srid pa'i nags ldong du'ang med pa de bzhin du/ don mi skyon rtsab nas med pa 9'dzam gling na med ces dpe don sbyar te/ mi la skyon phra mo tsam yang med pa dgos pa'i re 'dun ni don dngos dang mi mthun par gdams pa'o//108 mi go ba can la bshad ba/ shing yal ga can (la )'dzegs ba/ dpe shing yal ga mang po can la 'dzegs bde po yod pa de bzhin du/ don mi go shes can la rgyu rkyen lha da sa yod ces dpe don sbyar te/ gzhan gyis brjod pa'i gtam la rgyu mtshan yod med nyan shes bsam gzhigs bya da tra rwa so pa yin zhes gdams pa sbyatsu//109 mi rgas na dbang med/ rta rgas na gong med/ 'di ni spyi tshogs kyi tshul lugs la cung zad ma rangs pa'i sdom tshig cig yin rung / don la gnas tshul de ni dngos po'i chos nyid dang mthun pa zhig yin//
310 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/110 mi rgas na yul dran/ bya rgas na tshang dran/ dpe bya rgas na rang gi tshang dran pa bzhin du / mi lo rgas dus rang gi pha yul dran pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar ba'o//111 mi rgyu la mi dga' ba dang / khyi khrag la mi dga' ba/ spyir na dpe khyi khrag la mi dga' ba med pa bzhin du/ don mi rnams kyang rgyu nor la mi dga' ba ha cang dgon pa'am/ yang na yong mi srid ces spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'o//112 mi rgyu dang bral na sbrang bo/ mda' snyo dang bral na dgrag ba/ dpe mda' yi sgro rnams yongs rdzogs med par gyur na dbyug pa ste rgyug hreng zhig yin pa bzhin du/ don mi rgyu nor kun dang bral na sprang po rang chags zhes dpe don sbyar nas sbrang po zer bar rgyu mtshan gzhan gang yang med ces rim pa mang ba'i spyi tshogs lam lugs la dmod pa'o//nya113 mi rgyud can gyi bu mo/ rta rgyud can gyi thor mo/ (rte'u mo ) dpe rta rgyud legs pa'i rte'u mo bzang po thon pa bzhin du/ don mi rgyud legs pa'i bu mo mna' mar blangs na bu rgyud bzang po spel thub ces dpe don sbyar ba 'di ni rigs rgyud smra ba'i shugs rkyen phog pa mtshon zhing / sgo phyugs sogs rgyud bzang srel ba ni don dngos yin// (a mdo khul )114 mi brgyad la bsam blo brgyad dang / rkyang brgyad la rna 'gyog bcu drug dpe ri dwags rkyang brgyad la rna 'phyog bcu drug yod pa de bzhin du/ mi brgyad la bsam blo brgyad yod ces dpe don sbyar nas mi rnams so so'i gnas bab dang re 'dun mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mi re la bsam tshul re 〈snad pas mi sems gcig gyur zer ba ni yong dka' bar bstan pa'o//115 'i brgya sems gcig /rta brgya 'gros gcig dpe rta brgya gom 'gros gcig pa 'grig pa bzhin du/ mi brgya blo sems gcig pa dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te tshang ma mthun sgril rdo rtsa gcig gyur yong ba bya dgos par bstan pa'o//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 311116 mi ngan gyi khog spru g.yos khengs/ dung dkar gyi khog ba 'bus khengs/ dpe dung dkar po phyi dbyibs mdzes kyang khog pa ni 'bu yis khengs pa bzhin du/ don mi ngan 'dzum bag can gyi khog pa yang g.yo jus kyis khengs yod ces dpe don sbyar nas phyi'i rnam pa bzang po tsam la yid ches bya mi rung bar/ nang gi don snying bzang ngan legs par brtag dgos pa'o///117 mi ngo thang che ba rgyu yin/ sha gong thang che ba tshil yin/ dpe sha rin gong mtho ba de tshil yod pa la brten nas byung ba bzhin du/ don mi la cha mthong che ba de yang rgyu nor mang po yod pa la brten nas byung ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar ba ltar/ dbang yod na rgyu nor los kyang yong ba de yang tshud yod do//118 4 gcig la gcig brten/ rdzas la lung brten/ dpe rdza khog gi kha la lung gnyis brten pa bzhin du/ don mi yang gcig la gcig brten te thad gar ram/ yang na gnyen la gnyen brgyud/ grogs la grogs mched serwa gas kyi 'brel ba yod pa la zer ba yin// ca119 mi chung chung gis lde 'go mi zin/ rdo chung chung gis phur mgo mi non/ dpe rdo chung chung gis phur pa brdung na mi non pa de bzhin du/ don mi chung chung gis sde tsho pa'i 'go 'tsho bzung mi thub ces dpe don sbyar ba 'di ni spyi tshogs thog ming cha mthong che chung la bltos nas bshad pa'i goms gshis rnying pa gzhir bzung ba yin no// ('brog khul )120 mi gnyis bar nas rdza chag /blo gnyis bar nas don 'a4gas/ dpe mi gnyis gcig gis gcig gis bzung snyam pa'i bar du gnyis gas glod nas rdza chag pa de bzhin du/ don la blo rtse gnyis kyi bar nas don dag 'phyugs 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te don chen sgrub skabs blo rtse gcig gtad byed pa las/ e lo sgyur lo rtsab nas bya mi rung bar gdams pa'o//
312 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/121 mi chen lhung na g.yog bo mi nyan/ gos chen zed na lhan ba mi nyan/ dpe gos chen rnying pa rtsab tor gyur na lhan pa'ang mi nyan pa de bzhin du/ mi go sa mthon po nas dbyungs na kho la goms 'dris dang / las myong gang yang med pa'i ga sku(ga po'ang mi nyan zhes dpe don sbyar te spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpon ngan las thang med pa la zur za byed pa'o//122 mi snying mi la ga gad/ bya snying shing la ga ltad/ dpe bya snying ste bya'i blo gtad shing sdong la bcol ba bzhin du/ don mi snying ste mi yi blo gtad mi la bcol ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas blo gtad pa'i mi de nam yang phung du 'jug mi nyan par cis kyang blo thub pa bya dgos par bstan pa'o//nya123 mi drang dgos/ lha mtshar dgos/ dpe lha sku bzhengs pa'i gtso bo'i dgos 'dun ni dbyibs legs mtshar sdug ldan pa zhig da〈snas pa bzhin du/ mi zhig byed pa'i gtso bo'i mtshan nyid drang bden tshad ma zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas/ drang po mi byed pa de ni mi'i rigs kyi kun spyod tha shal zhig yin par bstan pa'o//124 mi nag med la nag /rdo zur med la zur/ dpe rdo zur med la zur 'dug zer ba bzhin du/ mi nag med la nag 'dug ces ma nyes kha ga9(gas 'gel gyi 'dug zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang / bzo rtsis byed pa'am/ bzos na mi 'grig ces pa 〈snags skabs bstun tshig grogs bsgyur chog pa gzhan dang 'gre//125 mi mang nang na mkhas ba yod/ bye ma'i khrod na gser gye yod/ dpe bye ma'i khrod na gser phye yod pa de bzhin du/ don mi mang gi nang na gang dang gang la mkhas shing byang chub pa'i mi yod pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas shes rig dang nus rtsal mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs ni/ mi mang mang tshogs yin zhes bstan pa phyo(//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 313126 mi mang tshogs sar kha mo snga/ mgar ba'i go khar lag ma snga/ dpe mgar ba'i 'thab 'gram gyi dngos por lag pa 'chang mi rung ba ni des tshig nyen yod pa bzhin du/don mi mang po tshogs sar don chen la yin min gyi kha tshig snga drags na nyen 'gan rang thog la 'khor nyen yod ces dpe don sbyar nas mi gzhan gyi zer 'gros la bltas nas shod dgos zer ba lta bu yin//127 mi zhim sman gyis nad bad gso/ mi snyan gtam gyis don la phan/ dpe sman kha la zhim po med pa des lus kyi nad ngan rtsa nas sel ba bzhin du/ don rna bar snyan po med pa'i bden gtam gyis dngos don la phan thogs chen po yong ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas kha mkhas tshig snyan la dga' po bya mi rung bar/ don dngos phan gnod ji yong shes dgos par bstan pa'o//128 mi la mi dgos kha mchu/ shing la mi dgos 7)ra ba/ dpe shing la mi dgos pa 'dzir pa yin pa bzhin du/ mi la mi dgos pa gyod dam kha mchu yin zhes dpe don sbyar te / gtso bo don chung la 'grig thabs gtso bor byas te lab rgyu gleng rgyu mi yong ba bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o//129 mi la blo dgos/ phag la sna dgos/ dpe phag pa yin na rang gi khyad chos gzhan la med pa'i 'khor lo lta bu'i sna dgos pa de bzhin du/ 'gro ba mi yin na sre rwag chags gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos te blang 'dor tshul bzhin 'byed pa'i blo gros shig dgos pa yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas mis nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos par gdams pa cas//13༷ mi la mi kha med na sha ba yin/ shing la du ba med na rul ba yin/ mi la la gzhan gyis rang la mtho bshad dma' bshad byed kyi 'dug ces sems sdug byed pa la sems
314 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/gso byed skabs spyad kyang chog pa yin zhing / dpe shing rul ba me la bsregs kyang du ba med pa bzhin du/ don mi ma shi bar du gang ltar mi kha yong ba de la ha las rgyu med ces bstan rnga/'o//131 mi su la mi re med/ lam gang la mi 'gro med/ dpe lam gang zhig la yang 'gro mi dgos pa'i nges pa med pa de bzhin du don mi su dang su yin rung nam zhig gi tshe kho la re mi dgos pa'i nges pa med ces dpe don sbyar te mi su la'ang dgra 'khon rigs mi 'byung ba dang / phan 'gyur gyi 'brel ba rgya gang che 'dzugs dgos zhes gdams pa'o//132 mi bslu na tshig gis bslu/ rta bsnya na snyog gis bslu/ dpe rta sgrog gis bslu ba bzhin du/ don mi yang tshig snyan pos bslu ba yin zhes dpe don zung 'brel gyis bstan te / mi tshos tshig 'jam gyis blo sna khrid pa la yid ches snga drags pa bya rgyu med ces gzab nan byed dgos par gdams pa'o// ('brog khul )133 mis mi theg ba gtam/ chus mi theg ba re'u/ dpe chu yis rde'u mi theg pa bzhin du / don mis gtam ste sems la gzan pa'i skad cha theg mi thub ces dpe don sbyar nas mi la pho ge thug 'gro ba'i gtam rtsab nas bshad rgyu med par gdams pa'am/ skabs re rna bar mi 'bab pa'i skad cha bshad pa'i lan la thad yar spyod mkhan yang yod//134 mis mi za mna'/ khyis mi za lcags/ dpe khyis lcags mi za ba bzhin du/ don mis mna' mi za zhes dpe don sbyar nas mna' bskyal ba la yid ches bya dgos zer ba lta bur spyod pa mang //135441 med pa la khyer shog dang / sha ba la longs shog dpe shi zin pa'i mi la longs lha rwag zer thabs ma mchis pa bzhin du/ don med pa la khyer lha rwag zer ba ni btsan gtam ya med cig min na gang yin zhes mang tshogs kyis dbang sgyur par ngo rgol byed par spyod pa yin//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 315135442 na yan la rdzogs dus med/ mi sno la shi dus med/ dpe zhing nang gi na yan ji tsam btog kyang ldogs rgyu med pa de bzhin du/ mi ngan ni dus tshod ji tsam song na'ang da dung shi rgyu med pa zhes spyi la gnod pa'i mi la dmod mo rgyag pa lta bur spyod pa yin// ga136 tshig brgya zag bshad na mdo dgos/ sga lhu bzhi sgrig na rgyun dgos/ dpe shing gi sga stod smad g.yas ga〈snan bcas lhu bzhi de gcig tu sgrig na ldem byed kyi rgyun bu da〈snas pa bzhin du/ don tshig brgya phrag mang po bshad pa yin na de la mdo tshig ste snying po 'di yin zhig dgos zhes dpe don sbyar nas skad cha zugad dus don snying gsal po dgos pa las tshig nyog mang po bshad mi nyan zhes ston pa'o// (a ma lnga sna khul )137 tshig stong bshad na mgo bo na/ me stong btang na dgral ba tshig dpe bkol bya med pa'i me skong stong pa btang na mtha' 〈 snar mi rnams kyi dpral ba tshig pa las lus drod la mi phan pa bzhin du/ don tshig nyog gi stong gtam bshad na nyan mkhan ma tra sna bo mnar ba las don la phan pa med ces dpe don sbyar te/ skad cha stong bshad bya rgyu med ces gdams pa'o// tsā138 mig thag zung na nyan bde/ yob thag zung na bzhon bde/ dpe rta sga'i yob thag thung na bzhon bde ba bzhin du/ don skad cha'i tshig thag ring po min pa thung na nyan bde ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar te/ pha rol por skad cha'i mdo don lha nod dgos zer ba'am yang na rang nyid kyis skad cha rdog cig shod kyi yin zer ba lta bu gang rung la spyad na chog /139 tshig rtsab can la go rgyu yod/ ba nu gzhol can la 'jo rgyu yod/ dpe ba mo nu ma 'jol ba can la 'o ma 'jo rgyu yod pa de bzhin du/ don tshig rtsab chen po can la go rgyu nges par yod ces dpe don sbyar nas mi yon tan can gyi gtam mam/ yang na don 'gag rtsar thug pa'i gtam serwa gas la go rgyu chen po 〈snad pas nan tan gyis nyan nas go ba len dgos zhes ston pa'o//
316 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/140 tshig shul na don rtsa med/ khab shul na skud ba med/ dpe khab 'then pa'i shul na skud pa med tshe tshem bu yong thabs med pa de bzhin du/ tshig ji tsam bshad pa'i shul na don rtsa med na dus tshod chud zos stong bshad yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas don dag med pa'i skad cha stong pa nyan bshad byeng mi rung zhes 'doms pa'o//141 tshe gcig gi bza' lpu/ khal gcig gi do ya/ dpe sgo phyugs la khal 'gel dus do po cha gcig med na 'gel mi shes pa de bzhin du/ mi tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba skyel dus bza' zla gcig med thabs med pa'i gtan grogs ni gal chen por brtsi dgos par bstan pa'o//142 tshong pas drang bo mi shod/ blun ma lam la mi 'gro/ dpe rkun po rnams rang mnong nyama bzod par mi gzhan dag 'gro sa'i brgya lam la mi 'gro ba bzhin du/ don tshong pa tshos khe bzang za dgos pas skad cha drang po lha(da mi srid ces tshong pa'i skad char yid ches bya rgyu med ces bstan pa'o//143 mdzub mo gcig gis gnam mi trag /grog ma'i gcin bas sa mi bang ka dpe 'bu grog ma'i gcin pas sa bzhi slong mi thub pa de bzhin du/ don mdzub mo gcig bsgrengs nas gnam 'big mi thub ces sbyar nas mi nyam chung gis zhu gtugs brgyab na yang bden pa bden thog tu 'khyol mi thub ces zer ba yin//144 mdzo 'o rgas nas bshas ra/ mi 'o rgas nas khrims ra/ dpe mdzo pho tshe gang rmo las sogs bskul mthar rgas nas bshas rar skyel ba bzhin/ don mi rgan 'chi khar khrims ra 'grim dgos byung zhes dpe don sbyar nas de rigs ni mi 'os mi 'tsham pa'i bya ba zhig yin par bstan pa'o//
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 317145 zas ngan gcig gis lus kyi stod smad dkrug /mi ngan gcig gis yul gyi phu ma da'ad khug dpe zas ngan gcig za nyes nas lus kyi nad gzhi slong ba bzhin du/ don mi ngan pa gcig gis yul sde kun dkrug srid ces dpe don sbyar nas 'phung dkrug slong mkhan gyi mi de ngan pa yin pas tshang mas dogs gzon dang zur 'bud bya dgos par bstan pa'o//146 zas za na 'o bas 'ju tshod/ gtam bshad na gdeng tshod yod dgos/ pho bas mi 'ju ba'i zas zos na gzugs por nad gzhi bzo ba ltar1 gdeng meng pa'i skad cha gang byung bshad na gyod gzhi bzo nyen yod ces bstan nas/ gtso bo skad cha lhu da dus khungs dang gdeng tshod 〈snad med bsam zhib nan po bya dgos par gdams pa'o //147 sbram zim char bas ri sul snyil/ kha mi grags sdod bas yod rgya 'phung] dpe char pa zim zim 'bab pa der mi rnams kyis do snang mi byed kyang / nam zhig ri bo snyil ba bzhin du/ mi kha mi grags par sdod mkhan la sus kyang dogs gzon mi byed pa des canyin gcig yod rgu thams cad 'phung la sbyor srid ces dpe don sbyar nas mi g.yo can de rigs la do snang byed dgos par bstan pa'o//145 zer tshad bden min/ btsos tshad sha min/ dpe btsos tshad tshang ma sha yin mi srid pa de bzhin du/ don mis zer tshad tshang ma bden pa ma yin zhes dpe don spyar nas/ gtso bo mi gzhan gyis skad cha gang bshad la yid ches rtsab nas bya mi rung zhes gdams pa cas// ( a ma lnga sna khul )149 4 bza' rgyu mang na nad yin/ bshad rgyu mang na gyod yin/ zas za za mang drags na 'bras bu nad skye ba bzhin so gtam bshad bshad mang drags na mtha' 'bras gyod gzhi bzo ba yin zhes don med kyi skad cha mang po da mi rung bar dpe yi sgo nas gdams pa'o//
318 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/15༷ 'a chad 'u shug /sa zad gram zug dpe sa zad pa'i mtha' ma gram par thug pa bzhin du/ don da cha yod tshad tshang ma zad nas bya thabs gang yang med zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//151 'u shug na gnyen dran/ thang chad na rta dran/ dpe lam thag ring por thang chad pa'i skabs su gzhi nas rta dran pa bzhin du/ don dka' ngal phrad de 'u thug pa'i skabs su gzhi nas rang gi gnyen nye ba dran pa zhes dpe don sbyar te rgyun ldan bde po skyid po byung dus dga' nye la do snang mi byed pa zer ba lta bur spyod pa yin//152 6 zug na zhu sa dbon/ thang chad na g.yab sa rta/ dpe rkang pa thang chad na zhon sa rta ma gtogs gzhan med pa ltar/ don thabs shes gzhan med par 'u thug na zhu sa dpon po ma gtogs med ces dpe don sbyar te 'u thug na zhes pa des dpon por zhu dgos pa ni las kyi mtha' yin par shugs la bstan pa cas// ('a〈snag khul )153 5 yon 'grim na rgyu dgos/ rgyu ma skyong na tshil dgos/ dpe sgo phyugs bsad pa'i rgyu ma sbyo steng ba la tshil dbo rwa so pa de bzhin du/ ya mon te khrims sar gtugs pa la rgyu dgos zhes dpe don sbyar te rgyu nor med na bden pa ji tsam yod kyang khrims sar 'phro thabs med ce so bstan pa'i a mdo khul gyi gtam dpe zhig bo sna/154 5 rabs ma rabs spyod bas shes/ skye yul gang yin skad kyis shes/ dpe mi zhig sa phyogs gang nas yin yul skad las shes pa bzhin du/ don ya rabs yin dang ma rabs yin de spyod pa la bltas na shes thub ces dpe don sbyar nas/ dus rtag tu kun spyong bzang po rgyun 'khyongs yong ba bya dgos zhes gdams pa'o//155 yun ring na bu mo ma dang 'khon/ za che na sbrang dkar zhe la rgyag dpe sbrang rtsi zhim mngar ldan yang zas drags na zhe log pa bzhin du/ ngon a ma byams skyong che rung
dpe don zung sbrel gyis brjod don gsal bar ston pa/ 319'grogs yun ring drags na rang gi bu mo dang 'khon pa'ang yong srid ces dpe don sbyar nas bya ba gang yin yang tshad las 'das na ldog phyogs su 'gyur srid ces bstan pa'o//156 yul dbon dgra ru langs na 'gro jis/ bad zhan mid khris na na sha rtsis/ dpe bad kun mid khris kyi nad phog na shi rtsis ma gtogs bya thabs med pa bzhin du/ don yul gyi dpon po rang gi dgrar langs na yul de nas 'gro rtsis bya rgyu las/ thabs gzhan med ces dpe don sbyar nas yul dpon 'khon na sa der chags sa med par bstan pa'o//157 yod po med skad che/ rod skam kob sgra che/ dper na/ g.yag gi grod pa skam po kob sgra gzhan las che ba de bzhin du/ don rgyu nor mang po yod pa'i mi la la med pa'i sdug skad gzhan las che zhes dpe don sbyar nas ham 'dod tshim med kyi mi de rigs la 'phya dmod byed pa'o//158 rwa gang mtho zhabs ba bzed sa/ rgyu su che dpon pos sdigs sa/ dpe g.yag lug sogs rwa co gang mtho ba de zhags pa bzed sla ba bzhin du/ mang tshogs nang rgyu nor su camang ba de dpon ngan gyi mig gis sdigs sa zhig tu 'gyur 'gro ba yin zhes dpe don sbyar nas sgyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpon ngan za rngams can gyi spyod pa la ther 'don byed pa'o//(a ma lnga sna khul )159 rang ma gtogs mi min/ yong do ma gtogs sha min/ dpe smad khog gi sha ldag ma gtogs sha la mi brtsi ba bzhin du/ don rang nyid gcig pu ma gtogs mir mi brtsi ba zhes dpe don sbyar nas don dngos dang rbad de 'gal ba'i lta stangs de 'dra 'dzin mkhan ni / mi rang shed kyis mig ldong ba'i glen rmongs mthar thug pa zhig yin par bstan pa'o//(khams khul )

338 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/na / re zhig grub kyang mtha' mar brlag /gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong bu yis/ lo rtog zos mthar gzhan gyis bsad/sa ces g.yo sgyu'i bya ba mang drags na mthar thug 'phung bar 'gyur ba'i don dang sbyar nas gsungs yod cing / 'on kyang gtam dper spyod skabs go don de dang mi 'dra ba gong du bshad pa ltar phyi jig nang stong ngam/ yang na phyi nang mi mtshungs pa sogs la go dgos pa'i khyad par yang shes dgos so//12 bya gral byi so/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i byung tshul ni dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud las/ sngon pha wang la bya khral bskul dus khos so bstan nas nga bya rigs min par byi ba'i rigs yin zhes bshad pa dang / yang kho la byi ba'i khral bskul dus nga byi ba min bya'i rigs yin zhes ga lha nog pa lheb lheb brdabs pas mthar khral gnyis ka rgyug mi dgos pa byung ba yin zhes grags pa ltar dpe de byung zhing / mi mgo bde po la las thabs shes ngo gnyis ma spyad de gyong g.yol khe bzang za thabs byed mkhan la gtam dpe 'di spyad nas sting tshig sgrog gin yod do//13 bya brgya shar lta/ pha wang nub lta/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni sngar gyi gtam rgyud cig la/ gna' snga mo bya rigs rnams kun tshogs te bya'i rgyal po gdam bsko bya skabs/ sang zhogs bya su zhig gis nyi ma shar ba sngon la mthong ba de la bya'i rgyal po bsko rgyur gros thag chod pa na/ sang nyin skya rengs 'char ma thag bya thams cad ri rtser 'dzoms shing / bya gzhan rnams kha shar la gtad nas nyi ma shar rgyur sgug nas bsdad pa na/ pha wang gis kha nub ngos kyi ri rtser gtad nas nyi 'od 'char rgyur bltas nas bsdad/ nyi ma'i 'od zer thog ma 'phros ma thag nub phyogs kyi ri rtser nyi mdangs ser lhag ger phog pa dang pha wang gis skad chen po zhib brgyab ste/ nyi ma dgos na ya gir 'dug ces bstan pa na bya thams cad kha nub la bltas so/ /pha wang gis de ni nyi mdangs ma gtogs nyi ma ngo ma ma red zer yong snyam nas lam seng kha shar la slog

340 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/nas/ u lags zhes skad brgyab nas bos pa na/ sge khung zhig nas a ma bag dro ba lke la lnga ba chen po yod pa zhig gis bltas nas/ ci byed zer bar kho pa gang lha nod 'di lha nod med par/ lnga bcos gnang e dgos zhes bshad/ khyim tshang de ni 'byor pa ldan pa zhig yin la/ a ma de yang dang dod che ba zhig yod stabs rab tu dga' ste/ lnga bcos byed dgos yod/ em chi 'a/gas mgyogs po yar phebs rogs gnang zer nas nang du gdan drangs/ kho la bza' btung gi sne len gzab cing rgyas pa byas/ khos bza' btung la tshim par longs spyod bzhin du lba bcos kyi 'go 'dzugs stangs dang / lhag par mjug ji ltar bsdu rgyu'i skor la bsam blo yang yang btang //de nas a ma des/ lnga bcos gnang bar yo chas gang dang gang dgos zer bar/khos lhabs bde po yin/ chu dkar yol gang dang / sbra snam lheb pa gcig byung na 'grig ces smras pa ltar de dag 'khyer yong / a ma de'i mgo bo kho rang gi pang du bzhag nas nyal bcug /sbra tshal lheb pa de chu la sbangs te lnga ba'i thog 'phur 'phur btang zhing yang yang chu la slong gin 'phur brdar byas pa na/ lba ba'i mdog dmar skyar gyur zhing tsha zug je cher phyin bzod sran mi thub tsam byung bas bud med des/ khyed kyis lnga bcos ji tsam gnang myong ngam zhes dris par khos mang po byed ma myong / mi gnyis la byas pa yin zer bar mos/ khong tsho gang 'dra byung song ngam zhes dris par khos/ mi gcig ni shi song /gzhan de ni dgongs pa zhus song zer/ yang snying lba bcos byas nas drag pa gcig kyang byung med pas mo yang skrag ste/ dgongs pa zhu na ci 'dra bya dgos zer bar khos/ las sla po yin/ dgongs pa zhu dus mar dkrog gcig phul na de gas 'grig ces bshad/ mos 'o na nga yang dgongs pa zhu rgyu yin zhes yar langs te kho la mar dkrog gcig phul nas dgongs pa zhus so zhes pa'i sgrung las mched pa yin zhing / skabs re 66mar dkrog 'bul rgyu yin :: zhes brjod mkhan yang yod de go don ni gcig mtshungs yin no//
gtam dpe 'ga' zhig gi 'byung khungs bshad pa/ 34116 mi dkar por zhwa nag 'o/ dpe 'di lo rgyus thog /sa skya 'phags pa rin po che sku gshegs khar nye gnas che mos/ dpon chen nam mkha' bzang pos bla ma 'phags par ngo log byed kyi 'dug ces yon gong ma hu be+e lir snyan phra zhus rkyen dmag sam gha dpung bcas bod du mngags te/ pa rnam bya rog ljaja phab nas dpon chen la srog khrims gcod skabs/ khong gis gos dkar gtsang zhig gi thog zhwa nag po gcig gyon nas gsod rar phyin tshul deb ther nang gsal yod pa de las mched skad//17 mi nag can yer ba'i brag phug na 'dug kyang] nga sgyi zug la sger tshwa mi rgyagces pa'i dpe 'di'i 'byung khungs ni dmangs khrod kyi bshad srol la/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes btsan po glang dar mar lkog mda' 'phangs nas bkrongs pa'i rjes su/ gsang thabs sna tshogs spyad nas yer pa'i sgrub khang du gros te yibs bzhugs skabs/ 'ded mi rnams kyis rjes ma non par bzung ma thub kyang / yer pa'i ri steng du lug 'tsho ba'i dzi bo zhig gis lha lung dpal rdor brel brel 'tshab 'tshub ngang ri gsham nas 'dzegs shing / brag phug nang 'dzul ba mthong ste ci yin dogs pa za nas myur bar brag phug rnang phyin thog khong gi brang khar lag pa sbyar skabs snying rtsa lug gu lding lding 'phag pa tshor yang cang mi smra bar phyir thon/ de nas btsan po gsod mkhan bros nas ma zin pa'i gtam thos dus/ khos/ che mi nag can yer pa'i brag phug na 'dug kyang / nga spyi thug la sger tshwa mi rgyag nya ces chig lab brgyab pa las mched pa yin zer ro//18 mo ston phag mgo zhes pa ni/ zog brdzu can nam/ bsnyon 'dzugs mkhan zer bar spyod pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin zhing / byed mi rung zhes pa'am/ min nam zer ba sogs skabs dang bstun te bsgyur na chog /gtam dpe de'i 'byung khungs kyang 〈〈ro sgrung 〉〉 gi le tshan zhig las 'phros pa yin/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ gna' snga mo grong tsho chung ngu zhig na/ bud med grung po gcig la khyo bo le lo can sked rags kyang (mi )
342 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/'ching bar khyim nang kho nar nyal sdod pa zhig yod/ bud med des/ pho khyo kha nyal na mda' mgo lha snar/ mda' mgo 〈snar na dgra mgo langs/ dman bud med nyal na phang mgo 〈snar/phang mgo lha snar na gyon gos hrul/ zer ba yin pas pho khyo kha phyir thon na nom pa yong srid pas de ring cis kyang phyir song dang zhes bskul ma byas pas/ kho khyim nas thon te ri gsham la 'gro ba'i dus/ 'grog pa skyas spos pa'i shul nas bya rog cig gis thur rdar zhig rnyed pa 'khyer nas 'phur yong ba ldid ma theg par lhungs pa kho'i mdun phyogs zags/ de bsgrugs te bza' zlas bshad pa de la rgyu mtshan 'dug snyam//khyim du log nas bza' zla la/ pho khyo kha phyi la thon na nom pa lon thag chod yin 'dug /khyod kyis rta bzang po gcig dang / khyi bzang po zhig grabs gyis nga thag ring sar 'gro zwan yin zhes bshad pa ltar mos chas rnams 'thus tshang bsgrigs zin pa dang / khos rta la bzhon/ khyi de khrid song ba las/ lung stong zhig tu slebs pa na wa mo gcig 'gro ba mthong bas de la khyi rbad cing / de'i rjes su rta rgyugs nas phyin/ wa mo de khung gcig tu 'dzul lo/ /kho der 'gror pa dang rta las babs te khyi de rta'i thur thag la btags/ zhwa mo phud de 'dzul khung gi kha bkag /rang gi gos thung ma gtogs gyon chas rnams phud de sga thog bsdams/ rdo leb cig spyad nas wa tshang brkos pa na/ wa mo de sdod ma 'od par khung nas thon pas kho'i zhwa mo de mgo la thogs bzhin bros pa dang / de'i rjes su khyis 'ded pas rta yang mnyam du rgyugs nas la lung brgal ba na/ kho rang stod hreng mar lus/ da nom pa phar bzhag rta dang gyon chas kyang med par yul du log na ngo yang tsha snyam ste/ rta khyi rgyugs sa'i phyogs su phyin//la zhig 'dzegs pa'i la rtse nas mar blta skabs/ rgyal po'i pho brang chen po zhig mthong de la kha gtad song ba na rim bzhin nyi ma nub cing sa yang rub/ kho stod hreng ma yin pas 'khyags shing 'dar nas rgyal po'i phag tshang gi gyang la 'dzegs nas de nub
gtam dpe 'ga' zhig gi 'byung khungs bshad pa/ 343phag pa dang mnyam du nyal bas dro bar byung yang / phag mo a ma zhig gis mchu 'bud yang yang brgyab ste nyal ma bcug pas de la khong khro chen po skyes/ sang zhogs nam langs nyi ma shar dus khos phag tshang gi rtsig srub nas phar blta dus/ rgyal po'i sras mo sgo ra'i nang 'cham bskor byas nas phar 'gro skabs lke nas g.yu zhig thag pa chad de zags pa mthong / khos de la bltas nas sdod skabs ba rdzobs ba phyugs rnams chu 'thung bar 'ded yong zhing / ba mo zhig gis tag tag g.yu de'i steng du lci ba zhig btang ba mthong /khos mu mthud nas blta gin bsdad pa na/ yud tsam nas rgyal po'i bran mo zhig 'ongs te lci ba de yar bsgrugs nas gyang ldebs la sbyar nas lag pas bcag bcag 'ga' byas te phar song / khos lci sgor de la ngo rtags nan tan brgyab ste phag tshang nas phyir thon srang lam du zhugs 31//tsha rting khar slebs dus mi mang po rug tshogs byed pa'i sar kho yang song / rgyal po'i blon po zhig skad chen pos/ da nang rgyal po'i sras mo'i mgul nas rgyal po'i bla g.yu 'od can bor brlag song 'dug pa su la rnyed kyang bya dga' blo 'dod gang ba zhi gi gnang rgyu yin zhes yang yang sgrog pa na/ khos mi tshogs kyi gseb nas thon te/ ngas mo 'debs shes pas phal cher rnyed thub/ 'on kyang bya dga' 'dod pa khengs pa zhig gnang e thub ces bshad par blon po des/ rgyal po'i bla g.yu rnyed na/ bya dga' khyed kyis gang gsungs yongs rdzogs 'bul rgyu khas len zhu chog /mo 'phya gnang rgyur dgos cha gang yod gsung rogs zer zhing rgyal por yang snyan gseng zhus/ khos dgos char phag tshang nang gi phag mo a ma 'di'i mgo bo byung na de gas 'grig ces bshad/ de 'phral kho la dar zab kyi zhwa gos lham sogs cha tshang dang / phag mo de bsad pa'i mgo bo bcas sprad de rgyal po'i drung du khrid/ khos yul de'i mi tshang ma rgyal po'i sgo ra'i nang bskongs bcug /phag mgo de la shing gi yu ba zhig bcos/ de dar tshon gyis dkris nas lag tu
344 gtam mdzod mes po'i zhal rgyun/thogs te mi tshogs kyi khrod du phyin nas/ phag mgo mi la 'dzugs gin du kha nas/ 'ji la med na 'di la yod zer bzhin bskor ba na/ phag mgo 'dzugs rgyur bsdad pa'i mi rnams su 'o/ khag btsugs yong snyam shin tu skrag /mi tshogs rdzogs zin mtshams skya ldebs kyi lci ba rnalas/ la de ltar brjod bzhin phag mgo btsugs mthar/ g.yu yod pa'i lci sgor de la phag mgo btsugs te/ 'di la yod ces mtshams bzhag nas lci sgor mar blangs pa'i nang nas rgyal po'i bla g.yu 'od can de blangs nas phul bas thams cad ha las te kho la mo ston phag mgo mngon shes can zhes snyan grags kun tu khyab//rgyal pos/ da bya dga' ci 'dod dris par/ khos wa zhwa gyon dang / khyi rta khrid bcas dgos zer/ de gang yin dris par/ sngar kho rang gi brlag song ba rnams cha tshang dgos zhes smra shad pa rnams de bzhin du sprad/ blon po 'khor dang bcas pas kho rang gi khyim du bskyal/ khyim thabs la sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bshad pas mos rgyal po'i bla g.yu tsam btsal bar bya dga' des ga la tshad zer nas/ yi ge zhig bris nas de lnga'i dgos cha rnams ni rgyal po'i sku gegs sel byed kyi gto bcos yin/ bla g.yu btsal ba'i bya dga' rgyal po rang gis thugs rje ma chung ba zhig gnang dgos zhes bskul ba na/ rgyal blon rnams gros byas mas de los bden zer nas slar yang gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa'i rgyu nor dang / gnag rta lug gsum la sogs pa'i sgo phyugs bcas gnang bas khong gnyis dbul ba dang bral nas bde skyed kyi 'tsho ba la rol ba sogs kyi sgrung gtam de las byung ba yin no//19 mon yul rdor gcod/ ces pa 'di ni a mdo'i khul du grags pa'i gtam dpe zhig yin/ dpe 'di'i yong stangs ni/ sngon lho phyogs mon gyi yul du chos dpe rdo rje gcod pa bris ma tshar gsum yod/ rang rloms can gyi mi 'ga' zhig gis dpe de gsum gyi tshig sbyor mi 'dra bar mthong nas tshar gsum po de phan tshun zhib bsdur byed
